```python
    def test_p2_values_guards_fail_closed(self):
        for overrides, error in (
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"backgroundFetchesPoolSize": 7}}}, "clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize must be an integer from 8 to 64"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"backgroundFetchesPoolSize": 65}}}, "clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize must be an integer from 8 to 64"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"backgroundFetchesPoolSize": "16"}}}, "backgroundFetchesPoolSize"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"enabled": "true"}}}, "enabled"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"keepFreeSpaceBytes": -1}}}, "keepFreeSpaceBytes"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"namedCollections": [{"name": "si_owner_1", "port": "9000"}]}}}, "port"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"passwordEnv": [{"name": "X", "secret": {"name": "s", "key": "k", "optional": True}}]}}}, "optional"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"server": {"replicas": 2}}}, "replicas"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"access": {"member": "yes"}}}, "member"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"access": {"engineGrants": {"si_snode": "MergeTree"}}}}, "si_snode"),
            ({"clickhouse": {"access": {"passwordSha256": {"si_member": TEST_P2_PASSWORD_SHA256["si_member"].upper()}}}},
             "clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_member must be 64 lowercase hex characters"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(error=error, overrides=overrides):
                self.assert_rejected(overrides, error)
        # A legacy release takes none of it: the engines need users, the bundle the lock, the member the bundle.
        for overrides in (self.values("engines"), self.values("restarted"), self.values("member")):
            result = render_legacy(overrides)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertIn("clickhouse.access and verifier.clickhouse require arbiter.protocol=pinned-genesis-v1", result.stderr)

    def test_grant_probe_covers_every_member_grant_and_refusal(self):
        rows = grant_probe_rows()
        member = [(expect, statement, probe_row_atoms("si_member", statement)) for role, expect, statement in rows if role == "si_member"]
        self.assertTrue(member)
        held = role_atoms("si_member")
        for expect, statement, atoms in member:
            with self.subTest(statement=statement):
                granted = all(atom_granted(atom, held) for atom in atoms)
                # ok and override rows pass the access check (an override fails after it, 36); denied rows need a right si_member lacks.
                self.assertEqual(granted, expect in ("ok", "override"), f"si_member {expect}: {statement}")
                self.assertEqual(bool(probe_overrides(statement)), expect == "override", statement)
        # Every grant of SI_MEMBER_GRANTS and the collection grant has an ok row; the
        # hg_rstage entry one row per right.
        for grant in probe_role_grants("si_member"):
            for grant_atom in grant_atoms(grant):
                with self.subTest(grant=grant, atom=grant_atom):
                    self.assertTrue(any(
                        expect == "ok" and any(atom_exercises(atom, grant_atom) for atom in atoms) for expect, _, atoms in member
                    ), f"no ok row of si_member exercises {grant_atom}")
        ok_statements = [statement for expect, statement, _ in member if expect == "ok"]
        for right in ("SELECT count() FROM hg_rstage.", "INSERT INTO hg_rstage.", "ALTER TABLE hg_rstage.p2_probe_scratch DELETE",
                      "CREATE TABLE hg_rstage.", "DROP TABLE hg_rstage.", "TRUNCATE TABLE hg_rstage.", "OPTIMIZE TABLE hg_rstage."):
            self.assertTrue([statement for statement in ok_statements if statement.startswith(right)], right)
        denied = [statement for expect, statement, _ in member if expect == "denied"]

        def refused(pattern):
            return [statement for statement in denied if re.fullmatch(pattern, statement)]

        # Every Replicated*MergeTree engine and every reaching engine, in hg_rstage and in hg_replica.
        for engine in REPLICATED_MERGE_TREE_ENGINES + REACHING_ENGINES:
            for database in ("hg_rstage", "hg_replica"):
                with self.subTest(engine=engine, database=database):
                    self.assertTrue(refused(rf"CREATE TABLE {database}\.\w+ .*ENGINE = {engine}\(.*"))
        # A Replicated database, data moved into hg_member_unsafe, writes to it, the
        # owner's databases, a remote() write, a replica drop.
        for pattern in (
            r"CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage ENGINE = Replicated\(.+\)",
            r"ALTER TABLE hg_member_unsafe\.\w+ ATTACH PARTITION tuple\(\) FROM hg_rstage\.\w+",
            r"ALTER TABLE hg_rstage\.\w+ MOVE PARTITION tuple\(\) TO TABLE hg_member_unsafe\.\w+",
            r"CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW hg_rstage\.\w+ TO hg_member_unsafe\.\w+ AS .+",
            r"INSERT INTO hg_member_unsafe\.\w+ VALUES .+",
            r"ALTER TABLE hg_member_unsafe\.\w+ DROP PARTITION tuple\(\)",
            r"TRUNCATE TABLE hg_member_unsafe\.\w+",
            r"OPTIMIZE TABLE hg_member_unsafe\.\w+ FINAL",
            r"SELECT count\(\) FROM hg_safe\.\w+",
            r"SELECT count\(\) FROM hg_unsafe\.\w+",
            r"INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote\(si_owner_staging, .+\) VALUES .+",
            r"SYSTEM DROP REPLICA 'probe' FROM ZKPATH '/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/p2_probe_target/1'",
            # D36: no dictionary, definer, SQL SECURITY NONE or SYSTEM right on hg_rstage.
            r"CREATE DICTIONARY hg_rstage\.\w+ .+ SOURCE\(NULL\(\)\) .+",
            r"CREATE DICTIONARY hg_rstage\.\w+ .+ SOURCE\(CLICKHOUSE\(DB 'hg_safe' .+",
            r"SELECT dictGet\('hg_rstage\.p2_probe_dict', .+\)",
            r"CREATE VIEW hg_rstage\.\w+ DEFINER = default SQL SECURITY DEFINER AS SELECT 1",
            r"CREATE VIEW hg_rstage\.\w+ DEFINER = default SQL SECURITY DEFINER AS SELECT .+ FROM hg_safe\.\w+",
            r"CREATE VIEW hg_rstage\.\w+ SQL SECURITY NONE AS SELECT 1",
            r"SYSTEM STOP MERGES hg_rstage\.\w+",
        ):
            with self.subTest(pattern=pattern):
                self.assertTrue(refused(pattern), pattern)
        # The four keys of a collection, each overridden once.
        overrides = [probe_overrides(statement) for expect, statement, _ in member if expect == "override"]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(key for keys in overrides for key in keys), ["host", "password", "port", "user"])
        # ClickHouse 26.3 grants CREATE VIEW with CREATE TABLE (Plan S3-C2 §23.2): a
        # plain view and a materialized view over hg_rstage are measured as accepted.
        self.assertIn("CREATE VIEW hg_rstage.p2_probe_v AS SELECT 1", ok_statements)
        # The engine rows of the other users: the protocol's DDL forms after the
        # restart, and the engines they do not hold.
        by_role = {}
        for role, expect, statement in rows:
            by_role.setdefault((role, expect), []).append(statement)
        for role, expect, pattern in (
            ("si_snode", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE hg_unsafe\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree\('/sentio/0/unsafe/.+"),
            ("si_snode", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE hg_safe\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple\(\)"),
            ("si_snode", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE hg_promote\.(\w+) AS hg_safe\.\1"),
            ("si_snode", "denied", r"CREATE TABLE hg_safe\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = SummingMergeTree ORDER BY tuple\(\)"),
            ("si_verifier", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE default\._hg_replay_scratch_\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple\(\)"),
            ("si_verifier", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE hg_unsafe\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree\('/sentio/0/unsafe/.+"),
            ("si_gateway", "ok", r"CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS devnet2"),
            ("si_gateway", "ok", r"CREATE TABLE devnet2\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple\(\)"),
            ("si_gateway", "ok", r"CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE \w+ \(.+\)"),
            ("si_gateway", "denied", r"CREATE TABLE devnet2\.\w+ \(.+\) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree\(.+"),
            ("si_gateway", "denied", r"SELECT count\(\) FROM remote\(si_owner_staging, .+\)"),
            ("si_reader", "denied", r"CREATE TABLE .+"),
            ("si_reader", "denied", r"CREATE DATABASE .+"),
            ("si_reader", "denied", r"CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE .+"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(role=role, expect=expect, pattern=pattern):
                self.assertTrue([s for s in by_role.get((role, expect), []) if re.fullmatch(pattern, s)])
        # The probe objects default creates first (on staging's own Keeper root) and drops last.
        default = [statement for role, _, statement in rows if role == "default"]
        for statement in (
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hg_member_unsafe.p2_probe_target (k UInt64, v Int64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/p2_probe_target/1', 'probe') ORDER BY tuple()",
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage.p2_probe_src (k UInt64, v Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()",
            "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS hg_member_unsafe.p2_probe_target",
        ):
            self.assertIn(statement, default)

    def test_member_live_probe_is_a_refusal_only_subset_of_the_corpus(self):
        lines = [line for line in MEMBER_LIVE_PROBE.read_text().splitlines() if line and not line.startswith("#")]
        self.assertEqual(lines[0], "expect\tstatement")
        live = [tuple(line.split("\t")) for line in lines[1:]]
        self.assertTrue(all(len(row) == 2 for row in live), live)
        self.assertEqual(len(live), len(set(live)))
        corpus = {(expect, statement) for role, expect, statement in grant_probe_rows() if role == "si_member"}
        for expect, statement in live:
            with self.subTest(statement=statement):
                # Refusals only: nothing it runs on a live host can succeed.
                self.assertIn(expect, ("denied", "override"))
                # The same row as on staging, with that installation's collection.
                self.assertIn((expect, statement.replace("@@COLLECTION@@", "si_owner_staging")), corpus)
                self.assertEqual("@@COLLECTION@@" in statement, "remote(" in statement)
                # No row names a table a live host must hold: only refused creations and remote() calls.
                self.assertRegex(statement, r"^(CREATE (TABLE|DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS|DICTIONARY|VIEW) hg_r(stage|eplica)\b|INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote|SELECT count\(\) FROM remote)")
                self.assertNotIn("hg_member_unsafe", statement)
        statements = [statement for _, statement in live]
        for engine in REPLICATED_MERGE_TREE_ENGINES + REACHING_ENGINES:
            for database in ("hg_rstage", "hg_replica"):
                with self.subTest(engine=engine, database=database):
                    self.assertEqual(len([s for s in statements if re.fullmatch(rf"CREATE TABLE {database}\.\w+ .*ENGINE = {engine}\(.*", s)]), 1)
        self.assertIn("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage ENGINE = Replicated('/p2-probe/db', 's', 'r')", statements)
        self.assertTrue([s for s in statements if s.startswith("CREATE DICTIONARY hg_rstage.") and "SOURCE(NULL())" in s])
        self.assertTrue([s for s in statements if re.fullmatch(r"CREATE VIEW hg_rstage\.\w+ (DEFINER = default SQL SECURITY DEFINER|SQL SECURITY NONE) AS SELECT 1", s)])
        self.assertEqual(len([s for s in statements if s.startswith("INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote(@@COLLECTION@@, ")]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(key for expect, s in live if expect == "override" for key in probe_overrides(s)),
                         ["host", "password", "port", "user"])
        # The exit probe's ReplicatedMergeTree row (spec §16 P2 exit).
        self.assertIn(("denied", "CREATE TABLE hg_rstage.p2_probe_rmt (v Int64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/p2-probe/{uuid}', 'r') ORDER BY tuple()"), live)
```

```python
    def test_devnet2_p2_stage_follows_the_rollout(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE), {FRESH_RELEASE, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c"})
        self.assertTrue(set(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE.values()) <= set(P2_STAGES))
        # Each stage moves indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network (contract §28.2),
        # and no installation starts a stage before every one finished the one before.
        b = p2_level(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE["storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b"])
        c = p2_level(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE["storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c"])
        n = p2_level(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE[FRESH_RELEASE])
        self.assertTrue(b >= c >= n >= b - 1, (b, c, n))
        # P2 starts after the lockdown: every installation is in posture C.
        for name in DEVNET2_P2_STAGE:
            self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_POSTURE[name], "C", name)
        # The network installation follows storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml.
        overlay_path = DEVNET2 / "storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
        overlay = yaml.safe_load(overlay_path.read_text())["clickhouse"]
        stage = DEVNET2_P2_STAGE[FRESH_RELEASE]
        self.assertEqual(overlay["access"]["engineGrants"], p2_engine_grants(stage) if p2_level(stage) >= 1 else {})
        self.assertEqual(overlay["access"]["member"], p2_level(stage) >= 3)
        self.assertEqual(bool(overlay["access"]["passwordSha256"].get("si_member")), p2_level(stage) >= 3)
        self.assertEqual(overlay["server"], {
            "enabled": p2_level(stage) >= 2, "keepFreeSpaceBytes": DEVNET2_KEEP_FREE_SPACE_BYTES,
            "namedCollections": p2_collections(FRESH_RELEASE), "passwordEnv": p2_password_env(FRESH_RELEASE),
        })
        network = self.control[("ClickHouseInstallation", FRESH_RELEASE)]
        self.assertEqual(network, p2_chi(network, FRESH_RELEASE, stage, overlay["access"]["passwordSha256"].get("si_member")))
        # indexer-b's and indexer-c's manifests are exactly what si_p2_yaml writes
        # at their stage, and every other line of theirs is Plans S3-B's and S3-C1's.
        text = overlay_path.read_text()
        self.assertEqual(p2_overlay_text(text, stage, overlay["access"]["passwordSha256"].get("si_member")), text)
        for path, name, chi, chi_stage in self.p2_manifests():
            with self.subTest(installation=name):
                self.assertEqual(chi, p2_chi(chi, name, chi_stage, self.own_si_member_hash(chi)))
                self.assertEqual(p2_manifest_text(path.read_text(), name, chi_stage, self.own_si_member_hash(chi)), path.read_text())

    def test_p2_stage_rewrites_reach_every_stage_and_back(self):
        overlay_path = DEVNET2 / "storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
        overlay_text = overlay_path.read_text()
        overlay_stage = DEVNET2_P2_STAGE[FRESH_RELEASE]
        own = yaml.safe_load(overlay_text)["clickhouse"]["access"]["passwordSha256"].get("si_member")
        for stage in P2_STAGES:
            with self.subTest(file=overlay_path.name, stage=stage):
                rewritten = p2_overlay_text(overlay_text, stage, TEST_P2_PASSWORD_SHA256["si_member"])
                values = yaml.safe_load(rewritten)
                self.assertEqual(values["clickhouse"]["access"]["engineGrants"], p2_engine_grants(stage) if p2_level(stage) >= 1 else {})
                self.assertEqual((values["clickhouse"]["server"]["enabled"], values["clickhouse"]["access"]["member"]),
                                 (p2_level(stage) >= 2, p2_level(stage) >= 3))
                # Nothing else of the overlay moves.
                expected = yaml.safe_load(overlay_text)
                expected["clickhouse"]["access"]["engineGrants"] = values["clickhouse"]["access"]["engineGrants"]
                expected["clickhouse"]["access"]["member"] = values["clickhouse"]["access"]["member"]
                expected["clickhouse"]["server"]["enabled"] = values["clickhouse"]["server"]["enabled"]
                hashes = expected["clickhouse"]["access"]["passwordSha256"]
                hashes.pop("si_member", None)
                if p2_level(stage) >= 3:
                    hashes["si_member"] = TEST_P2_PASSWORD_SHA256["si_member"]
                self.assertEqual(values, expected)
                self.assertEqual(p2_overlay_text(rewritten, overlay_stage, own), overlay_text)
        for path, name, chi, chi_stage in self.p2_manifests():
            text = path.read_text()
            for stage in P2_STAGES:
                with self.subTest(installation=name, stage=stage):
                    rewritten = p2_manifest_text(text, name, stage, TEST_P2_PASSWORD_SHA256["si_member"])
                    self.assertEqual(yaml.safe_load(rewritten), p2_chi(chi, name, stage, TEST_P2_PASSWORD_SHA256["si_member"]))
                    # Rolled back to its own stage, the manifest is the same text again.
                    self.assertEqual(p2_manifest_text(rewritten, name, chi_stage, self.own_si_member_hash(chi)), text)
                    # Every comment line of the manifest is kept in order.
                    added = P2_POSTURE_COMMENT + P2_MANIFEST_FILES_COMMENT + P2_MANIFEST_ENV_COMMENT
                    comments = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.lstrip().startswith("#") and line not in added]
                    kept = [line for line in rewritten.splitlines() if line in comments]
                    self.assertEqual(kept, comments)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            p2_manifest_text(INDEXER_B_CHI.read_text(), "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "member")
```

```yaml
# Throwaway staging installation of stage 3 P2 (housegate spec 2026-10-14
# §8.2, §8.6; docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md §3): the
# runbook applies it with kubectl at each P2 stage and deletes it with its PVCs
# and its Keeper root at the end of §3. It is indexer-b's source installation,
# storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source.yaml in k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2,
# renamed, under its own Keeper root and with 1Gi volumes, so the
# devnet2-operator reconciles exactly their shape here: the runbook proves on it
# that the engine grants and si_member reload in place, that the server bundle
# restarts the ClickHouse exactly once, that every protocol DDL form still runs
# after table_engines_require_grant, and runs the grant probe
# (charts/storage-integrity/tests/clickhouse_grant_probe.tsv) as every role.
#
# Never apply this file as it is: it carries no login and no bundle. The
# runbook's si_p2_yaml staging-p2 <stage> renders each stage from it with
# charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py's p2_staging_chi(stage, hashes):
# born locked (posture C) with the network installation's user set and Plan
# S3-C1's si_backup, each with its hash from make-p2-logins.sh staging-p2
# (Secret storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins), then that stage's engine
# grants, server bundle and si_member, with the one collection
# si_owner_staging on this installation itself. test_render.py keeps it equal
# to indexer-b's installation. No client of devnet2-si-v2 ever connects to it,
# and its collection names no live installation.
apiVersion: clickhouse.altinity.com/v1
kind: ClickHouseInstallation
metadata:
  name: storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging
  namespace: sentio-network-devnet2
spec:
  defaults:
    templates:
      podTemplate: clickhouse
      dataVolumeClaimTemplate: data-volume-claim
      logVolumeClaimTemplate: log-volume-claim
      clusterServiceTemplate: cluster-service
      replicaServiceTemplate: replica-service
    storageManagement:
      reclaimPolicy: Retain
  configuration:
    zookeeper:
      nodes:
        - host: clickhouse-keeper-extra-0.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local
          port: 2181
        - host: clickhouse-keeper-extra-1.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local
          port: 2181
        - host: clickhouse-keeper-extra-2.clickhouse.svc.cluster.local
          port: 2181
      session_timeout_ms: 100000
      operation_timeout_ms: 10000
      # Its own root on the shared ensemble: nothing here may join a replica
      # of devnet2-si-v2, whose tables live under /storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2.
      root: /storage-integrity/devnet2/p2-staging
    clusters:
      - name: source
        layout: {shardsCount: 1, replicasCount: 1}
    settings:
      logger/level: warning
      logger/console: "true"
      prometheus/endpoint: /metrics
      prometheus/port: 9363
      prometheus/metrics: true
      prometheus/events: true
      prometheus/asynchronous_metrics: true
      prometheus/status_info: true
      max_concurrent_queries: 500
      max_server_memory_usage_to_ram_ratio: "0.85"
    files:
      zz-pool-settings.xml: |
        <clickhouse>
          <background_pool_size>16</background_pool_size>
          <background_fetches_pool_size>8</background_fetches_pool_size>
        </clickhouse>
    # No login: p2_staging_chi replaces this block with posture C's users (and
    # adds posture C's users.d file and the stage's bundle under files above).
    users:
      default/password: ""
      default/networks/ip:
        - 0.0.0.0/0
      default/access_management: "1"
    profiles:
      default/query_cache_nondeterministic_function_handling: ignore
      default/enable_json_type: "1"
  templates:
    podTemplates:
      - name: clickhouse
        generateName: "{chi}-{cluster}-{host}"
        podDistribution:
          - type: ClusterAffinity
        metadata:
          annotations:
            prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
            prometheus.io/path: /metrics
            prometheus.io/port: "9363"
        spec:
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          nodeSelector:
            sentio.xyz/general: "true"
          imagePullSecrets:
            - name: google-image-secret
          containers:
            - name: clickhouse
              image: us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/sentio-352722/sentio/clickhouse-server:26.3-lts-decimal512-release-2026-09-16
              ports:
                - name: metrics
                  containerPort: 9363
              volumeMounts:
                - name: data-volume-claim
                  mountPath: /var/lib/clickhouse
              resources:
                requests:
                  cpu: "2"
                  memory: 4Gi
                limits:
                  cpu: "8"
                  memory: 16Gi
    volumeClaimTemplates:
      - name: data-volume-claim
        spec:
          accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
          storageClassName: local-path
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 1Gi
      - name: log-volume-claim
        spec:
          accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
          storageClassName: local-path
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 1Gi
    serviceTemplates:
      - name: cluster-service
        generateName: "{chi}-{cluster}"
        spec:
          ports:
            - {name: http, port: 8123}
            - {name: tcp, port: 9000}
          type: ClusterIP
      - name: replica-service
        generateName: "{chi}-{cluster}-replica-{replica}"
        spec:
          ports:
            - {name: http, port: 8123}
            - {name: tcp, port: 9000}
            - {name: interserver, port: 9009}
          type: ClusterIP
```

```python
        secrets = json.loads(secrets_file.read_text()) if secrets_file.exists() else {}
        return result, calls, secrets

    def test_p2_logins_script_keeps_the_token_apart_and_writes_only_hashes(self):
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Write the member-logins script**

Create `scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh` (mode 755; the user runs it in Task 40, never an agent):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Creates the stage 3 P2 member logins of one SI ClickHouse installation of
# devnet2-si-v2 (Plan S3-C3 contract §25.8;
# docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md §1.2). Run it in your own
# terminal (from fish too):
#
#   bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh <installation> <hashes-file>
#
# <installation> is network, indexer-b or indexer-c (an installation whose host
# runs a si-member) or staging-p2 (the P2 staging installation).
#
# For a member installation it generates the si_member password (openssl rand
# -hex 24) and the si-member's status token (openssl rand -hex 32) and stores
# each only in its own Secret (context sentio-sea, namespace
# sentio-network-devnet2):
#
#   storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>  key clickhouse-password
#   <release>-si-member-status-token               key status-token
#
# where <release> is the installation's host release (sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a
# for network, sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b, sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c): the
# token never shares the Secret that holds the password (decision D29). It
# writes the SHA-256 of the password to <hashes-file>:
#
#   passwordSha256:
#     si_member: "<64 lowercase hex>"
#
# which is what the installation's si_member takes at its member stage
# (clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_member, or si_member/password_sha256_hex
# in a CHI file). For staging-p2 it generates one password per user of the P2
# staging installation into Secret storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins
# (one key per user) and writes all seven hashes; no token.
#
# It never prints a password or a token and never passes one on a command
# line; the plaintext exists only in a mode-700 temporary directory that it
# removes on exit. It refuses to overwrite an existing Secret (either of a
# member installation's two) or hashes file: a password or token is never
# changed in place.
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

readonly context=sentio-sea
readonly namespace=sentio-network-devnet2

usage() {
  echo "usage: bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh network|indexer-b|indexer-c|staging-p2 <hashes-file>" >&2
  exit 2
}

[ "$#" -eq 2 ] || usage
installation=$1
hashes_file=$2

case "$installation" in
  network) release=sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a; users="si_member" ;;
  indexer-b|indexer-c) release="sentio-node-devnet2-$installation"; users="si_member" ;;
  # The P2 staging installation carries the network's user set, Plan S3-C1's
  # si_backup and si_member (grant probe).
  staging-p2) release=""; users="default si_snode si_gateway si_verifier si_reader si_backup si_member" ;;
  *) usage ;;
esac

# One line per Secret key: <secret> <key> <source>; source is the user whose
# password the key holds, or token for the status token.
plan() {
  if [ -n "$release" ]; then
    printf '%s %s %s\n' \
      "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$installation" clickhouse-password si_member \
      "$release-si-member-status-token" status-token token
  else
    for user in $users; do
      printf '%s %s %s\n' storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins "$user" "$user"
    done
  fi
}

kube() {
  kubectl --context "$context" --namespace "$namespace" "$@"
}

for tool in kubectl openssl shasum; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "make-p2-logins: $tool is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [ -e "$hashes_file" ]; then
  echo "make-p2-logins: $hashes_file exists; refusing to overwrite it" >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ -d "$(dirname "$hashes_file")" ] || { echo "make-p2-logins: the directory of $hashes_file does not exist" >&2; exit 1; }

secrets=$(plan | awk '{print $1}' | uniq)
for secret in $secrets; do
  found=$(kube get secret "$secret" --ignore-not-found -o name)
  if [ -n "$found" ]; then
    echo "make-p2-logins: Secret $secret exists in $namespace; refusing to overwrite it (nothing was created)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
chmod 700 "$tmp"
created=""
cleanup() {
  status=$?
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] && [ -n "$created" ]; then
    echo "make-p2-logins: failed after creating these Secrets:$created" >&2
    echo "make-p2-logins: their values are lost; delete them with kubectl --context $context --namespace $namespace delete secret$created and run the script again" >&2
  fi
  exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

for user in $users; do
  openssl rand -hex 24 | tr -d '\n' > "$tmp/$user.password"
  grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{48}$' "$tmp/$user.password" || { echo "make-p2-logins: openssl did not produce 24 random bytes" >&2; exit 1; }
  shasum -a 256 < "$tmp/$user.password" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 | tr -d '\n' > "$tmp/$user.sha256"
  grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' "$tmp/$user.sha256" || { echo "make-p2-logins: shasum did not produce a SHA-256" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [ -n "$release" ]; then
  openssl rand -hex 32 | tr -d '\n' > "$tmp/status.token"
  grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' "$tmp/status.token" || { echo "make-p2-logins: openssl did not produce 32 random bytes" >&2; exit 1; }
fi

for secret in $secrets; do
  files=()
  while read -r name key source; do
    [ "$name" = "$secret" ] || continue
    if [ "$source" = token ]; then
      files+=("--from-file=$key=$tmp/status.token")
    else
      files+=("--from-file=$key=$tmp/$source.password")
    fi
  done < <(plan)
  kube create secret generic "$secret" "${files[@]}" >/dev/null
  created="$created $secret"
  echo "created Secret $secret ($namespace)"
done

{
  echo "passwordSha256:"
  for user in $users; do
    printf '  %s: "%s"\n' "$user" "$(cat "$tmp/$user.sha256")"
  done
} > "$tmp/hashes.yaml"
(set -C; cat "$tmp/hashes.yaml" > "$hashes_file")
echo "wrote the SHA-256 of each password to $hashes_file; the passwords and the token exist only in the Secrets above"
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded local Task37 corpus proof. No pull, ports, external network or production changes.
Nominal256GiB tmpfs capacity is a capacity-reporting fixture, NOT production headroom,
persistence or performance evidence. Hard2GiB cgroup cap limits actual tiny allocations.
900s proof plus independent180s exact-name cleanup; pending explicit execution approval.
Usage: ch_probe.py WORKTREE EMPTY_WORK_DIRECTORY staging|live
"""
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import re
import secrets
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape


class ProofFailure(RuntimeError):
    pass


class BoundedDocker:
    """Only this invocation's exact random, labelled container can be removed."""
    def __init__(self, work, mode, *, run=subprocess.run, clock=time.monotonic,
                 sleep=time.sleep, token=None):
        self.work, self.run, self.clock, self.sleep = work, run, clock, sleep
        self.token = token or secrets.token_hex(12)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{24}", self.token) or mode not in ("staging", "live"):
            raise ProofFailure("invalid local proof identity")
        self.name = f"s3c3-task37-{mode}-{self.token}"
        self.label = "housegate.s3c3.task37-proof"
        self.deadline = clock() + 900
        self.attempted = False
        self.closed = False
        self.events = []
        self.env_file = None

    def event(self, op, status, **safe):
        # Never log argv, stdin, Docker stderr, XML, passwords or password hashes.
        entry = dict(at=round(self.clock(), 3), operation=op, status=status, **safe)
        self.events.append(entry)
        (self.work / "docker-events.json").write_text(json.dumps(self.events, indent=2) + "\n")

    def call(self, args, timeout, *, check=True, cleanup=False, **kwargs):
        remaining = (self.cleanup_deadline if cleanup else self.deadline) - self.clock()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise ProofFailure("local proof time budget exhausted")
        op = args[0]
        try:
            out = self.run(["docker", *args], capture_output=True, text=True,
                           timeout=min(timeout, remaining), **kwargs)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            self.event(op, "timeout")
            raise ProofFailure(f"bounded Docker {op} timed out") from None
        self.event(op, "returned", rc=out.returncode)
        if check and out.returncode:
            raise ProofFailure(f"bounded Docker {op} failed (rc={out.returncode}; private output withheld)")
        return out

    def create(self, image, env_file):
        self.env_file = env_file
        self.call(["image", "inspect", image], 30)
        # Mark the exact name before create: timeout/interrupt does not prove no object was created.
        self.attempted = True
        self.event("creation-attempt", "recorded", name=self.name)
        self.call(["create", "--pull", "never", "--name", self.name,
                   "--hostname", self.name, "--add-host", self.name + ":127.0.0.1",
                   "--label", self.label + "=" + self.token,
                   "--network", "none", "--cpus", "1", "--memory", "2g",
                   "--memory-swap", "2g", "--pids-limit", "1024",
                   "--log-driver", "json-file", "--log-opt", "max-size=2m",
                   "--log-opt", "max-file=1",
                   "--tmpfs", "/var/lib/clickhouse:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=256g",
                   "--tmpfs", "/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=256g",
                   "--tmpfs", "/var/log/clickhouse-server:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=16m",
                   "--add-host", "storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-source:127.0.0.2",
                   "--env-file", str(env_file), image], 90)

    def close(self):
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        self.cleanup_deadline = self.clock() + 180
        errors = []
        first_absent = None
        samples = 0
        try:
            if self.attempted:
                while self.clock() < self.cleanup_deadline:
                    out = self.call(["inspect", "--type", "container", self.name], 30,
                                    check=False, cleanup=True)
                    if out.returncode:
                        if not re.search(r"No such (?:object|container)", out.stderr, re.I):
                            raise ProofFailure("cleanup inspect failed without definite absence")
                        now = self.clock()
                        first_absent = now if first_absent is None else first_absent
                        samples += 1
                        self.event("absence", "confirmed", name=self.name, sample=samples)
                        if samples >= 3 and now - first_absent >= 30:
                            self.event("cleanup", "stable-absent", name=self.name, span=round(now-first_absent, 3))
                            break
                    else:
                        try:
                            data = json.loads(out.stdout)
                            if len(data) != 1:
                                raise ValueError()
                            item = data[0]
                            if (item.get("Name") != "/" + self.name or
                                item.get("Config", {}).get("Labels", {}).get(self.label) != self.token or
                                not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", item.get("Id", ""))):
                                raise ValueError()
                        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
                            raise ProofFailure("foreign or malformed object at owned name; refusing removal") from None
                        self.event("inspect-owned", "present", name=self.name, id=item["Id"],
                                   state=item.get("State", {}).get("Status", "unknown"))
                        self.call(["rm", "-f", self.name], 30, cleanup=True)
                        first_absent, samples = None, 0
                    self.sleep(min(15, max(0, self.cleanup_deadline - self.clock())))
                else:
                    raise ProofFailure("cleanup did not establish three absence samples spanning30s")
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append(str(error) if isinstance(error, ProofFailure) else "cleanup failed; private output withheld")
            self.event("cleanup", "FAILED")
        finally:
            if self.env_file is not None:
                try:
                    self.env_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                except OSError:
                    errors.append("temporary environment file removal failed")
        if errors:
            raise ProofFailure("; ".join(errors))


CURRENT = []

def interrupted(signum, frame):
    raise ProofFailure("local proof interrupted by signal")


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 4 or sys.argv[3] not in ("staging", "live"):
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    tree, work, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(), sys.argv[3]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(tree / "charts/storage-integrity/tests"))
    t = importlib.import_module("test_render")
    IMAGE = "clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3"
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    if any(work.iterdir()):
        sys.exit(f"{work} must be empty")
    docker = BoundedDocker(work, mode)
    CURRENT.append(docker)
    NAME = docker.name
    passwords = {user: secrets.token_hex(24) for user in t.P2_STAGING_USERS}
    hashes = {user: hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).hexdigest() for user, pw in passwords.items()}
    chi = t.p2_staging_chi("member", hashes, ("Memory", "MergeTree"))
    configuration = chi["spec"]["configuration"]
    collection = "si_owner_staging"
    if mode == "live":
        # A live-like installation: the staging users and bundle, its one collection
        # renamed as a live one, and no probe object at all.
        collection = "si_owner_0"
        for key in ("zz-si-named-collections.xml",):
            configuration["files"][key] = configuration["files"][key].replace("si_owner_staging", collection)
        configuration["users"]["si_member/grants/query"] = [g.replace("si_owner_staging", collection) for g in configuration["users"]["si_member/grants/query"]]


    def nest(flat):
        tree = {}
        for key, value in flat.items():
            node = tree
            parts = key.split("/")
            for part in parts[:-1]:
                node = node.setdefault(part, {})
            node[parts[-1]] = value
        return tree


    def xml(node, indent=2):
        out = []
        for key, value in node.items():
            pad = " " * indent
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                out.append(f"{pad}<{key}>")
                out.extend(xml(value, indent + 2))
                out.append(f"{pad}</{key}>")
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    out.append(f"{pad}<{key}>{escape(str(item))}</{key}>")
            else:
                out.append(f"{pad}<{key}>{escape(str(value))}</{key}>")
        return out


    users = nest(configuration["users"])
    lines = ["<clickhouse>", "  <users>"]
    for user, body in users.items():
        lines.append(f"    <{user}>")
        if user == "default":
            lines.append('      <password remove="remove"/>')
        for key, value in body.items():
            if key == "networks":
                lines.append('      <networks replace="replace">')
                lines.extend(xml(value, 8))
                lines.append("      </networks>")
            elif key == "grants":
                lines.append("      <grants>")
                lines.extend(xml(value, 8))
                lines.append("      </grants>")
            else:
                lines.extend(xml({key: value}, 6))
        lines.append(f"    </{user}>")
    lines += ["  </users>", "  <profiles>"]
    for profile, body in nest(configuration["profiles"]).items():
        lines.append(f"    <{profile}>")
        lines.extend(xml(body, 6))
        lines.append(f"    </{profile}>")
    lines += ["  </profiles>", "</clickhouse>"]
    config_dir, users_dir = work / "config.d", work / "users.d"
    for directory in (config_dir, users_dir):
        directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for old in directory.iterdir():
            old.unlink()
    (users_dir / "chi-users.xml").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    for name, text in configuration["files"].items():
        target = users_dir / name.split("/", 1)[1] if name.startswith("users.d/") else config_dir / name
        target.write_text(text)
    root = configuration["zookeeper"]["root"]
    (config_dir / "keeper.xml").write_text(f"""<clickhouse>
      <keeper_server>
        <tcp_port>9181</tcp_port>
        <server_id>1</server_id>
        <log_storage_path>/tmp/task37-keeper/log</log_storage_path>
        <snapshot_storage_path>/tmp/task37-keeper/snapshots</snapshot_storage_path>
        <raft_configuration><server><id>1</id><hostname>127.0.0.1</hostname><port>9234</port></server></raft_configuration>
      </keeper_server>
      <zookeeper>
        <node><host>127.0.0.1</host><port>9181</port></node>
        <root>{root}</root>
      </zookeeper>
      <listen_host>0.0.0.0</listen_host>
    </clickhouse>
    """)
    # The throwaway reader password reaches the container through an env file of
    # mode 600 in the work directory, never on a command line.
    env_file = work / "container.env"
    docker.env_file = env_file
    env_file.touch(mode=0o600)
    env_file.write_text("CLICKHOUSE_SKIP_USER_SETUP=1\n" + "".join(
        f"{item['name']}={passwords['si_reader']}\n" for item in t.p2_password_env(t.P2_STAGING_CHI_NAME)
    ))
    docker.create(IMAGE, env_file)
    for path in config_dir.iterdir():
        docker.call(["cp", str(path), f"{NAME}:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/"], 30)
    for path in users_dir.iterdir():
        docker.call(["cp", str(path), f"{NAME}:/etc/clickhouse-server/users.d/"], 30)
    docker.call(["start", NAME], 90)


    def ch(user, sql):
        """One statement as user; the password goes to the client on stdin, never on argv."""
        # The exact gateway raw-REMOTE positive row binds an authenticated
        # existing si_reader target; the corpus/log line remains its public
        # logical statement, never the generated credential-bearing SQL.
        secret_query = False
        if user == "si_gateway" and sql == "SELECT count() FROM remote('127.0.0.2:9000', system.one)":
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{48}", passwords["si_reader"]):
                raise ProofFailure("reader probe credential shape invalid")
            secret_query = True
            sql = ("SELECT name FROM remote('127.0.0.2:9000', 'system', 'parts', 'si_reader', '"
                   + passwords["si_reader"] + "') LIMIT 1")
        command = ["docker", "exec", "-i", NAME, "sh", "-c",
                   'IFS= read -r p; shift; CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD="$p" exec clickhouse-client "$@"', "sh", "client", "--user", user]
        if secret_query:
            command.extend(["--log_queries", "0"])
        command.extend(["--queries-file", "/dev/stdin"])
        out = docker.call(command[1:], 60, check=False, input=passwords[user] + "\n" + sql + "\n")
        text = out.stdout if out.returncode == 0 else out.stdout + out.stderr
        for private in [*passwords.values(), *hashes.values()]:
            text = text.replace(private, "<redacted>")
        return out.returncode, text


    for _ in range(60):
        if ch("default", "SELECT 1")[0] == 0:
            break
        time.sleep(1)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("local ClickHouse did not become ready")
    keeper = ["docker", "exec", NAME, "clickhouse", "keeper-client", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "9181", "-q"]
    path = ""
    for part in (root + "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc").strip("/").split("/"):
        path += "/" + part
        # keeper-client 26.3 refuses create with an empty value (syntax error); touch makes an empty znode.
        docker.call(keeper[1:] + [f"touch '{path}'"], 60)
    # ClickHouse reads the Keeper root only at start: restart once the root exists.
    docker.call(["restart", NAME], 90)
    for _ in range(60):
        if ch("default", "SELECT count() FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/'")[0] == 0:
            break
        time.sleep(1)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("local ClickHouse Keeper root did not become ready")
    print(json.dumps({
        "version": ch("default", "SELECT version()")[1].strip(),
        "disks": ch("default", "SELECT name, path, keep_free_space FROM system.disks FORMAT TSV")[1].strip(),
        "setting": ch("default", "SELECT value FROM system.replicated_merge_tree_settings WHERE name = 'max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool'")[1].strip(),
        "collections": ch("default", "SELECT name FROM system.named_collections FORMAT TSV")[1].strip(),
        "keeper": ch("default", f"SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/sentio/0'")[1].strip(),
    }))


    # A different loopback alias alone does not establish remote reader identity.
    # These controls must fail if remote() takes the default caller's privileged local shortcut.
    def require_control(user, sql, expected):
        rc, detail = ch(user, sql)
        code = re.search(r"Code: ([0-9]+)\.", detail)
        if expected == "ok":
            if rc != 0:
                override = re.search(r"Override not allowed for \W*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)", detail)
                raise ProofFailure("local metadata/identity positive control failed (rc=" + str(rc) + ", code=" + (code.group(1) if code else "unknown") + ", override_key=" + (override.group(1) if override else "none") + ")")
        elif rc == 0 or code is None or code.group(1) != expected:
            raise ProofFailure("remote reader/readonly negative control failed; local shortcut or unknown failure")

    version_rc, version_text = ch("default", "SELECT version()")
    if version_rc or version_text.strip() != "26.3.37.3":
        raise ProofFailure("cached runtime version is not exactly26.3.37.3")
    reader_rc, reader_identity = ch("si_reader", "SELECT currentUser()")
    if reader_rc or reader_identity.strip() != "si_reader":
        raise ProofFailure("direct reader identity positive control failed")
    require_control("default", "SELECT bytes_on_disk FROM system.parts LIMIT 0", "ok")
    require_control("si_reader", "SHOW COLUMNS FROM system.parts", "ok")
    require_control("si_reader", "SELECT bytes_on_disk FROM system.parts LIMIT 0", "497")
    require_control("default", f"SELECT database, table, name, active, rows, partition_id, hash_of_all_files FROM remote({collection}, database = 'system', table = 'parts') LIMIT 0", "ok")
    require_control("default", f"SELECT bytes_on_disk FROM remote({collection}, database = 'system', table = 'parts') LIMIT 0", "497")
    # The corpus supplies its exact remote-write refusal rows unchanged below.
    print("reader metadata and effective remote-identity controls passed; actual remote currentUser proof remains separately required")
    # Check Task39's exact independent admin schema without printing potentially sensitive rows.
    admin_query = "SELECT user_name, access_type, access_object, database, table, column, is_partial_revoke, grant_option FROM system.grants WHERE startsWith(user_name, 'si_') ORDER BY user_name, access_type, database, table, column FORMAT JSONEachRow"
    rc, detail = ch("default", admin_query)
    if rc:
        raise ProofFailure("eight-column admin grants query failed")
    fields = ("user_name", "access_type", "access_object", "database", "table", "column", "is_partial_revoke", "grant_option")
    admin_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in detail.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not admin_rows:
        raise ProofFailure("empty admin grants schema proof")
    for row in admin_rows:
        if set(row) != set(fields) or any(not isinstance(row[k], str) for k in fields[:3]):
            raise ProofFailure("admin grants string/column shape mismatch")
        if any(row[k] is not None and not isinstance(row[k], str) for k in ("database", "table", "column")):
            raise ProofFailure("admin grants nullable-column shape mismatch")
        if any(type(row[k]) is not int or row[k] not in (0, 1) for k in ("is_partial_revoke", "grant_option")):
            raise ProofFailure("admin grants flag shape mismatch")
    print("eight-column admin grants schema controls passed")


    # Reviewer-only setup: keep the corpus SQL/expectations unchanged, but give
    # its SYSTEM DROP REPLICA positive rows a real replicated-table metadata path.
    # Its dropped replica name is deliberately absent; this live fixture replica
    # must remain attached until the corpus finishes.
    if mode == "staging":
        rc, detail = ch("default", "CREATE TABLE default.si_grant_probe_keeper (v UInt8) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/si_grant_probe', 's3c3_fixture_live') ORDER BY v")
        if rc:
            raise ProofFailure("replicated grant-probe metadata setup failed")


    def outcome(role, statement):
        rc, text = ch(role, statement)
        if rc == 0:
            return "ok", "0", ""
        code = re.search(r"Code: ([0-9]+)\.", text)
        code = code.group(1) if code else "?"
        message = re.findall(r"DB::Exception: ([^(]*)", text)
        message = message[-1].strip() if message else text.strip()[:160]
        if code == "497" and "Received from 127.0.0.2" not in text:
            return "denied", code, message
        if code == "36" and "Override not allowed for" in text:
            return "override", code, message
        if role == "default":
            return "error", code, message
        if code == "499" and ("s3(" in statement or "TO S3(" in statement):
            return "ok", code, message
        return "error", code, message


    bad = 0
    rows = []
    if mode == "staging":
        for role, expect, statement in t.grant_probe_rows():
            if role not in t.P2_STAGING_USERS:
                continue
            rows.append((role, expect, statement))
    else:
        for database in ("hg_rstage", "hg_replica"):
            rc, detail = ch("si_member", f"CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS {database}")
            if rc:
                raise RuntimeError(f"live-probe database setup failed: {detail}")
        for line in t.MEMBER_LIVE_PROBE.read_text().splitlines()[1:]:
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith("expect\t"):
                continue
            expect, statement = line.split("\t")
            rows.append(("si_member", expect, statement.replace("@@COLLECTION@@", collection)))
    for role, expect, statement in rows:
        got, code, message = outcome(role, statement)
        flag = "" if got == expect else "MISMATCH"
        bad += bool(flag)
        print(f"{flag}\t{role}\t{expect}\t{got}\t{code}\t{statement[:120]}\t{message[:200]}")
    print(f"{len(rows)} rows, {bad} mismatches")
    if mode == "live":
        print("tables left in hg_rstage and hg_replica:", ch("default", "SELECT database, name FROM system.tables WHERE database IN ('hg_rstage', 'hg_replica') FORMAT TSV")[1].strip() or "none")
        print("znodes under the root:", ch("default", "SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/' ORDER BY name FORMAT TSV")[1].strip().replace("\n", ","))
    # Prove the fixture stayed tiny; nominal tmpfs size is not allocated RAM.
    footprint = docker.call(["exec", NAME, "du", "-skc", "/var/lib/clickhouse", "/tmp/task37-keeper"], 30)
    try:
        kib = int(footprint.stdout.splitlines()[-1].split()[0])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        raise ProofFailure("missing actual fixture allocation measurement") from None
    if not 0 <= kib <= 262144:
        raise ProofFailure("fixture exceeded256MiB tiny-data allocation bound")
    print(json.dumps({"fixture_actual_kib": kib, "nominal_tmpfs_gib_each": 256, "hard_memory_gib": 2,
                      "production_headroom_equivalence": False}))
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, interrupted)
    signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 900)
    result = 1
    try:
        result = main()
    except BaseException as error:
        # Never dump a traceback/subprocess payload containing generated credentials.
        print(str(error) if isinstance(error, ProofFailure) else
              "local proof failed (" + type(error).__name__ + "; private details withheld)", file=sys.stderr)
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        for supervisor in CURRENT:
            try:
                supervisor.close()
            except BaseException:
                print("local proof cleanup FAILED; inspect own docker-events.json", file=sys.stderr)
                result = 1
    sys.exit(result)
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Replay Task 40's stage commits and their rollback on a scratch copy**

Write `$HOME/.cache/s3c3-task37/replay_p2.py` with the Write tool:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay Plan S3-C3 Task 40's nine single-service P2 stage commits, and the
rollback of the last one, on a scratch copy of a production worktree, running
test_render.py after each (Plan S3-C3 Task 37; never a real checkout).

usage: python3 -I replay_p2.py <worktree> <empty scratch directory>

The copy holds the worktree's tracked and untracked files (uncommitted changes
included), except the two prohibited ClickHouse files, in a fresh git repository
of its own. Each step is what the runbook's
si_p2_yaml writes: test_render.py's p2_manifest_text for indexer-b's and
indexer-c's installations, p2_overlay_text for the network's, and the mirror
DEVNET2_P2_STAGE (DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES with the first engines step). The
census set and the si_member hashes are stand-ins. Prints one line per step and
exits 1 at the first step whose suite fails.
"""
import hashlib
import importlib
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

STEPS = [(installation, stage) for stage in ("engines", "restarted", "member") for installation in ("indexer-b", "indexer-c", "network")]
STEPS.append(("network", "restarted"))
CHIS = {"network": "storage-integrity-si-v2", "indexer-b": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "indexer-c": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c"}
CENSUS = ("Memory", "MergeTree", "ReplacingMergeTree")


def step(tree, installation, stage):
    """One stage commit's file changes (run in a fresh process per step)."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(tree / "charts/storage-integrity/tests"))
    t = importlib.import_module("test_render")
    chi = CHIS[installation]
    member_hash = hashlib.sha256(f"replay-p2-{installation}-si_member".encode()).hexdigest() if stage == "member" else None
    tests = tree / "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
    text = tests.read_text()
    gateway = t.DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES
    if gateway is None:
        gateway = CENSUS
        assert text.count("DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES = None\n") == 1
        text = text.replace("DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES = None\n", f"DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES = {CENSUS!r}\n")
    start = text.index("\nDEVNET2_P2_STAGE = {\n")
    end = text.index("\n}\n", start) + 1
    old = f'    "{chi}": "{t.DEVNET2_P2_STAGE[chi]}",\n'
    assert text[start:end].count(old) == 1, old
    text = text[:start] + text[start:end].replace(old, f'    "{chi}": "{stage}",\n') + text[end:]
    tests.write_text(text)
    if installation == "network":
        path = tree / "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
        path.write_text(t.p2_overlay_text(path.read_text(), stage, member_hash, gateway))
    else:
        path = tree / f"k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-{installation}-source.yaml"
        path.write_text(t.p2_manifest_text(path.read_text(), chi, stage, member_hash, gateway))


def git(tree, *args):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(tree), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) == 5 and sys.argv[1] == "--step":
        step(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4])
        return
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    worktree, scratch = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
    if not scratch.is_dir() or any(scratch.iterdir()):
        sys.exit(f"{scratch} must be an empty directory")
    tree = scratch / "tree"
    tree.mkdir()
    files = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(worktree), "ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z"],
                           check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
    # These two production files contain forbidden commented credentials. Exclude
    # their paths before tar reads any file, including in a real executor's tree.
    forbidden = {b"k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse.yaml", b"k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse-extra.yaml"}
    files = b"".join(path + b"\0" for path in files.split(b"\0") if path and path not in forbidden)
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-C", str(worktree), "--null", "-T", "-", "-cf", str(scratch / "tree.tar")], input=files, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-C", str(tree), "-xf", str(scratch / "tree.tar")], check=True)
    git(tree, "init", "-q")
    # Synthetic scratch-only commits must not invoke the user's real signing key.
    git(tree, "config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
    git(tree, "add", "-A")
    git(tree, "-c", "user.email=replay@localhost", "-c", "user.name=replay", "commit", "-qm", "Task 37")
    for installation, stage in STEPS:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", __file__, "--step", str(tree), installation, stage], check=True)
        git(tree, "add", "-A")
        git(tree, "-c", "user.email=replay@localhost", "-c", "user.name=replay", "commit", "-qm", f"{installation} {stage}")
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"], cwd=tree, capture_output=True, text=True)
        summary = [line for line in result.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(("Ran ", "OK", "FAILED"))]
        print(f"{installation} {stage}: {' '.join(summary)}")
        if result.returncode:
            print(result.stderr[-4000:])
            sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Notes:
- **Inert on merge.** `siMember` is a new top-level block that no host template reads, so the host pod's `checksum/config` (`templates/node.yaml` names its four keys) never sees it; every overlay sets `enabled: false`; `monitoring.members` lists nothing on devnet2, and the members scrape and rule group render only with listed releases.
- **No remote or live action.** This task pushes nothing, opens no PR and runs no `helmfile sync`, `kubectl` or registry write; the network reads are Step 1's housegate fetch and image digest lookup, and Step 7's released-source clone / module resolution for strict-loader validation; all are read-only and use fresh scratch for source validation. Task 39 pushes the branch and opens `P2_PR`, each only after explicit user confirmation in chat; the single-service commits that start the members (`siMember.enabled: true` with the measured `disk_budget_bytes`, `DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED`) and list them for monitoring (`DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS`, `DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS`) are Task 41's, after `P2_PR` merged and Task 40 brought every installation to its `member` stage, each confirmed in chat too.
- **Ledger values** enter `test_render.py`, the three overlays and the §1.2 ledger only through `sed` from the recorded Appendix C values (Steps 2 and 5); every block that needs them refuses to run without them, and Step 1 stops if one is not recorded. Never type a value in.
- **Why the member is its own StatefulSet.** A container in the host pod would restart the SNode on every member change through the host's `checksum/config` (Plan S3-C2 K30): the member's ConfigMap, checksum, image, resources and volume belong to its own pod, whose `nodeSelector` is `siMember.nodeSelector` and never the host's node pin. The ConfigMap renders `siMember.config` key by key with each value as JSON (in sorted key order, nulls left out), because Helm's `toYaml` writes the genesis snapshot id `0x6370…` unquoted, which a YAML 1.1 reader takes for an integer; sentio-node's yaml.v3 decoder reads JSON values as written.
- **Readiness.** The `si-member` container is Ready once it answers `GET /metrics` on port `metrics`, so `kubectl rollout status` of `<release>-si-member` (Task 41) returns once the process runs, while the member may still be copying; its bootstrap is `GET /readyz` (200 once the startup audit is clean and every peer's copies reached a manifest, Plan S3-C2 §24.3), which runbook §9 reads, and `sentio_node_si_member_ready` exports the same state. Plan S3-C4's serving endpoint on port `status` decides by its own state and is reached through the same Service.
- **Why the rules look like this.** As Plan S3-B's (Task 13 notes): the member scrape adds `network`, `si_component=member`, `release` and `member` by `relabelConfigs`; the si-member pods carry no `prometheus.io` annotation, so nothing else scrapes them; every member expression selects `network="<network>"` and `si_component="member"`, the disk expression the namespace and the listed installations; every `by()` keeps `cluster`; every alert carries `severity`, `network`, `summary` and a `runbook_url` into the P2 members runbook. Contract §26.6's expressions are written with those conventions (`max by (cluster, network, release, member, owner)` around the contract's terms). On the network installation the `member` disk exists on the verifier ClickHouses too (K43), so `StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh` also watches their data filesystems. `MonitoringTest.MONITORED` stays as Plans S3-B and S3-C1 left it: the member tests list the probe members on top of it (`members_monitored`), so no earlier test changes its expectations.
- **Not verified by this task.** The member series exist only once a member runs `SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2`, and `ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_member` / `..._DiskTotal_member` only once its installation restarted with the `member` disk (Task 40); runbook §8.4 (Task 41) reads every member alert's series in vmui before listing the members. `helm lint` evaluates no `fail` (it logs them), so the guards are proven by `test_render.py` alone.
- **Later tasks edit the same files** (Global Constraints): apply each hunk below by its quoted anchor on top of Plans S3-B and S3-C1 and Task 37. Task 39 adds the runbook's own paths to the workflow. Task 41 flips each overlay's `siMember.enabled`, sets its `disk_budget_bytes` (its `p2m-edit.py` edits exactly the lines `  enabled: false` and `    disk_budget_bytes: 0` of the `siMember` block and the `DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED` entry), and then fills `monitoring.members` (the lines `    releases: []` and `    installations: []`) with its mirrors `DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS` and `DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS`. Plan S3-C4 adds `siMember.serve` and the host's `replicaReads` on top of this template; Plan S3-F replaces the reconciler refusal with its container.
- **The tests hold through the rollout.** `SIMemberTest` renders every devnet2 SI host release with a complete member block built from the reviewed host/genesis definitions and constants (`member_values`), whatever its overlay sets, and with the member off; the `ActualFreshNetworkTest` tests read the overlays and their mirrors, so each of Task 41's commits keeps them green: a member may be on only in the order `member-b`, `member-c`, `member-a`, only once its installation's `DEVNET2_P2_STAGE` is `member`, and only with a positive `disk_budget_bytes`, and the members are monitored all three at once.
- **Verification boundary.** Historical scratch counts are not the current acceptance proof. Review on the current sanitized production chain must consume the actual C2 loader and full Task 37 predecessor, and record observed results. C2's final integration proof and Task 37's real ClickHouse grant proof are prerequisites: chart-only candidate checks cannot waive them. Synthetic image/indexer inputs used in a local review are fixtures, never ledger outcomes.

The local input helper below reads those same ledger copies, validates the exact key set and registry digest, and exclusively persists public values. Every later Bash call sources that file; never manually paste a value or silently reuse another attempt.

Write `$HOME/.cache/s3c3-task38/inputs38.py` with the Write tool from this exact local-only code (never commit it):

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read Task38's public inputs from authoritative ledger copies; never overwrite."""
import ast, os, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
h, w, out = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3])
def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(args, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode: sys.exit('input command failed; retain evidence and stop')
    return p.stdout
raw = run([sys.executable, '-I', str(Path.home()/'.cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py'), 'get', str(h), 'SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2', 'SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2', 'INDEXER_C_ID'])
rows = raw.splitlines()
if len(rows) != 3 or any('=' not in row for row in rows): sys.exit('missing/malformed ledger inputs; stop')
values = dict(row.split('=', 1) for row in rows)
if set(values) != {'SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2','SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2','INDEXER_C_ID'}: sys.exit('unexpected or duplicate ledger input; stop')
for key, pattern in [('SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2',r'[0-9a-f]{40}'), ('SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2',r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}'), ('INDEXER_C_ID',r'[1-9][0-9]*')]:
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern, values[key]): sys.exit('unrecorded or malformed '+key+'; stop')
if int(values['INDEXER_C_ID']) < 2: sys.exit('INDEXER_C_ID belongs to another owner; stop')
registry = run(['docker','buildx','imagetools','inspect','ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-'+values['SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2']])
if re.findall(r'^Digest:\s*(sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})\s*$',registry,re.M) != [values['SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2']]: sys.exit('registry index digest differs from released ledger image; stop')
module = ast.parse((w/'charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py').read_text())
def constant(key):
    nodes=[n.value for n in module.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id==key for t in n.targets)]
    if len(nodes)!=1: sys.exit('missing/duplicate '+key+'; stop')
    return ast.literal_eval(nodes[0])
ids=constant('DEVNET2_SNODE_IDS'); owners=constant('DEVNET2_BACKUP_OWNERS')
name='sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c';node=ids[name]
if node!='snode-3' or owners.get(name)!=int(values['INDEXER_C_ID']): sys.exit('actual source allocation or backup-owner ledger differs; stop')
text=(w/'docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md').read_text()
a=text.index('### 1.2 Identities');b=text.index('### 1.3 ',a);section=text[a:b]
if len(re.findall(r'^\| `'+re.escape(node)+r'` \| '+values['INDEXER_C_ID']+r' \(indexer-c\) \|[^\n]+$',section,re.M))!=1: sys.exit('Task21 observed enrollment row is absent or different; stop')
if 'Next free id: `snode-4`.' not in section: sys.exit('SNode allocation changed; stop for reconciliation')
out.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fd=os.open(out,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:
    for key in ('SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2','SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2','INDEXER_C_ID'): f.write(key+'='+values[key]+'\n')
print('Task38 inputs validated and exclusively persisted; no ledger written')
```

```python
def si_release(name):
    """One charts/sentio-node release of FRESH_HELMFILE, as the helmfile declares it."""
    (release,) = [release for release in yaml.safe_load(FRESH_HELMFILE.read_text())["releases"] if release["name"] == name]
    return release


def si_release_values(name, *overrides):
    """The statically merged values of one FRESH_HELMFILE sentio-node release, overrides merged last."""
    values = release_chart_values(FRESH_HELMFILE, si_release(name), f"{FRESH_HELMFILE.relative_to(ROOT)}:{name}")[0]
    for override in overrides:
        merge_values(values, copy.deepcopy(override))
    return values


def render_si_release(name, *overrides):
    """helm template of one FRESH_HELMFILE sentio-node release with its values
    files, its --set-file entries and overrides merged last."""
    release = si_release(name)
    command = [
        "helm", "template", name, str((FRESH_HELMFILE.parent / release["chart"]).resolve()),
        "--namespace", release["namespace"],
    ]
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        for index, entry in enumerate(list(release["values"]) + list(overrides)):
            if isinstance(entry, str):
                path = FRESH_HELMFILE.parent / entry
            else:
                path = Path(directory) / f"values-{index}.yaml"
                path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(entry))
            command += ["-f", str(path)]
        for item in release.get("set", []):
            command += ["--set-file", f'{item["name"]}={FRESH_HELMFILE.parent / item["file"]}']
        return subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


def member_values(name, budget=107374182400):
    """A complete, enabled siMember block for one devnet2 SI host release, built
    from the reviewed host and full genesis definitions (contract §26.5), independent
    of that overlay's siMember enabled/config block."""
    host = si_release_values(name)["storageIntegrity"]
    suffix = name.rsplit("-", 1)[1]
    installation = "network" if suffix == "a" else f"indexer-{suffix}"
    own = DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name]
    genesis = arbiter_config(documents(render_si_release(FRESH_RELEASE)), FRESH_RELEASE)["tables"]
    return {"siMember": {
        "enabled": True,
        "image": DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE,
        "nodeID": DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name],
        "clickhouseDSN": host["clickhouseDSN"],
        "secret": {"name": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-member-{installation}"},
        "statusTokenSecret": {"name": f"{name}-si-member-status-token"},
        "restoreSecret": {"name": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-{suffix}"},
        "config": {
            "host_indexer_id": own,
            "genesis_snapshot_id": host["snode"]["genesisSnapshotID"],
            "genesis_tables": copy.deepcopy(genesis),
            "storage_policy": "member",
            "peers": [
                {"indexer_id": indexer, "collection": f"si_owner_{indexer}"}
                for indexer in sorted(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS.values()) if indexer != own
            ],
            "pool_collections": ["si_peer_verifier_1", "si_peer_verifier_2", "si_peer_verifier_3"],
            "restore": {"endpoint": "https://storage.googleapis.com", "bucket": SI_BACKUP_BUCKET},
            "shadow_verification": True,
            "stop_installs_ratio": 0.5,
            "disk_budget_bytes": budget,
        },
    }}


def member_on(budget=107374182400):
    """A release's own siMember values turned on, with a disk budget."""
    return {"siMember": {"enabled": True, "config": {"disk_budget_bytes": budget}}}


def si_member_objects(docs):
    """The si-member objects one sentio-node release renders."""
    return {key: doc for key, doc in docs.items() if key[1].endswith(("-si-member", "-si-member-config"))}


def si_member_config(docs):
    """The si-member.yaml one sentio-node release renders, parsed."""
    (config_map,) = [
        doc for (kind, name), doc in docs.items() if kind == "ConfigMap" and name.endswith("-si-member-config")
    ]
    return yaml.safe_load(config_map["data"]["si-member.yaml"])
```
