```python
class SIMemberTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """Plan S3-C3 contract §26.1-§26.3: the si-member of a devnet2 SI host, its
    own StatefulSet beside the host pod (Plan S3-C2 K30)."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.off = {name: documents(render_si_release(name, {"siMember": {"enabled": False}})) for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES}
        cls.on = {name: documents(render_si_release(name, member_values(name))) for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES}

    def assert_rejected(self, result, error):
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, "the chart rendered")
        self.assertIn(error, result.stderr)

    def test_default_renders_no_si_member(self):
        self.assertEqual(yaml.safe_load((SENTIO_NODE_CHART / "values.yaml").read_text())["siMember"], {
            "enabled": False, "image": "", "nodeID": "", "clickhouseDSN": "", "clickhouseUsername": "si_member",
            "secret": {"name": "", "passwordKey": "clickhouse-password"},
            "statusTokenSecret": {"name": "", "key": "status-token"},
            "restoreSecret": {"name": "", "accessKeyIDKey": "access-id", "secretAccessKeyKey": "secret"},
            "config": {}, "stateSize": "1Gi", "storageClassName": "local-path",
            "resources": {"requests": {"cpu": "250m", "memory": "512Mi"}, "limits": {"cpu": "2", "memory": "2Gi"}},
            "nodeSelector": {"sentio.xyz/general": "true"}, "metricsPort": 9095, "statusPort": 9096,
            "reconciler": {"enabled": False},
        })
        self.assertEqual(si_member_objects(documents(render_sentio_node())), {})
        for name, docs in self.off.items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                # Off, the member's values are only values: nothing renders them.
                self.assertEqual(si_member_objects(docs), {})
                self.assertEqual([
                    key for key, doc in docs.items()
                    if doc["metadata"].get("labels", {}).get("app.kubernetes.io/component") == "si-member"
                ], [])

    def test_si_member_is_its_own_statefulset_with_its_own_config_and_checksum(self):
        for name, docs in self.on.items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                member = si_release_values(name, member_values(name))["siMember"]
                labels = {
                    "app.kubernetes.io/name": f"{name}-si-member",
                    "app.kubernetes.io/instance": name,
                    "app.kubernetes.io/component": "si-member",
                    "storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id": DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name],
                }
                self.assertEqual(set(si_member_objects(docs)), {
                    ("ConfigMap", f"{name}-si-member-config"), ("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member"), ("Service", f"{name}-si-member"),
                })
                config_map = docs[("ConfigMap", f"{name}-si-member-config")]
                self.assertEqual(list(config_map["data"]), ["si-member.yaml"])
                spec = docs[("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member")]["spec"]
                self.assertEqual((spec["replicas"], spec["serviceName"]), (1, f"{name}-si-member"))
                self.assertEqual(spec["selector"], {"matchLabels": labels})
                pod = spec["template"]
                self.assertEqual(pod["metadata"]["labels"], labels)
                # checksum/si-member-config is the hash of the rendered si-member.yaml alone.
                self.assertEqual(pod["metadata"]["annotations"], {
                    "checksum/si-member-config": hashlib.sha256(config_map["data"]["si-member.yaml"].encode()).hexdigest(),
                })
                # siMember.nodeSelector, never the host pod's node pin.
                self.assertEqual(pod["spec"]["nodeSelector"], {"sentio.xyz/general": "true"})
                self.assertNotEqual(pod["spec"]["nodeSelector"], docs[("StatefulSet", name)]["spec"]["template"]["spec"].get("nodeSelector"))
                self.assertIs(pod["spec"]["automountServiceAccountToken"], False)
                self.assertNotIn("initContainers", pod["spec"])
                (container,) = pod["spec"]["containers"]
                self.assertEqual((container["name"], container["image"]), ("si-member", member["image"]))
                self.assertEqual((container["command"], container["args"]), (["/sentio-node"], ["si-member", "--config-path", "/config/si-member.yaml"]))
                self.assertEqual(container["ports"], [
                    {"name": "metrics", "containerPort": 9095, "protocol": "TCP"},
                    {"name": "status", "containerPort": 9096, "protocol": "TCP"},
                ])
                # Ready once it serves /metrics; /readyz (the bootstrap) is runbook §9's.
                self.assertEqual(container["readinessProbe"], {
                    "httpGet": {"path": "/metrics", "port": "metrics"}, "periodSeconds": 10, "failureThreshold": 3,
                })
                self.assertEqual(container["resources"], {"requests": {"cpu": "250m", "memory": "512Mi"}, "limits": {"cpu": "2", "memory": "2Gi"}})
                self.assertEqual(container["volumeMounts"], [
                    {"name": "config", "mountPath": "/config", "readOnly": True},
                    {"name": "si-member-state", "mountPath": "/data/si-member"},
                ])
                self.assertEqual(pod["spec"]["volumes"], [{"name": "config", "configMap": {"name": f"{name}-si-member-config"}}])
                self.assertEqual(spec["volumeClaimTemplates"], [{
                    "metadata": {"name": "si-member-state"},
                    "spec": {"accessModes": ["ReadWriteOnce"], "storageClassName": "local-path", "resources": {"requests": {"storage": "1Gi"}}},
                }])
                service = docs[("Service", f"{name}-si-member")]
                self.assertLessEqual(labels.items(), service["metadata"]["labels"].items())
                self.assertEqual(service["spec"], {
                    "type": "ClusterIP",
                    "ports": [
                        {"name": "metrics", "port": 9095, "targetPort": "metrics", "protocol": "TCP"},
                        {"name": "status", "port": 9096, "targetPort": "status", "protocol": "TCP"},
                    ],
                    "selector": labels,
                })
                # The config: the host's arbiter peers, DA address and network
                # id, the keys the chart sets, then siMember.config as written.
                host = host_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]
                self.assertEqual(si_member_config(docs), {"storage_integrity": {
                    "arbiter_peers": host["arbiter_peers"],
                    "payload_store_data_addr": host["payload_store_data_addr"],
                    "member": {
                        "node_id": DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name],
                        "state_dir": "/data/si-member",
                        "network_id": host["snode"]["network_id"],
                        "clickhouse_dsn": member["clickhouseDSN"],
                        "clickhouse_username": "si_member",
                        "metrics_listen": ":9095",
                        **member["config"],
                    },
                }})
                # A config change rolls the member, through its own checksum.
                tuned = documents(render_si_release(name, member_values(name), {"siMember": {"config": {"poll_interval": "10s"}}}))
                self.assertEqual(si_member_config(tuned)["storage_integrity"]["member"]["poll_interval"], "10s")
                self.assertNotEqual(
                    tuned[("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member")]["spec"]["template"]["metadata"]["annotations"],
                    pod["metadata"]["annotations"],
                )

    def test_si_member_changes_never_restart_the_host_pod(self):
        # Starting, re-pinning, reconfiguring or resizing a member, or removing
        # it again, adds or removes only the member's three objects: the host
        # StatefulSet, its checksum/config and every other object stay
        # byte-identical, so the host pod keeps its UID and restart count.
        node = (SENTIO_NODE_CHART / "templates/node.yaml").read_text()
        (checksum,) = [line for line in node.splitlines() if "checksum/config:" in line and "storageIntegrity" in line]
        self.assertNotIn("siMember", checksum)
        repinned = {"siMember": {"image": "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-" + "1" * 40 + "@sha256:" + "2" * 64}}
        tuned = {"siMember": {
            "config": {"poll_interval": "10s", "self_audit_interval": "12h"},
            "resources": {"limits": {"memory": "3Gi"}},
            "stateSize": "2Gi",
        }}
        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            base = self.off[name]
            for change, docs in (
                ("start", self.on[name]),
                ("re-pin", documents(render_si_release(name, member_values(name), repinned))),
                ("reconfigure", documents(render_si_release(name, member_values(name), tuned))),
            ):
                with self.subTest(release=name, change=change):
                    self.assertEqual(set(docs) - set(base), set(si_member_objects(docs)))
                    self.assertEqual(len(si_member_objects(docs)), 3)
                    self.assertEqual(set(base) - set(docs), set())
                    for key, resource in base.items():
                        self.assertEqual(docs[key], resource, key)

    def test_si_member_password_and_status_token_come_only_from_their_own_secrets(self):
        for name, docs in self.on.items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                member = si_release_values(name, member_values(name))["siMember"]
                password = member["secret"]["name"]
                token = member["statusTokenSecret"]["name"]
                restore = member["restoreSecret"]["name"]
                # Decision D29: the token has its own Secret, never the password's.
                self.assertEqual(token, f"{name}-si-member-status-token")
                self.assertEqual(len({password, token, restore}), 3)
                statefulset = docs[("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member")]
                (container,) = statefulset["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"]
                self.assertEqual(container["env"], [
                    {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": password, "key": "clickhouse-password"}}},
                    {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": token, "key": "status-token"}}},
                    {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": restore, "key": "access-id"}}},
                    {"name": "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET", "valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": {"name": restore, "key": "secret"}}},
                ])
                self.assertEqual(secret_references(statefulset), {password, token, restore})
                # Neither the host pod nor any other object of the release names
                # them, the chart creates no Secret, and the config file holds none.
                for key, resource in docs.items():
                    if key != ("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member"):
                        self.assertEqual(secret_references(resource) & {password, token, restore}, set(), key)
                self.assertEqual([key for key in si_member_objects(docs) if key[0] == "Secret"], [])
                text = docs[("ConfigMap", f"{name}-si-member-config")]["data"]["si-member.yaml"]
                self.assertIsNone(re.search(r"(?i)password|token|secret", text), text)
        # Without a restore source the member gets no restore key.
        name = "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b"
        docs = documents(render_si_release(

        self.assertNotIn("restore", si_member_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]["member"])

    def test_si_member_reconciler_stays_off_in_p2(self):
        # The si-member-reconciler container and si_member_ddl belong to spec
        # §10.4 step 6 (Plan S3-F): the value is a refused slot in P2.
        error = "siMember.reconciler.enabled needs the si_member_ddl user of spec §10.4 step 6 (Plan S3-F); it stays false in P2"
```

```yaml

# -- The si-member of this host (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.1, §16 P2; Plan
# S3-C2 K30; Plan S3-C3 contract §26): a separate process that copies the
# other owners' SI tables into hg_replica on this host's source ClickHouse, as
# si_member, and shadow-verifies every block it sees. It runs in its own
# StatefulSet <fullname>-si-member (templates/si-member.yaml) with its own
# ConfigMap, checksum/si-member-config, state volume and Service. This block is
# top-level, never under node, housegate, storageIntegrity or
# housegateSidecar, so no value here enters the host pod's checksum/config:
# starting, re-pinning, reconfiguring or removing a member never restarts the
# SNode. Off by default; indexer mode with storageIntegrity.enabled only. In
# stage 3 P2 the member is off consensus: never registered, it reads only the
# arbiter's SafeState and TableRegistry and the DA payloads.
siMember:
  enabled: false
  # -- The si-member image, digest-pinned
  # (ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<commit>@sha256:<64 hex>);
  # charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py lets a release set only a
  # reviewed one (MEMBER_IMAGES).
  image: ""
  # -- The member node id (member-a, member-b, ...), allocated once from
  # docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md §1.2 and never reused.
  nodeID: ""
  # -- This host's own source ClickHouse (host:port), the one
  # storageIntegrity.clickhouseDSN names.
  clickhouseDSN: ""
  clickhouseUsername: si_member
  # -- The Secret holding the si_member password, passed to the si-member
  # container only, as STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.
  secret:
    name: ""
    passwordKey: clickhouse-password
  # -- The member status token's own Secret, <fullname>-si-member-status-token
  # (never the password Secret), passed to the si-member container as
  # STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN; the stage-3 P2 image ignores it.
  statusTokenSecret:
    name: ""
    key: status-token
  # -- The read-only restore key of the P1 backups (Plan S3-C1), passed as
  # STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID and
  # STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET; set exactly when config.restore is.
  restoreSecret:
    name: ""
    accessKeyIDKey: access-id
    secretAccessKeyKey: secret
  # -- The other storage_integrity.member keys of the si-member config (Plan
  # S3-C2 contract §24.2), rendered after the keys the chart sets: never a
  # password, token, secret or key, and never node_id, state_dir, network_id,
  # clickhouse_dsn, clickhouse_username or metrics_listen.
  config: {}
  stateSize: 1Gi
  storageClassName: local-path
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: 2Gi
  # -- Where the member pod runs; never the host pod's nodeSelector.
  nodeSelector:
    sentio.xyz/general: "true"
  # -- metrics_listen (/metrics and /readyz) and the status port that the
  # stage-3 P3 image serves on.
  metricsPort: 9095
  statusPort: 9096
  # -- The si-member-reconciler container (si_member_ddl, spec §10.4 step 6)
  # belongs to stage 3 P6 (Plan S3-F); the chart refuses it while true.
  reconciler:
    enabled: false
```

```yaml
{{- /*
The si-member of this host (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.1, §16 P2; Plan S3-C2
K30; Plan S3-C3 contract §26): its own StatefulSet <fullname>-si-member with its
own ConfigMap, checksum/si-member-config, state volume, digest-pinned image and
Service. No siMember value enters the host pod's checksum/config
(templates/node.yaml), so a member change never restarts the SNode.

The si_member password reaches only the si-member container, from
siMember.secret; the status token comes only from its own Secret
<fullname>-si-member-status-token, never from the password Secret (Plan S3-C3
decision D29); the restore key only from siMember.restoreSecret. The config
file carries no secret, and the chart creates no Secret: the user's
scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh and Plan S3-C1's
make-si-backup-keys.sh do. The si-member-reconciler container (si_member_ddl)
belongs to spec §10.4 step 6 (Plan S3-F) and is refused here.
*/ -}}
{{- define "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "sentio-node.fullname" . }}-si-member
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
app.kubernetes.io/component: si-member
storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id: {{ .Values.siMember.nodeID | quote }}
{{- end }}
{{- /* The si-member's config file (Plan S3-C2 contract §24.2), read with
KnownFields: only SIMemberConfig keys, so no enabled key and, in P2, no serving
listener. The arbiter peers, the DA address and the network id are the host's. */ -}}
{{- define "sentio-node.siMember.config" -}}
storage_integrity:
  arbiter_peers:
    {{- range .Values.storageIntegrity.arbiterPeers }}
    - id: {{ .id | quote }}
      addr: {{ .addr | quote }}
    {{- end }}
  payload_store_data_addr: {{ .Values.storageIntegrity.payloadStoreDataAddr | quote }}
  member:
    node_id: {{ .Values.siMember.nodeID | quote }}
    state_dir: "/data/si-member"
    network_id: {{ .Values.storageIntegrity.snode.networkID | quote }}
    clickhouse_dsn: {{ .Values.siMember.clickhouseDSN | quote }}
    clickhouse_username: {{ .Values.siMember.clickhouseUsername | quote }}
    metrics_listen: {{ printf ":%d" (int .Values.siMember.metricsPort) | quote }}
    {{- /* siMember.config, key by key in sorted order and each value as JSON,
    so every YAML reader reads it as written (a 0x-prefixed hex string stays a
    string); a null value is left out, as if unset. The guards below have
    checked every key. */}}
    {{- range $key, $value := .Values.siMember.config }}
    {{- if not (kindIs "invalid" $value) }}
    {{ $key }}: {{ toJson $value }}
    {{- end }}
    {{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- $member := .Values.siMember -}}
{{- if $member.reconciler.enabled -}}
{{- fail "siMember.reconciler.enabled needs the si_member_ddl user of spec §10.4 step 6 (Plan S3-F); it stays false in P2" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if $member.enabled -}}
{{- $fullname := include "sentio-node.fullname" . -}}
{{- if ne .Values.node.mode "indexer" -}}
{{- fail "siMember is supported only in indexer mode" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not .Values.storageIntegrity.enabled -}}
{{- fail "siMember.enabled requires storageIntegrity.enabled: the si-member reads the host's arbiter peers, DA address and network id" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch "^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9._/-]*[a-z0-9])?(:[0-9]+/[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9._/-]*[a-z0-9])?)?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$" (toString $member.image)) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.image must be a digest-pinned image (<repository>:<tag>@sha256:<64 hex>)" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch "^member-[a-z]$" (toString $member.nodeID)) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.nodeID must be one member id (member-[a-z])" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if eq (toString $member.nodeID) (toString .Values.storageIntegrity.snode.nodeID) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.nodeID must differ from storageIntegrity.snode.nodeID" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch "^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?:[0-9]{1,5}$" (toString $member.clickhouseDSN)) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.clickhouseDSN is required (the host's own source ClickHouse, host:port)" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if ne (toString $member.clickhouseUsername) "si_member" -}}
{{- fail "siMember.clickhouseUsername must be si_member" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if empty $member.secret.name -}}
{{- fail "siMember.secret.name is required: the si_member password comes only from that Secret" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $tokenSecret := printf "%s-si-member-status-token" $fullname -}}
{{- if ne (toString $member.statusTokenSecret.name) $tokenSecret -}}
{{- fail (printf "siMember.statusTokenSecret.name must be %s: the status token has its own Secret" $tokenSecret) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if eq (toString $member.statusTokenSecret.name) (toString $member.secret.name) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.statusTokenSecret.name must differ from siMember.secret.name: the status token never shares the Secret that holds the si_member password" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if not (kindIs "map" $member.config) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.config must be a map of storage_integrity.member keys" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $key, $_ := $member.config -}}
{{- if not (regexMatch "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$" $key) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.config must be a map of storage_integrity.member keys" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $key := list "node_id" "state_dir" "network_id" "clickhouse_dsn" "clickhouse_username" "metrics_listen" -}}
{{- if hasKey $member.config $key -}}
{{- fail "siMember.config may not set node_id, state_dir, network_id, clickhouse_dsn, clickhouse_username or metrics_listen: they come from siMember values" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- /* Any key, at any depth, whose name holds password, token or secret or
ends in key. toJson writes every key right after "{" or ",", and a string
value never right before ":". */ -}}
{{- if regexMatch "[{,]\"([^\"]*(?i:password|token|secret)[^\"]*|[^\"]*(?i:key))\":" (toJson $member.config) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.config may not carry a password, a token or a key: secrets come only from siMember.secret, siMember.statusTokenSecret and siMember.restoreSecret" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $restore := and (hasKey $member.config "restore") (not (kindIs "invalid" (index $member.config "restore"))) -}}
{{- if ne (empty $member.restoreSecret.name) (not $restore) -}}
{{- fail "siMember.restoreSecret.name and siMember.config.restore are set together: the restore source needs its bucket and its key" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $config := printf "%s\n" (include "sentio-node.siMember.config" .) -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullname }}-si-member-config
  labels:
    {{- include "sentio-node.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
data:
  si-member.yaml: |
    {{- $config | trimSuffix "\n" | nindent 4 }}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullname }}-si-member
  labels:
    {{- include "sentio-node.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  serviceName: {{ $fullname }}-si-member
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        # The rendered si-member.yaml only, so a host value the member does
        # not read never rolls it.
        checksum/si-member-config: {{ $config | sha256sum }}
      labels:
        {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      {{- with .Values.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with $member.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      # The si-member never calls the Kubernetes API.
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: si-member
          image: {{ $member.image | quote }}
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["/sentio-node"]
          args: ["si-member", "--config-path", "/config/si-member.yaml"]
          env:
            - name: STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $member.secret.name | quote }}
                  key: {{ $member.secret.passwordKey | quote }}
            - name: STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $member.statusTokenSecret.name | quote }}
                  key: {{ $member.statusTokenSecret.key | quote }}
            {{- with $member.restoreSecret }}
            {{- if .name }}
            - name: STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .name | quote }}
                  key: {{ .accessKeyIDKey | quote }}
            - name: STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .name | quote }}
                  key: {{ .secretAccessKeyKey | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- end }}
          ports:
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: {{ int $member.metricsPort }}
              protocol: TCP
            - name: status
              containerPort: {{ int $member.statusPort }}
              protocol: TCP
          # Ready once the process serves its metrics. Its bootstrap (GET
          # /readyz answers 200 once the startup audit is clean and every
          # peer's copies reached a manifest, Plan S3-C2 §24.3) is read by
          # runbook §9, so a member that is still copying is Ready and scraped.
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /metrics
              port: metrics
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          {{- with $member.resources }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /config
              readOnly: true
            - name: si-member-state
              mountPath: /data/si-member
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ $fullname }}-si-member-config
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: si-member-state
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        storageClassName: {{ $member.storageClassName | quote }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ $member.stateSize | quote }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullname }}-si-member
  labels:
    {{- include "sentio-node.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - name: metrics
      port: {{ int $member.metricsPort }}
      targetPort: metrics
      protocol: TCP
    - name: status
      port: {{ int $member.statusPort }}
      targetPort: status
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    {{- include "sentio-node.siMember.selectorLabels" . | nindent 4 }}
{{- end -}}
```

```python
    def test_si_member_config_names_the_hosts_own_source_clickhouse(self):
        # Each member runs as si_member on its own host's source ClickHouse, with
        # that host's arbiter peers, DA address, network and genesis, and with
        # only the keys of Plan S3-C2's storage_integrity.member block.
        self.require_every_si_host()
        sources = {
            FRESH_RELEASE: config_for(self.control, "bootstrap", FRESH_RELEASE)["clickhouse_addr"],
            "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b": source_clickhouse(INDEXER_B_CHI),
            "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c": source_clickhouse(INDEXER_C_CHI),
        }
        genesis = arbiter_config(self.control, FRESH_RELEASE)["tables"]
        dsns = []
        for name, docs in self.si_hosts.items():
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                host = host_config(docs)["storage_integrity"]
                values = si_release_values(name)["siMember"]
                self.assertEqual(values["clickhouseDSN"], host["clickhouse_dsn"])
                self.assertEqual(values["clickhouseDSN"], sources[DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS[name]])
                dsns.append(values["clickhouseDSN"])
                config = si_member_config(documents(render_si_release(name, member_on())))["storage_integrity"]
                self.assertEqual(
                    (config["arbiter_peers"], config["payload_store_data_addr"]),
                    (host["arbiter_peers"], host["payload_store_data_addr"]),
                )
                member = config["member"]
                self.assertLessEqual(set(member), SI_MEMBER_CONFIG_KEYS)
                self.assertEqual({key: member[key] for key in (
                    "node_id", "host_indexer_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "genesis_snapshot_id", "genesis_tables",
                    "clickhouse_dsn", "clickhouse_username", "storage_policy", "restore", "shadow_verification",
                    "stop_installs_ratio", "metrics_listen",
                )}, {
                    "node_id": DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name],
                    "host_indexer_id": DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name],
                    "state_dir": "/data/si-member",
                    "network_id": host["snode"]["network_id"],
                    "genesis_snapshot_id": host["snode"]["genesis_snapshot_id"],
                    "genesis_tables": genesis,
                    "clickhouse_dsn": host["clickhouse_dsn"],
                    "clickhouse_username": "si_member",
                    "storage_policy": "member",
                    "restore": {"endpoint": "https://storage.googleapis.com", "bucket": SI_BACKUP_BUCKET},
                    "shadow_verification": True,
                    "stop_installs_ratio": 0.5,
                    "metrics_listen": ":9095",
                })
                self.assertEqual(member["genesis_snapshot_id"], DEVNET2_GENESIS_SNAPSHOT_ID)
                # The installation's si_member password, this host's own token
                # Secret (decision D29) and its P1 restore key (Plan S3-C1).
                chi = DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS[name]
                installation = "network" if chi == FRESH_RELEASE else chi.removeprefix(f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-")
                self.assertEqual(values["secret"]["name"], f"storage-integrity-si-v2-member-{installation}")
                self.assertEqual(values["statusTokenSecret"]["name"], f"{name}-si-member-status-token")
                self.assertEqual(values["restoreSecret"]["name"], f"storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-{name.rsplit('-', 1)[1]}")
        self.assertEqual(len(set(dsns)), len(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))

    def test_si_member_needs_a_reviewed_image(self):
        # A member image runs si-member --config-path (Plan S3-C2 Task 35) and
        # refuses the host's config file; any other image would run a host or
        # nothing. A values file may name a member image only from MEMBER_IMAGES.
        for image in MEMBER_IMAGES:
            self.assertRegex(image, r"^ghcr\.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-[0-9a-f]{40}@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
        checked = []
        referenced = set()
        for helmfile in sentio_node_helmfiles():
            for release in yaml.safe_load(helmfile.read_text())["releases"]:
                if (helmfile.parent / release["chart"]).resolve() != SENTIO_NODE_CHART:
                    continue
                label = f"{helmfile.relative_to(ROOT)}:{release['name']}"
                values, files = release_chart_values(helmfile, release, label)
                referenced.update(files)
                checked.append(label)
                member = values["siMember"]
                if member["enabled"] or member["image"]:
                    self.assertIn(member["image"], MEMBER_IMAGES, f"{label}: siMember.image must be a reviewed member image")
        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            self.assertIn(f"{FRESH_HELMFILE.relative_to(ROOT)}:{name}", checked)
        # No file outside those releases may carry siMember: it would be dead
        # configuration that a later release could pick up unreviewed.
        tracked = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "ls-files", "k8s-*"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
        ).stdout.split()
        for name in tracked:
            path = ROOT / name
            if name in {"k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse-extra.yaml", "k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse.yaml"}:
                continue  # Credential-bearing manifests are outside this member-config census.
            if path.suffix in (".yaml", ".yml") and path not in referenced and path.is_file():
                self.assertNotIn("siMember", path.read_text(errors="ignore"), f"{name} is not part of any sentio-node release")

    def test_member_ids_are_unique_and_never_an_snode_verifier_or_voter_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS), set(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        # The same indexer ids as Plan S3-C1's backup owners (contract §18).
        self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS, DEVNET2_BACKUP_OWNERS)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS.values())), len(DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS))
        self.assertEqual(len(set(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS.values())), len(DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS))
        for member in DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS.values():
            self.assertRegex(member, r"^member-[a-z]$")
        verifiers = self.control[("StatefulSet", f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-verifier")]["spec"]["replicas"]
        voters = self.control[("StatefulSet", f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-arbiter")]["spec"]["replicas"]
        taken = set(DEVNET2_SNODE_IDS.values()) | {f"verifier-{n}" for n in range(1, verifiers + 1)} | {
            init_rendered_arbiter_config(self.control, n, FRESH_RELEASE)["node_id"] for n in range(voters)
        }
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS.values()) & taken, set())
        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                member = si_release_values(name)["siMember"]
                self.assertEqual(member["nodeID"], DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name])
                self.assertEqual(member["config"]["host_indexer_id"], DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name])

    def test_member_id_ledger_matches_the_constants(self):
        # docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md §1.2: the SNode ledger
        # names each host's indexer id (indexer-c's since Plan S3-B's record),
        # and the member ledger after it allocates each member id once.
        text = MULTI_SOURCE_RUNBOOK.read_text()
        section = text[text.index("### 1.2 Identities"):text.index("### 1.3 ")]
        snodes = {snode: int(indexer) for snode, indexer in re.findall(r"^\| `(snode-[0-9]+)` \| ([0-9]+) \(", section, re.M)}
        self.assertEqual({name: snodes[snode] for name, snode in DEVNET2_SNODE_IDS.items()}, DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS)
        rows = re.findall(r"^\| `(member-[a-z])` \| ([0-9]+) \((indexer-[a-z])\) \| [^|\n]+ \|$", section, re.M)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), len(DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS))
        self.assertEqual({member: (int(indexer), host) for member, indexer, host in rows}, {
            DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name]: (DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name], name.removeprefix("sentio-node-devnet2-"))
            for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES
        })
        last = max(member[-1] for member in DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS.values())
        self.assertIn(f"\nNext free member id: `member-{chr(ord(last) + 1)}`.\n", section)
        self.assertLess(section.index("Next free id: `snode-"), section.index("| Member | Host (SI indexer) | Since |"))

    def test_devnet2_members_follow_the_rollout(self):
        # docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md §8 starts member-b,
        # member-c, then member-a, each in a single-service commit that flips
        # DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED, only on an installation whose si_member
        # exists (stage member, §7; Plan S3-C3 Task 37) and with its member
        # disk's total as the budget; §8.4 then lists all three for monitoring.
        self.require_every_si_host()
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED), set(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(DEVNET2_MEMBER_ROLLOUT), sorted(DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        self.assertEqual(set(DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS.values()), set(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE))
        started = [name for name in DEVNET2_MEMBER_ROLLOUT if DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[name]]
        self.assertEqual(started, list(DEVNET2_MEMBER_ROLLOUT[:len(started)]))
        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                member = si_release_values(name)["siMember"]
                self.assertIs(member["enabled"], DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[name])
                self.assertEqual(set(si_member_objects(self.si_hosts[name])) != set(), DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[name])
                self.assertEqual(member["config"]["stop_installs_ratio"], 0.5)
                self.assertIsInstance(member["config"]["disk_budget_bytes"], int)
                if DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[name]:
                    self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_P2_STAGE[DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS[name]], "member")
                    self.assertGreater(member["config"]["disk_budget_bytes"], 0)
        monitoring = yaml.safe_load((DEVNET2 / "storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml").read_text())["monitoring"]["members"]
        self.assertEqual(
            (tuple(monitoring["releases"]), tuple(monitoring["installations"])),
            (DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS, DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS),
        )
        self.assertIn(DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS, ((), DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES))
        self.assertEqual(DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS, tuple(DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS[name] for name in DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS))
        for name in DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS:
            self.assertTrue(DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[name], f"{name} is monitored before its member runs")
        self.assertIs(
            ("VMServiceScrape", f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-members") in self.control,
            DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED and bool(DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS),
        )

    def test_devnet2_member_static_peers_are_every_other_si_indexer(self):
        # Spec §16 P2: the static group config of each member is every other SI
        # indexer, in ascending id, each reached through the NOT OVERRIDABLE
        # collection si_owner_<id> that its installation defines (Plan S3-C3
        # Task 37), plus the three pool verifiers' collections; a member never
        # copies its own host.
        verifiers = self.control[("StatefulSet", f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-verifier")]["spec"]["replicas"]
        pool = [f"si_peer_verifier_{n}" for n in range(1, verifiers + 1)]
        sources = {
            DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name]: si_release_values(name)["storageIntegrity"]["clickhouseDSN"].rsplit(":", 1)[0]
            for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES
        }
        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                config = si_release_values(name)["siMember"]["config"]
                own = DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS[name]
                others = sorted(indexer for indexer in DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS.values() if indexer != own)
                self.assertEqual(config["peers"], [{"indexer_id": indexer, "collection": f"si_owner_{indexer}"} for indexer in others])
                self.assertEqual(config["pool_collections"], pool)
                collections = {collection: host for collection, host, _ in DEVNET2_NAMED_COLLECTIONS[DEVNET2_MEMBER_CHIS[name]]}
                self.assertEqual(set(collections), {peer["collection"] for peer in config["peers"]} | set(pool))
                for peer in config["peers"]:
                    self.assertEqual(collections[peer["collection"]], sources[peer["indexer_id"]])
                for n, collection in enumerate(pool, 1):
                    self.assertEqual(collections[collection], f"{FRESH_RELEASE}-verifier-{n}")
                self.assertNotIn(f"si_owner_{own}", collections)
```

```yaml

# The si-member of indexer-a (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.1, §16 P2; Plan
# S3-C3 contract §26.5): member-a copies the SI tables of owners 1 and <INDEXER_C_ID>
# into hg_replica on this host's own source ClickHouse, as si_member, by owner
# pull through the NOT OVERRIDABLE collections and by restore from the P1
# backups, and shadow-verifies every block of those owners. It is off
# consensus and runs in its own StatefulSet, so nothing here restarts this
# host's SNode. docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md §8.3 turns
# it on in its own commit, after si_member exists on this installation
# (§7.3), and sets disk_budget_bytes to the member disk's total that §1.2
# records (installs pause at half of it, Plan S3-C3 D28).
siMember:
  enabled: false
  image: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2>@<SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2>
  nodeID: member-a
  clickhouseDSN: storage-integrity-si-v2-source:9000
  secret:
    name: storage-integrity-si-v2-member-network
  statusTokenSecret:
    name: sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member-status-token
  restoreSecret:
    name: storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-a
  config:
    host_indexer_id: 0
    # The network's genesis snapshot id and genesis table, as
    # storageIntegrity.snode.genesisSnapshotID and storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml
    # (table) state them.
    genesis_snapshot_id: "0x63700cf134ce037961d9acf4ab5ff120dde6c6b1d2ba258fa321d581139d1c06"
    genesis_tables:
      - table_id: devnet101.swap_new2
        partition_by: ""
        columns:
          - {name: value, type: Int64}
    storage_policy: member
    # Every other SI indexer, in ascending id (static group config, spec §16 P2).
    peers:
      - {indexer_id: 1, collection: si_owner_1}
      - {indexer_id: <INDEXER_C_ID>, collection: si_owner_<INDEXER_C_ID>}
    pool_collections: [si_peer_verifier_1, si_peer_verifier_2, si_peer_verifier_3]
    # Plan S3-C1's replica bucket; each owner's backups under owner-<indexer_id>/.
    restore:
      endpoint: https://storage.googleapis.com
      bucket: sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica
    shadow_verification: true
    stop_installs_ratio: 0.5
    disk_budget_bytes: 0
```

```python
    # Two si-member releases and the installations of their member disks
    # (Plan S3-C3 §26.6), listed on top of MONITORED.
    MEMBERS = {"members": {
        "releases": ["sentio-node-probe-a", "sentio-node-probe-b"],
        "installations": ["storage-integrity", "storage-integrity-probe-b"],
    }}

    def members_monitored(self, **monitoring):
        """MONITORED with the two probe members listed, other monitoring values merged last."""
        return documents(render({"monitoring": {**self.MONITORED["monitoring"], **self.MEMBERS, **monitoring}}))

    def test_member_scrape_selects_only_the_listed_member_services(self):
        docs = self.members_monitored()
        scrape = docs[("VMServiceScrape", "storage-integrity-members")]["spec"]
        self.assertEqual(scrape, {
            "namespaceSelector": {"matchNames": [RENDER_NAMESPACE]},
            "selector": {
                "matchLabels": {"app.kubernetes.io/component": "si-member"},
                "matchExpressions": [{
                    "key": "app.kubernetes.io/instance", "operator": "In", "values": ["sentio-node-probe-a", "sentio-node-probe-b"],
                }],
            },
            "endpoints": [{
                "port": "metrics", "path": "/metrics", "interval": "30s", "scrapeTimeout": "10s",
                "relabelConfigs": [
                    {"action": "replace", "targetLabel": "network", "replacement": "render-test-v1"},
                    {"action": "replace", "targetLabel": "si_component", "replacement": "member"},
                    {"action": "replace", "sourceLabels": ["__meta_kubernetes_service_label_app_kubernetes_io_instance"], "targetLabel": "release"},
                    {"action": "replace", "sourceLabels": ["__meta_kubernetes_service_label_storage_integrity_sentio_xyz_member_id"], "targetLabel": "member"},
                ],
            }],
        })
        # Listed, a devnet2 SI host release's si-member Service is the only one
        # of its Services the member scrape selects, and the hosts scrape never
        # selects it; the member pod has no prometheus.io annotation, so the
        # pod-annotation job never scrapes it a second time.
        hosts = docs[("VMServiceScrape", "storage-integrity-hosts")]["spec"]["selector"]

        def selected(selector, labels, release):
            return selector["matchLabels"].items() <= labels.items() and labels["app.kubernetes.io/instance"] == release

        for name in DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
            with self.subTest(release=name):
                rendered = documents(render_si_release(name, member_on()))
                services = {service: doc for (kind, service), doc in rendered.items() if kind == "Service"}
                self.assertEqual(
                    [service for service, doc in services.items() if selected(scrape["selector"], doc["metadata"]["labels"], name)],
                    [f"{name}-si-member"],
                )
                self.assertNotIn(f"{name}-si-member", [
                    service for service, doc in services.items() if selected(hosts, doc["metadata"]["labels"], name)
                ])
                member = services[f"{name}-si-member"]
                self.assertIn("metrics", [port["name"] for port in member["spec"]["ports"]])
                self.assertEqual(member["metadata"]["labels"]["storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id"], DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS[name])
                pod = rendered[("StatefulSet", f"{name}-si-member")]["spec"]["template"]["metadata"]
                self.assertEqual([key for key in pod["annotations"] if key.startswith("prometheus.io")], [])
        # Without listed members there is no scrape and no members group, and
        # listing them adds those two and changes no other object.
        self.assertNotIn(("VMServiceScrape", "storage-integrity-members"), self.monitored)
        self.assertNotIn("storage-integrity.members", vm_rules(self.monitored))
        self.assertEqual(set(docs) - set(self.monitored), {("VMServiceScrape", "storage-integrity-members")})
        self.assertEqual(set(self.monitored) - set(docs), set())
        for key, resource in self.monitored.items():
            if key != ("VMRule", "storage-integrity"):
                self.assertEqual(docs[key], resource, key)
        rules = vm_rules(docs)
        self.assertEqual(list(rules)[:-1], list(vm_rules(self.monitored)))
        self.assertEqual({group: rule for group, rule in rules.items() if group != "storage-integrity.members"}, vm_rules(self.monitored))
        # Without monitoring nothing renders, whatever is listed.
        quiet = documents(render({"monitoring": self.MEMBERS}))
        self.assertEqual({kind for kind, _ in quiet} & {"VMServiceScrape", "VMRule"}, set())

    def test_member_rules_read_only_this_networks_member_series(self):
        docs = self.members_monitored()
        expected = {
            "StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped": ("warning", "10m"),
            "StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch": ("critical", None),
            "StorageIntegrityMemberForeignPart": ("critical", None),
            "StorageIntegrityMemberDiverged": ("warning", None),
            "StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind": ("warning", "30m"),
            "StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh": ("warning", "15m"),
        }
        rules = vm_rules(docs)["storage-integrity.members"]
        self.assertEqual({rule["alert"]: (rule["labels"]["severity"], rule.get("for")) for rule in rules}, expected)
        series = set()
        for rule in rules:
            with self.subTest(alert=rule["alert"]):
                expr = rule["expr"]
                for clause in re.findall(r"\bby \(([^()]*)\)", expr):
                    self.assertIn("cluster", [label.strip() for label in clause.split(",")])
                selectors = promql_selectors(expr)
                self.assertNotEqual(selectors, [])
                for metric, matchers in selectors:
                    self.assertNotIn("job", matchers)
                    if metric.startswith("ClickHouse"):
                        self.assertIn(metric, ("ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_member", "ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskTotal_member"))
                        self.assertEqual(matchers, {
                            "namespace": ("=", RENDER_NAMESPACE),
                            "clickhouse_altinity_com_chi": ("=~", "storage-integrity|storage-integrity-probe-b"),
                        })
                    else:
                        self.assertEqual(matchers["network"], ("=", "render-test-v1"))
                        self.assertEqual(matchers["si_component"], ("=", "member"))
                        series.add(metric)
                self.assertEqual(rule["labels"]["network"], "render-test-v1")
                self.assertNotEqual(rule["annotations"]["summary"].strip(), "")
        self.assertEqual(series - {"up"}, SI_MEMBER_RULE_SERIES)
        unscraped = alert_rule(docs, "StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped")["expr"]
        for release in self.MEMBERS["members"]["releases"]:
            self.assertIn(f'absent(up{{network="render-test-v1", si_component="member", release="{release}"}})', unscraped)
        self.assertTrue(alert_rule(docs, "StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh")["expr"].endswith(") > 0.5"))
        tuned = self.members_monitored(members={**self.MEMBERS["members"], "diskUsedRatio": 0.4})
        self.assertTrue(alert_rule(tuned, "StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh")["expr"].endswith(") > 0.4"))

    def test_group_runbook_urls_point_into_their_runbooks(self):
        # Plan S3-B's groups point into the P0 runbook (monitoring.runbookURL);
        # a group of a later phase points into its own runbook through its own
        # value, and every anchor is a top-level section of that runbook.
        values = yaml.safe_load((CHART / "values.yaml").read_text())["monitoring"]
        docs = self.members_monitored()
        rules = vm_rules(docs)
        for group, (key, runbook, sections) in MONITORING_GROUP_RUNBOOKS.items():
            with self.subTest(group=group):
                url = values[key]["runbookURL"]
                self.assertEqual(url, f"https://github.com/sentioxyz/production/blob/main/{runbook.relative_to(ROOT)}")
                self.assertNotEqual(url, values["runbookURL"])
                if runbook.exists():
                    headings = re.findall(r"^## (.+)$", runbook.read_text(), re.M)
                    self.assertLessEqual(set(sections), set(headings))
                anchors = {markdown_anchor(section) for section in sections}
                for rule in rules[f"storage-integrity.{group}"]:
                    prefix, _, anchor = rule["annotations"]["runbook_url"].partition("#")
                    self.assertEqual(prefix, url, rule["alert"])
                    self.assertIn(anchor, anchors, rule["alert"])
        self.assertEqual(
            {rule["alert"]: rule["annotations"]["runbook_url"].partition("#")[2] for rule in rules["storage-integrity.members"]},
            {
                "StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped": "8-si-members",
                "StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch": "10-shadow-soak",
                "StorageIntegrityMemberForeignPart": "14-operating-rules",
                "StorageIntegrityMemberDiverged": "14-operating-rules",
                "StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind": "14-operating-rules",
                "StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh": "14-operating-rules",
            },
        )
        # Moving the members runbook moves exactly the members group's URLs.
        moved = vm_rules(self.members_monitored(members={**self.MEMBERS["members"], "runbookURL": "https://example.com/p2.md"}))
        for group, group_rules in moved.items():
            for rule in group_rules:
                if "alert" not in rule:
                    continue
                prefix = rule["annotations"]["runbook_url"].partition("#")[0]
                if group == "storage-integrity.members":
                    self.assertEqual(prefix, "https://example.com/p2.md")
                else:
                    self.assertNotEqual(prefix, "https://example.com/p2.md")

    def test_member_monitoring_settings_fail_closed(self):
        distinct = "monitoring.members.releases must name distinct sentio-node releases"
        together = (
            "monitoring.members.releases and monitoring.members.installations are set together: "
            "every member alert reads the listed members and their installations' member disks"
        )
        ratio = "monitoring.members.diskUsedRatio must satisfy 0 < diskUsedRatio < 1"
        listed = self.MEMBERS["members"]
        for members, error in (
            ({**listed, "releases": ["sentio-node-a", "sentio-node-a"]}, distinct),
            ({**listed, "releases": ["Sentio_Node"]}, distinct),
            ({**listed, "releases": [""]}, distinct),
            ({"releases": ["sentio-node-a"]}, together),
            ({"installations": ["storage-integrity"]}, together),
            ({**listed, "diskUsedRatio": 0}, ratio),
            ({**listed, "diskUsedRatio": 1}, ratio),
            ({**listed, "diskUsedRatio": -0.5}, ratio),
            ({**listed, "diskUsedRatio": "0.5"}, "diskUsedRatio"),
            ({**listed, "installations": ["Bad_Name"]}, "installations"),
            ({**listed, "installations": ["storage-integrity", "storage-integrity"]}, "installations"),
            ({**listed, "runbookURL": "http://example.com/p2.md"}, "runbookURL"),
            ({**listed, "runbookURL": "https://example.com/p2.md#8-si-members"}, "runbookURL"),
            (None, "members"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(members=members):
                self.assert_rejected({"monitoring": {"enabled": True, "members": members}}, error)
```

```gotemplate
{{- if $members }}

apiVersion: operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1
kind: VMServiceScrape
metadata:
  name: {{ $fullname }}-members
  labels:
    {{- include "storage-integrity.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- with .Values.monitoring.labels }}
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}
spec:
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames: [{{ $namespace | quote }}]

  # registry. The si-member pods carry no prometheus.io annotation, so nothing
  # else scrapes them.
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: si-member
    matchExpressions:
      - key: app.kubernetes.io/instance
        operator: In
        values:
          {{- range $members }}
          - {{ . | quote }}
          {{- end }}
  endpoints:
    - port: metrics
      path: /metrics
      interval: {{ .Values.monitoring.interval }}
      scrapeTimeout: {{ .Values.monitoring.scrapeTimeout }}
      relabelConfigs:
        - {action: replace, targetLabel: network, replacement: {{ $network | quote }}}
        - {action: replace, targetLabel: si_component, replacement: member}
        - {action: replace, sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_service_label_app_kubernetes_io_instance], targetLabel: release}
        - {action: replace, sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_service_label_storage_integrity_sentio_xyz_member_id], targetLabel: member}
{{- end }}
```

and insert right before the file's last line `{{- end }}` (`:461`), after Plan S3-C1's `backups` group and its `    {{- end }}`:

```gotemplate
    {{- if $members }}
    # The si-members (stage 3 P2, Plan S3-C3 §26.6): their own series, scraped
    # by <fullname>-members, and the member disks of the listed installations
    # from the pod-annotation scrape. Every runbook_url points into the P2
    # members runbook (monitoring.members.runbookURL).
    - name: {{ $fullname }}.members
      rules:
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped
          expr: |-
            (max by (cluster, network, release) (up{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member"}) == 0)
            {{- range $members }}
            or absent(up{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member", release="{{ . }}"})
            {{- end }}
          for: 10m
          labels:
            severity: warning
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "A listed si-member exports no metrics (no scrape target, or the scrape fails); its member rules cannot fire"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#8-si-members"
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch
          expr: |-
            max by (cluster, network, release, member, owner, kind) (increase(sentio_node_si_member_shadow_mismatches_total{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member"}[10m])) > 0
          labels:
            severity: critical
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "An si-member's shadow verification disagreed with the evaluated evidence of an owner's block"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#10-shadow-soak"
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberForeignPart
          expr: |-
            max by (cluster, network, release, member, owner) (sentio_node_si_member_foreign_tables{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member"}) > 0
          labels:
            severity: critical
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "An si-member found a part that no published manifest lists and quarantined that table's copy (its scratch is kept)"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#14-operating-rules"
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberDiverged
          expr: |-
            max by (cluster, network, release, member, owner) (increase(sentio_node_si_member_diverged_partitions_total{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member"}[1h])) > 0
          labels:
            severity: warning
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "An si-member found a copy partition that is not a sub-multiset of its manifest and rebuilt it in the last hour"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#14-operating-rules"
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind
          expr: |-
            max by (cluster, network, release, member, owner) (sentio_node_si_member_copy_behind_seconds{network="{{ $network }}", si_component="member"}) > 0
          for: 30m
          labels:
            severity: warning
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "An si-member's copies of an owner have stayed behind the latest published entry for 30 minutes"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#14-operating-rules"
        - alert: StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh
          expr: |-
            max by (cluster, namespace, clickhouse_altinity_com_chi, pod) (1 - ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_member{namespace="{{ $namespace }}", clickhouse_altinity_com_chi=~"{{ $memberChis }}"} / ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskTotal_member{namespace="{{ $namespace }}", clickhouse_altinity_com_chi=~"{{ $memberChis }}"}) > {{ .Values.monitoring.members.diskUsedRatio }}
          for: 15m
          labels:
            severity: warning
            network: {{ $network | quote }}
          annotations:
            summary: "The filesystem of a member disk is above monitoring.members.diskUsedRatio used (the stage-3 P2 exit keeps it below 50 %)"
            runbook_url: "{{ $memberRunbook }}#14-operating-rules"
    {{- end }}
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
import sys,copy,yaml
W=Path(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(sys.argv[2]);out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0,str(W/'charts/storage-integrity/tests'));import test_render as t
for name in t.DEVNET2_SI_RELEASES:
 for kind,overrides in [('actual',t.member_on()),('complete-helper',t.member_values(name))]:
  c=t.si_member_config(t.documents(t.render_si_release(name,overrides)))
  (out/f'{name}-{kind}.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(c))
  if kind=='actual':
   for mutation in ['missing-policy','schema','unknown','trailing','secret']:
    bad=copy.deepcopy(c);m=bad['storage_integrity']['member']
    if mutation=='missing-policy':m.pop('storage_policy')
    if mutation=='schema':m['genesis_tables'][0]['columns'][0]['type']=''
    if mutation=='unknown':m['not_a_real_config_key']='x'
    if mutation=='secret':m['restore']['secret']='SYNTHETIC_ONLY_DO_NOT_LOG'
    s=yaml.safe_dump(bad)
    if mutation=='trailing':s+='---\n{}\n'
    (out/f'reject-{name}-{mutation}.yaml').write_text(s)
print('six real renders and fifteen negative loader fixtures exported')
```

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "compute-network-node/config"
)

func main() {
    if len(os.Args) < 3 || (os.Args[1] != "pass" && os.Args[1] != "reject") { panic("usage: check-config pass|reject files...") }
    for _, path := range os.Args[2:] {
        cfg, err := config.LoadSIMemberConfig(path)
        if err == nil { _, err = cfg.MemberConfig() }
        if os.Args[1] == "reject" {
            if err == nil { panic("invalid rendered member config accepted: " + path) }
        } else {
            if err != nil { panic(fmt.Errorf("rendered member config refused: %s: %w", path, err)) }
            m := cfg.StorageIntegrity.Member
            if m.StoragePolicy != "member" || !m.ShadowVerification || len(m.GenesisTables) == 0 || len(m.PoolCollections) != 3 { panic("incomplete devnet2 member config: " + path) }
        }
        fmt.Printf("%s: %s\n", os.Args[1], path)
    }
}
```

Notes (drafting decisions, Appendix B):
- **`si_p2_yaml` is Task 37's rewriters.** `si_p2_yaml <installation> <stage>` calls `si_p2_py stage`, which writes indexer-b's and indexer-c's CHI manifests with `p2_manifest_text`, the network overlay with `p2_overlay_text` and the staging variants with `p2_staging_chi`, the functions the render tests hold the files to, and checks each result against an independent construction before it writes (a manifest must parse to `p2_chi` of the old one and be a fixed point of the rewriter; the overlay must be the old one with exactly the stage's four values (including the reader metadata grant derived by Task 37 from engineGrants)). It then sets `DEVNET2_P2_STAGE` and, at the first engines stage, `DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES`, each a no-op when the entry already holds the value, so Task 40's `p2_stage_commit` (which sets the constants first and checks the result with its own `p2-change.py`) and a human run of the runbook end in the same commit. `si_p2_py` has no `manifest` or `values` subcommand (contract §27.2 named them); `stage` does both through those rewriters.
- **`touch`, not `create`.** K42's `si_keeper "create '<path>' ''"` is a syntax error on `clickhouse-keeper-client` 26.3, which also exits 0 on every command (Task 37's measurement); §3 and §6 create znodes with `touch` (an empty value) and prove existence with strict exact `exists` output 0/1 before reading children with `ls`.
- **Census stops on a tenant reaching engine.** K41 grants `si_gateway` every tenant engine of the census; the census check (and Task 40's own check, and `p2-change.py`) stops instead when a tenant table uses `Buffer`, `Distributed`, `Merge` or `Alias`, which then is the user's decision (spec §8.2 keeps those engines away from every user without a reason).
- **The staging measurements re-run every protocol DDL form after the restart** (Review Focus 1, Task 40's Gate 5) before the 497 and override measurements; the grant probe runs them again with the corpus.
- **`si_member_probe <host>` has one argument** (contract §27.2, Task 41): the first run on a host writes `member-probe-<host>.tsv` (§7.4), the second `exit-probe-<host>.tsv` (§12), a third refuses.
- **The soak's evidence has Task 41's formats**: `budget-start.txt` and `budget-end.txt` hold one estimator line each (Task 40 reads `tail -n 1`); `soak-start` is a `KEY=VALUE` record (`SOAK_START_UTC`, `SOAK_START_SEALED`, `SOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION`, `SOAK_K`, `SOAK_B`, `SOAK_L0`) and `soak-k` is written with it at the start; `soak.tsv` is `si_shadow_sample` lines; round `r` writes indexer-a's `5202 + (r - 1)·k` to `5201 + r·k` and rows `2 + (r - 1)·k` to `1 + r·k`, appends to `soak-writes-<r>.txt` with the lines Task 41's round check greps (`track <id> published <a> -> <b>`, `round <r> owner <b|c> safe rows <lo> to <hi>: <k>`) and leaves `soak-writes-<r>-<owner>.done`; the start and end blocks are idempotent.
- **`blockowners` prints `transition` as well** (contract §27.2 lists four fields): the shadow verifier skips table-set transitions (Plan S3-C2 §24), so the soak verdict counts each peer owner's non-transition blocks; it also requires every soak block to have a verdict with quorum and `blocks-soak.jsonl` to cover exactly the soak's range.
- **The host check needs no baseline.** `si_p2_host_unchanged` proves from the pod and StatefulSet themselves that starting a member left its host alone (every container of the host pod started before the member's StatefulSet existed, none restarted since, the pod on the current and update revision) and compares with §8's baseline when it exists, so it holds for Task 41's flow too.
- **Each confirmed window block of §4 and §7 checks after its apply**, read-only and tee'd (the reload, the grants, no restart, the stage read-back), so a live task runs one confirmed block per window; §5 keeps its read-only checks in blocks of their own after the confirmed apply, then the probe, the acceptance write and the window record `restart-<installation>.txt`, as Task 40 runs them.
- **The member disk total** is recorded in §1.2 as the filesystem's size less `keep_free_space_bytes` (what ClickHouse 26.3 reports as `total_space` and `DiskTotal_<disk>`; indexer-c's existing disk is checked against it at once) and read back live after each restart and before each member starts; a difference stops P2.
- **The quiet point reads partition states** through the stage-3 P0 runbook's `partstates`, so §1.3 builds `partstates` and `blockowners` from `CORE_TAG_P2` (local) and copies them into the voters in a confirmed block of its own; a replaced or restarted voter loses its copies and the helpers then ask for that block again.
- **Pointer row.** Reviewed Plan S3-C1 Task 27 appends the P1 row 10 after S3-B row 9. This task appends exactly row 11 after that verified P1 row and refuses an absent, moved or duplicate predecessor.
- **Workflow paths.** Two of the four entries (`charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_member_live_probe.tsv`, `scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh`) are already matched by `charts/storage-integrity/**` and `scripts/storage-integrity/**`; they are listed as contract §27.10 says.
- **Review additions, all in §0.** `si_p2_assert_absent`, `si_p2_keeper_exists`, `si_p2_backup_window`, `si_p2_release_record`, `si_p2_soak_budget`, `si_p2_member_identities`, `si_p2_member_identity_check`, `si_p2_vm_query_at`, `si_p2_vm_range`, `si_p2_vmalert_pod_identity`, `si_p2_vmalert_identity`, `si_p2_vmalert_check` and `si_p2_vmalert_history` add fail-closed presence, scheduling, release-record, budget and historical-evidence boundaries without external helper files. block in §0 (with every helper of contract §27.2) plus the one go block, every
```python
block parsing, "Confirm before running." in front of every mutating block, the
devuser1 blocks the live task runs in the user's terminal, no hard-wrapped
prose, and shellcheck -S warning over every bash block (each checked after the
§0 helpers, whose variables later blocks read).
"""

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path).read()
lines = text.splitlines()
WANT = [
    "## 0. Session helpers", "## 1. Preparation", "### 1.1 Pins", "### 1.2 Identities and Secrets", "### 1.3 Preconditions and budget",
    "## 2. Engine census", "## 3. Staging proof", "## 4. Engine grants", "### 4.1 indexer-b", "### 4.2 indexer-c", "### 4.3 network",
    "## 5. Restart windows", "### 5.1 indexer-b", "### 5.2 indexer-c", "### 5.3 network", "## 6. The unsafe_inc root",
    "## 7. Member users", "### 7.1 indexer-b", "### 7.2 indexer-c", "### 7.3 network", "### 7.4 Member probe",
    "## 8. si-members", "### 8.1 member-b", "### 8.2 member-c", "### 8.3 member-a", "### 8.4 Monitoring",
    "## 9. Bootstrap", "## 10. Shadow soak", "## 11. Measurements", "## 12. End", "## 13. Rollback",
    "## 14. Operating rules", "### 14.1 Members", "### 14.2 Engine grants after the restart", "### 14.3 ClickHouse restarts", "### 14.4 Promotion budget",
]
ANCHORS = ("8-si-members", "10-shadow-soak", "14-operating-rules")
HELPERS = ("si_member_pod", "si_member_metrics", "si_member_ch", "si_engine_census", "si_engine_census_check", "si_replicated_tables",
           "si_p2_yaml", "si_p2_py", "si_p2_stage_check", "si_quiet_point", "si_unsafe_inc", "si_member_probe", "si_budget_capture",
           "si_budget", "si_blockowners_build", "si_blockowners", "si_shadow_sample", "si_copies_check")
MUTATING = re.compile(
    r"git push|git revert|helmfile .* sync|(si_)?kubectl (apply|delete|create|patch|run|rollout restart)"
    r"|si_keeper \"(touch|create|rmr|rm|set)|si_(partstates|blockowners)_put|si_member_probe|si_p2s_grant_probe|si_accept_a_track"
    r"|si_agent_start|si_p2_revert|si_(ch_admin|ch_exec|member_ch|p2s_ch|p2_admin) [^\"]*\"(CREATE|INSERT|DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE|OPTIMIZE|SYSTEM|ATTACH|RENAME)"
)
# The devuser1 blocks the live task (Plan S3-C3 Task 40, p2-user-block.sh) runs in the user's terminal:
# (subsection, texts the block contains, texts it does not contain); each must be exactly one confirmed block.
USER_BLOCKS = {
    "soak-table-b": ("### 1.3 Preconditions and budget", ("CREATE TABLE", "s3_p2"), ("acceptance-db",)),
    "soak-table-c": ("### 1.3 Preconditions and budget", ("CREATE TABLE", "s3_p2", "acceptance-db"), ()),
    "restart-row-b": ("### 5.1 indexer-b", ("INSERT INTO", "s3_p2"), ("acceptance-db",)),
    "restart-row-c": ("### 5.2 indexer-c", ("INSERT INTO", "s3_p2", "acceptance-db"), ()),
}


def fences():
    """Every fenced block as (opening line index, language, body, heading above it), parsed line by line (D24)."""
    out, i, heading = [], 0, None
    while i < len(lines):
        m = re.match(r"^(`{3,})([A-Za-z0-9_-]*)\s*$", lines[i])
        if not m:
            if re.match(r"#{2,3} ", lines[i]):
                heading = lines[i]
            i += 1
            continue
        ticks, lang, j = m.group(1), m.group(2), i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and not re.fullmatch(re.escape(ticks) + r"`*\s*", lines[j]):
            j += 1
        assert j < len(lines), f"unterminated fence at line {i + 1}"
        out.append((i, lang, "\n".join(lines[i + 1:j]) + "\n", heading))
        i = j + 1
    return out


def slug(heading):
    title = heading.lstrip("#").strip().lower()
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 _-]", "", title).replace(" ", "-")


def confirmed(start):
    return [l for l in lines[:start] if l.strip()][-1].strip() == "Confirm before running."


blocks = fences()
in_block = set()
for start, _, body, _ in blocks:
    in_block.update(range(start, start + body.count("\n") + 2))
got = [l for n, l in enumerate(lines) if n not in in_block and re.match(r"#{2,3} ", l)]
assert got == WANT, "headings differ:\n" + "\n".join(f"  {a!r} | {b!r}" for a, b in zip(got + [""] * 40, WANT + [""] * 40) if a != b)
anchors = [slug(h) for h in got]
assert len(anchors) == len(set(anchors)), "two headings share an anchor"
for a in ANCHORS:
    assert a in anchors, f"anchor #{a} is missing"
print(f"headings ok ({len(got)})")

s0 = lines.index("## 0. Session helpers")
s1 = lines.index("## 1. Preparation")
zero = [b for b in blocks if s0 < b[0] < s1]
assert [b[1] for b in zero] == ["bash", "go"], f"§0 holds {[b[1] for b in zero]}, expected one bash block then one go block"
assert sum(1 for b in blocks if b[1] == "go") == 1, "the runbook must hold exactly one go block"
helpers = zero[0][2]
print("one bash block in §0 plus one go block")
missing = [h for h in HELPERS if not re.search(rf"^{h}\(\) {{", helpers, re.M)]
assert not missing, f"§0 does not define {missing}"
assert 'si_backup="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2"' in helpers.splitlines() and 'si_p2_logins_dir="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins"' in helpers.splitlines(), "§0 does not set si_backup and si_p2_logins_dir"
print(f"helpers of contract §27.2 defined ({len(HELPERS)})")

bashes = [b for b in blocks if b[1] == "bash"]
markers = [b[2].splitlines()[0] for b in bashes]
assert len(markers) == 115 and len(set(markers)) == 115 and all(re.fullmatch(r"# block p2-[0-9]+(?:-[0-9]+)*", m) for m in markers), "missing, duplicate or malformed executable block marker"
bad = []
for start, _, body, _ in bashes:
    r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-n"], input=body, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        bad.append(f"line {start + 1}: {r.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
fish = [b for b in blocks if b[1] == "fish"]
for start, _, body, _ in fish:
    r = subprocess.run(["fish", "-n"], input=body, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        bad.append(f"line {start + 1} (fish): {r.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
assert not bad, "blocks do not parse:\n" + "\n".join(bad)
print(f"blocks parse ({len(bashes)})")
print(f"fish blocks parse ({len(fish)})")

unconfirmed, n_confirmed = [], 0
for start, _, body, _ in bashes:
    if s0 < start < s1:
        continue
    hits = [l for l in body.splitlines() if MUTATING.search(l) and "--dry-run" not in l]
    if not hits:
        continue
    if confirmed(start):
        n_confirmed += 1
    else:
        unconfirmed.append(f"line {start + 1}: {hits[0].strip()[:90]}")
assert not unconfirmed, "mutating blocks without 'Confirm before running.':\n" + "\n".join(unconfirmed)
print(f"mutating blocks confirmed ({n_confirmed})")

for name, (heading, wanted, unwanted) in USER_BLOCKS.items():
    found = [b for b in bashes if b[3] == heading and b[2].splitlines().count("key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key") == 1
             and all(w in b[2] for w in wanted) and not any(u in b[2] for u in unwanted)]
    assert len(found) == 1, f"{name}: {len(found)} devuser1 blocks in {heading}, expected one"
    assert confirmed(found[0][0]), f"{name}: its block is not confirmed"
print(f"devuser1 blocks for the live task ({len(USER_BLOCKS)})")

wrapped = []
prose = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z`(\[*]")
for n, l in enumerate(lines):
    if n in in_block or n == 0:
        continue
    if prose.match(l) and (n - 1) not in in_block and prose.match(lines[n - 1]):
        wrapped.append(n + 1)
assert not wrapped, f"hard-wrapped prose at lines {wrapped[:10]}"
print("no hard-wrapped prose")

assert shutil.which("shellcheck"), "shellcheck is not installed: install it and run again"
findings = []
preamble = "# shellcheck shell=bash\n# Defined by the lockdown runbook's §0: the in-pod client script.\nsi_inpod_client=''\n"
# The §0 variables are read by later blocks and sessions, so they count as used.
used = "\n: " + " ".join(f'"${{{v}}}"' for v in sorted(set(re.findall(r"^([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)=", helpers, re.M)))) + "\n"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    for n, (start, _, body, _) in enumerate(bashes):
        f = os.path.join(d, f"block-{n}.bash")
        with open(f, "w") as out:
            out.write(preamble + (helpers if not (s0 < start < s1) else "") + "\n" + body + used)
        r = subprocess.run(["shellcheck", "-s", "bash", "-S", "warning", "-f", "gcc", f], capture_output=True, text=True)
        for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
            findings.append(f"block at line {start + 1}: {line.split(':', 3)[-1].strip()}")
assert not findings, "shellcheck -S warning:\n" + "\n".join(sorted(set(findings))[:40])
print(f"shellcheck -S warning clean ({len(bashes)})")
```

````markdown
# Storage integrity devnet2: multi-source stage 3 P2 (one ClickHouse restart per installation, member users, si-members, shadow soak)

This runbook takes devnet2-si-v2 (releases `storage-integrity-si-v2`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b` and `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c`, and the source ClickHouse installations `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b` and `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c`, all in `sentio-network-devnet2`) through stage 3 P2 of the multi-source storage-integrity design. Every SI ClickHouse restarts exactly once, one at a time, with every server change stage 3 needs: `access_control_improvements.table_engines_require_grant`, `keep_free_space_bytes` on every disk, the `member` disk and storage policy, the `<replicated_merge_tree>` merge default 0, `background_fetches_pool_size` 16 and `NOT OVERRIDABLE` named collections whose `si_reader` passwords come from the container environment. Before its restart every user that creates tables holds its table engines by name. After the three restarts the Keeper root `unsafe_inc` exists, then the member user `si_member`, then one si-member per SI indexer host (`member-b`, `member-c`, `member-a`), each in its own StatefulSet, which copies the other two owners' tables by owner pull and P1 restore and shadow-verifies every block it sees, through a soak of at least 24 hours within half the promotion budget. Design: housegate `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` §8.1, §8.2, §8.6, §13.1, §16 row P2 and §17, as clarified by the stage-3 plans (housegate `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3c2-p2-members-code.md`, clarifications K29 to K37, and `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3c3-p2-hosts-rollout.md`, clarifications K38 to K43). It continues [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p1-backups.md) (stage 3 P1: per-owner backups and one verified restore drill per owner), whose end record is a precondition. The stage numbers below are this runbook's own.

| Stage | Change | Way back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | PR: the P2 server bundle, by-name engine grants, the `si_member` user and profile and the named collections in `charts/storage-integrity`, the `siMember` StatefulSet of `charts/sentio-node` and the three host overlays, the member ids, the member monitoring, the logins script, the P2 staging installation, the grant-probe and member live-probe corpora, render tests and this runbook; every value off, inert on merge | Revert the PR |
| 1 | Preparation: pins, identities, the user's logins, preconditions, the promotion budget, the two soak tables (§1) | Drop the soak tables (§12) |
| 2 | Engine census of every SI ClickHouse (§2) | None needed |
| 3 | Staging proof: the bundle restarts the staging ClickHouse once, users reload, the grant probe; the staging installation is deleted again (§3) | None needed |
| 4 | Engine grants by name, users reloads: indexer-b, indexer-c, network (§4) | Revert (§13) |
| 5 | Restart windows, one per installation: indexer-b, indexer-c, network (§5) | Revert, which restarts that installation once more (§13) |
| 6 | The Keeper root `unsafe_inc` (§6) | None: it stays |
| 7 | `si_member`, users reloads: indexer-b, indexer-c, network; the member probe (§7) | Revert (§13) |
| 8 | si-members `member-b`, `member-c`, `member-a`, one host at a time, then the member monitoring (§8) | Turn the member off (§13) |
| 9 | Bootstrap: every member's copies reach the latest published entry of both peer owners (§9) | Turn the members off (§13) |
| 10 | Shadow soak of at least 24 hours with three write rounds per owner (§10) | None needed |
| 11 | Measurements (§11) | None needed |
| 12 | End: the P2 exit criteria, the exit probe, the soak tables dropped (§12) | None needed |

Nothing in this runbook changes consensus state: no Raft command, tag, Raft-reachable field, snapshot version (it stays 20), header byte or feature string, and no consensus update; every arbiter pod keeps its image. The si-members are off consensus: they are never registered, call only the unauthenticated `SafeState` reads (`GetSafeWatermark`, `GetManifest`, `GetBlockVerification`), the table registry reads and DA `GetPayload`, and hold no key, so a member can be stopped and removed at any time. Three things are one-way all the same: the member ids are allocated for good (§1.2 of [storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md)), the `unsafe_inc` znode is never removed, and `table_engines_require_grant` is never turned off again (a missing engine is granted by name, §14.2; turning the setting off would cost every installation another restart).

Each SI ClickHouse restarts exactly once in this runbook (§5), the staging one aside.
````
