With the Write tool install these seven local files under `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41/`, never commit them:

`t41-check.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The independent read-only checks of Plan S3-C3 Task 41 (a throwaway tool, never committed).

  t41-check.py state PHASE SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID ENGINE_CENSUS MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py commit member|monitoring X SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID
  t41-check.py render X RENDER_FILE SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py member-pod X POD_LINE INDEXER_C_ID MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py room BUDGET_START_FILE LIVE_PROMOTION_SEQ PLANNED_WRITES

Run from the root of the live production checkout. X is a member host: a
(member-a on indexer-a, SI indexer 0), b (member-b on indexer-b, 1) or c
(member-c on indexer-c, INDEXER_C_ID); for monitoring X is "-". The member
disk total of host X is $SI_BACKUP/member-disk-X (runbook §1.2), each member's
disk_budget_bytes (decision D28).

state checks test_render.py's rollout constants and every siMember and
monitoring.members value against contract §26.4-§26.7, rebuilt here from the
contract and the ledger rather than read from the runbook's helpers; PHASE is
none, b, bc, bca (the members started so far, in the order b, c, a) or
monitored (all three and the monitoring commit). commit checks that HEAD is
exactly that commit of contract §28.2 on top of HEAD~1: the two files, the
lines that change (comments and layout kept), the values, the subject and the
trailer. render checks an audited direct-Helm rendering of X's host release at HEAD
(contract §26.2, §26.3, decision D29). member-pod checks one JSON line of the
running si-member pod (names and Secret references only, never a value).
room refuses unless the promotions made since budget-start.txt plus the
planned writes stay within half of its budget (contract §27.7). Every check
prints what it compared and ends with one "ok" line, or exits non-zero with a
line ending "stop".
"""

import ast
import copy
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

TESTS = "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
D2 = "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2"
SI_OVERLAY = f"{D2}/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
ORDER = ("b", "c", "a")
RELEASES = ("sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c")
CHIS = ("storage-integrity-si-v2", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c")
POOL = ["si_peer_verifier_1", "si_peer_verifier_2", "si_peer_verifier_3"]
RESTORE = {"endpoint": "https://storage.googleapis.com", "bucket": "sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica"}
TRAILER = "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
MEMBER_KEYS = {
    "node_id", "host_indexer_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "genesis_snapshot_id", "genesis_tables", "clickhouse_dsn",
    "clickhouse_username", "storage_policy", "peers", "pool_collections", "restore", "shadow_verification",
    "stop_installs_ratio", "disk_budget_bytes", "metrics_listen",
}
SECRETISH = re.compile(r"(?i)password|token|secret|key$")
BUDGET = re.compile(r"live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(([0-9]+) bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)$")


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"t41-check: {message}; stop")


def host(x, c):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", str(c)) or not 2 <= int(c) <= 2**64 - 1:
        fail("INDEXER_C_ID must be an observed uint64 distinct from owners 0 and 1")
    c = int(c)
    table = {
        "a": (0, "storage-integrity-si-v2-source:9000", "network", "§8.3"),
        "b": (1, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source:9000", "indexer-b", "§8.1"),
        "c": (c, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source:9000", "indexer-c", "§8.2"),
    }
    if x not in table:
        fail(f"unknown member host {x!r} (a, b or c)")
    indexer, dsn, installation, section = table[x]
    release = f"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-{x}"
    return {
        "x": x,
        "release": release,
        "member": f"member-{x}",
        "indexer": indexer,
        "dsn": dsn,
        "installation": installation,
        "section": section,
        "secret": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-member-{installation}",
        "token": f"{release}-si-member-status-token",
        "restore": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-{x}",
        "overlay": f"{D2}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml",
        "peers": [{"indexer_id": i, "collection": f"si_owner_{i}"} for i in sorted({0, 1, c}) if i != indexer],
        "subject": f"chore(devnet2): start si-member member-{x} on {release}",
    }


def disk_of(si_backup, x):
    text = Path(si_backup, f"member-disk-{x}").read_text().strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", text):
        fail(f"{si_backup}/member-disk-{x} holds {text!r}, not the member disk's total (runbook §1.2)")
    return int(text)


def assignments(source, where):
    out = {}
    for node in ast.parse(source).body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            if node.targets[0].id in out:
                fail(f"{where} assigns {node.targets[0].id} more than once")
            out[node.targets[0].id] = node
    return out


def literal(source, name, where):
    node = assignments(source, where).get(name)
    if node is None:
        fail(f"{where} has no module-level {name}")
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    except ValueError:
        fail(f"{where}: {name} is not a literal")


def constants(source, where):
    """The rollout constants of test_render.py that Task 41 reads, from their literals."""
    image = literal(source, "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE", where)
    images = assignments(source, where).get("MEMBER_IMAGES")
    if images is None or ast.unparse(images.value) != "frozenset({DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE})":
        fail(f"{where}: MEMBER_IMAGES is not frozenset({{DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE}})")
    names = ("DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED", "DEVNET2_MONITORED_HOSTS", "DEVNET2_MONITORED_CLICKHOUSES", "DEVNET2_P2_STAGE", "DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES", "DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS", "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS",
             "DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED", "DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS", "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS")
    out = {name: literal(source, name, where) for name in names}
    out["DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE"] = image
    return out


def started(phase):
    if phase not in ("none", "b", "bc", "bca", "monitored"):
        fail(f"PHASE {phase!r} is none, b, bc, bca or monitored")
    return {"none": "", "b": "b", "bc": "bc", "bca": "bca", "monitored": "bca"}[phase]


class UniqueLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
    pass


def unique_mapping(loader, node, deep=False):
    loader.flatten_mapping(node)
    result = {}
    for key_node, value_node in node.value:
        key = loader.construct_object(key_node, deep=deep)
        if key in result:
            fail("duplicate YAML key; do not log the config value")
        result[key] = loader.construct_object(value_node, deep=deep)
    return result


UniqueLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG, unique_mapping)


def yaml_one(text):
    docs = list(yaml.load_all(text, Loader=UniqueLoader))
    if len(docs) != 1 or not isinstance(docs[0], dict):
        fail("expected one YAML mapping document")
    return docs[0]


def genesis_tables():
    # Current devnet2's pinned genesis schema comes from the actual control
    # overlay. Do not trust the same siMember field being checked.
    control = yaml_one(Path(SI_OVERLAY).read_text())
    table = control.get("table")
    if not isinstance(table, dict) or not isinstance(table.get("id"), str) or not table["id"]:
        fail("control overlay lacks the pinned genesis table identity")
    columns = table.get("columns")
    if not isinstance(columns, list) or not columns:
        fail("control overlay lacks full genesis columns")
    if any(not isinstance(col, dict) or not isinstance(col.get("name"), str) or not col["name"] or
           not isinstance(col.get("type"), str) or not col["type"] for col in columns):
        fail("control overlay has an incomplete genesis column schema")
    partition = table.get("partitionBy", "")
    if not isinstance(partition, str):
        fail("control genesis partition expression is not text")
    return [{"table_id": table["id"], "partition_by": partition, "columns": copy.deepcopy(columns)}]


def expect_member(doc, h, enabled, budget, image, where):
    """Contract §26.5's siMember block of one host overlay, rebuilt from the contract."""
    m = doc.get("siMember")
    if not isinstance(m, dict):
        fail(f"{where} has no siMember block (P2_PR, Task 38)")
    cfg = m.get("config") or {}
    snode = ((doc.get("storageIntegrity") or {}).get("snode")) or {}
    want = {
        "enabled": enabled,
        "image": image,
        "nodeID": h["member"],
        "clickhouseDSN": h["dsn"],
        "secret.name": h["secret"],
        "statusTokenSecret.name": h["token"],
        "restoreSecret.name": h["restore"],
        "reconciler.enabled": False,
        "config.host_indexer_id": h["indexer"],
        "config.genesis_snapshot_id": snode.get("genesisSnapshotID"),
        "config.genesis_tables": genesis_tables(),
        "config.storage_policy": "member",
        "config.peers": h["peers"],
        "config.pool_collections": POOL,
        "config.restore": RESTORE,
        "config.shadow_verification": True,
        "config.stop_installs_ratio": 0.5,
        "config.disk_budget_bytes": budget,
    }
    got = {
        "enabled": m.get("enabled"),
        "image": m.get("image"),
        "nodeID": m.get("nodeID"),
        "clickhouseDSN": m.get("clickhouseDSN"),
        "secret.name": (m.get("secret") or {}).get("name"),
        "statusTokenSecret.name": (m.get("statusTokenSecret") or {}).get("name"),
        "restoreSecret.name": (m.get("restoreSecret") or {}).get("name"),
        "reconciler.enabled": (m.get("reconciler") or {}).get("enabled", False),
    }
    got.update({f"config.{k[7:]}": cfg.get(k[7:]) for k in want if k.startswith("config.")})
    wrong = [f"{k} differs from its reviewed value/type (values withheld)" for k in want if got[k] != want[k] or type(got[k]) is not type(want[k])]
    if not snode.get("genesisSnapshotID"):
        wrong.append("storageIntegrity.snode.genesisSnapshotID is missing")
    tables = cfg.get("genesis_tables")
    if not isinstance(tables, list) or not tables or not all(isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("table_id") for t in tables):
        wrong.append("config.genesis_tables is not the full reviewed genesis schema list")
    extra = sorted(set(cfg) - (MEMBER_KEYS - {"node_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "clickhouse_dsn", "clickhouse_username", "metrics_listen"}))
    if extra:
        wrong.append(f"config carries keys outside Plan S3-C2 contract §24.2: {extra}")
    if wrong:
        fail(f"{where}: " + "; ".join(wrong))


def cmd_state(phase, si_backup, c, census, image):
    on = started(phase)
    source = Path(TESTS).read_text()
    k = constants(source, TESTS)
    gateway = tuple(census.split(","))
    want = {
        "DEVNET2_MONITORING_ENABLED": True,
        "DEVNET2_MONITORED_HOSTS": RELEASES,
        "DEVNET2_MONITORED_CLICKHOUSES": CHIS,
        "DEVNET2_P2_STAGE": dict.fromkeys(CHIS, "member"),
        "DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES": gateway,
        "DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS": dict(zip(RELEASES, (0, 1, int(c)))),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS": dict(zip(RELEASES, ("member-a", "member-b", "member-c"))),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE": image,
        "DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED": {r: r[-1] in on for r in RELEASES},
        "DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS": RELEASES if phase == "monitored" else (),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS": CHIS if phase == "monitored" else (),
    }
    wrong = [f"{name} is {k[name]!r}, expected {value!r}" for name, value in want.items() if k[name] != value or type(k[name]) is not type(value)]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"{TESTS}: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    print(f"{TESTS}: every installation at stage member, DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES {census}, "
          f"members enabled [{', '.join('member-' + x for x in ORDER if x in on)}], "
          f"monitored {'all three' if phase == 'monitored' else 'none'}")
    for x in ("a", "b", "c"):
        h = host(x, c)
        enabled = x in on
        expect_member(yaml_one(Path(h["overlay"]).read_text()), h, enabled, disk_of(si_backup, x) if enabled else 0, image, h["overlay"])
        print(f"{h['overlay']}: siMember {h['member']} as contract §26.5 gives it, "
              + (f"on with disk_budget_bytes {disk_of(si_backup, x)}" if enabled else "off with disk_budget_bytes 0"))
    monitoring = (yaml_one(Path(SI_OVERLAY).read_text()) or {}).get("monitoring") or {}
    if monitoring.get("enabled") is not True:
        fail("P2 requires monitoring.enabled=true; a historical waiver never applies to this later phase")
    members = monitoring.get("members") or {}
    lists = (list(RELEASES), list(CHIS)) if phase == "monitored" else ([], [])
    if (members.get("releases"), members.get("installations")) != lists:
        fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members is {members!r}, expected releases {lists[0]} and installations {lists[1]}")
    print(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members releases {lists[0]}, installations {lists[1]}")
    print(f"state {phase} ok")


def git(*args):
    out = subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"git {' '.join(args)}: {out.stderr.strip()}")
    return out.stdout


def hunks(old, new):
    """(first old line, last old line, old lines, new lines) of every change, 1-based; an insertion has last = first - 1."""
    a, b = old.split("\n"), new.split("\n")
    return [(i1 + 1, i2, a[i1:i2], b[j1:j2])
            for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if tag != "equal"]


def replaced_lines(old, new, where):
    """(old line, new line) of every replaced line; an added or removed line fails."""
    out = []
    for first, last, a, b in hunks(old, new):
        if len(a) != len(b):
            fail(f"{where}: the change adds or removes lines at old line {first}: only replaced lines are expected")
        out.extend(zip(a, b))
    return out


def line_span(source, name):
    node = assignments(source, TESTS)[name]
    return node.lineno, node.end_lineno


def rest_equal(old, new, names):
    def rest(source):
        return [ast.dump(n) for n in ast.parse(source).body
                if not (isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id in names)]
    if rest(old) != rest(new):
        fail(f"the commit changes {TESTS} beyond {', '.join(sorted(names))}")


def check_tests_change(old, new, edits):
    """edits: name -> (old value, new value); nothing else in test_render.py may change."""
    rest_equal(old, new, set(edits))
    covered = {n for name in edits for n in range(line_span(old, name)[0], line_span(old, name)[1] + 1)}
    for first, last, _, _ in hunks(old, new):
        touched = set(range(first, last + 1)) if last >= first else {first - 1, first} & covered or {first}
        if not touched <= covered:
            fail(f"{TESTS} lines {first}-{last} change outside {', '.join(edits)}")
    for name, (before, after) in edits.items():
        if literal(old, name, f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}") != before or literal(new, name, f"HEAD:{TESTS}") != after:
            fail(f"{TESTS}: {name} goes from {literal(old, name, TESTS)!r} to {literal(new, name, TESTS)!r}, "
                 f"expected {before!r} to {after!r}")


def message_ok(subject):
    message = git("log", "-1", "--format=%B").rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    if message[0] != subject:
        fail(f"HEAD's subject is {message[0]!r}, expected {subject!r} (contract §28.2)")
    trailers = [line for line in message if re.match(r"(?i)^co-authored-by\s*:", line)]
    if message[-1] != TRAILER or trailers != [TRAILER]:
        fail("HEAD must contain exactly the canonical Claude coauthor trailer")
    if git("log", "-1", "--format=%an <%ae>").strip() != "poetry <chen@sentio.xyz>":
        fail("HEAD primary author is not poetry <chen@sentio.xyz>")
    if git("log", "-1", "--format=%G?").strip() != "G":
        fail("HEAD has no good GPG signature")
    git("verify-commit", "HEAD")


def cmd_commit(kind, x, si_backup, c):
    files = sorted(git("diff", "--name-only", "HEAD~1", "HEAD").split())
    if kind == "member":
        h = host(x, c)
        budget = disk_of(si_backup, x)
        if files != sorted([h["overlay"], TESTS]):
            fail(f"HEAD changes {files}, expected {h['overlay']} and {TESTS}")
        old, new = git("show", f"HEAD~1:{h['overlay']}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{h['overlay']}")
        lines = replaced_lines(old, new, h["overlay"])
        want = [("  enabled: false", "  enabled: true"), ("    disk_budget_bytes: 0", f"    disk_budget_bytes: {budget}")]
        if [(o.rstrip(), n.rstrip()) for o, n in lines] != want:
            fail(f"{h['overlay']}: the changed lines are {lines}, expected {want}")
        a, b = yaml_one(old), yaml_one(new)
        a["siMember"]["enabled"] = True
        a["siMember"]["config"]["disk_budget_bytes"] = budget
        if a != b:
            fail(f"{h['overlay']}: the YAML changes beyond siMember.enabled and siMember.config.disk_budget_bytes")
        expect_member(b, h, True, budget, b["siMember"].get("image"), f"HEAD:{h['overlay']}")
        enabled_before = {r: r[-1] in ORDER[:ORDER.index(x)] for r in RELEASES}
        check_tests_change(git("show", f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{TESTS}"),
                           {"DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED": (enabled_before, dict(enabled_before, **{h["release"]: True}))})
        message_ok(h["subject"])
        print(f"HEAD {git('rev-parse', '--short=9', 'HEAD').strip()}: {h['subject']}; {h['overlay']} siMember.enabled false -> true "
              f"and siMember.config.disk_budget_bytes 0 -> {budget} (two lines); {TESTS} DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[{h['release']!r}] False -> True")
        print(f"commit member-{x} ok")
    elif kind == "monitoring":
        if x != "-":
            fail("monitoring takes X '-'")
        if files != sorted([SI_OVERLAY, TESTS]):
            fail(f"HEAD changes {files}, expected {SI_OVERLAY} and {TESTS}")
        old, new = git("show", f"HEAD~1:{SI_OVERLAY}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{SI_OVERLAY}")
        a, b = yaml_one(old), yaml_one(new)
        if (a["monitoring"]["members"]["releases"], a["monitoring"]["members"]["installations"]) != ([], []):
            fail(f"HEAD~1:{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members is not the PR's empty lists")
        a["monitoring"]["members"]["releases"] = list(RELEASES)
        a["monitoring"]["members"]["installations"] = list(CHIS)
        if a != b:
            fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: the YAML changes beyond monitoring.members.releases and .installations")
        start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(old.split("\n"), 1) if line.rstrip() == "monitoring:")
        end = next((i for i, line in enumerate(old.split("\n"), 1) if i > start and re.match(r"[A-Za-z_]", line)), len(old.split("\n")) + 1)
        for first, last, _, _ in hunks(old, new):
            if not (start < first and max(first, last) < end):
                fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: old lines {first}-{last} change outside the monitoring block (lines {start}-{end - 1})")
        check_tests_change(git("show", f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{TESTS}"),
                           {"DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS": ((), RELEASES), "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS": ((), CHIS)})
        message_ok("chore(devnet2): monitor the si-members")
        print(f"HEAD {git('rev-parse', '--short=9', 'HEAD').strip()}: chore(devnet2): monitor the si-members; {SI_OVERLAY} "
              f"monitoring.members releases {list(RELEASES)} and installations {list(CHIS)}; {TESTS} DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS "
              "and DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS the same tuples")
        print("commit monitoring ok")
    else:
        fail(f"commit kind {kind!r} is member or monitoring")


def objects(path):
    out = {}
    for doc in yaml.load_all(Path(path).read_text(), Loader=UniqueLoader):
        if doc:
            key = (doc["kind"], doc["metadata"]["name"])
            if key in out:
                fail("duplicate rendered Kubernetes object identity")
            out[key] = doc
    return out


def secret_refs(pod_spec):
    refs = set()
    for c in (pod_spec.get("containers") or []) + (pod_spec.get("initContainers") or []):
        for e in c.get("env") or []:
            ref = ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("name")
            if ref:
                refs.add(ref)
        for e in c.get("envFrom") or []:
            if (e.get("secretRef") or {}).get("name"):
                refs.add(e["secretRef"]["name"])
    for v in pod_spec.get("volumes") or []:
        if (v.get("secret") or {}).get("secretName"):
            refs.add(v["secret"]["secretName"])
        for s in (v.get("projected") or {}).get("sources") or []:
            if (s.get("secret") or {}).get("name"):
                refs.add(s["secret"]["name"])
    return refs


def secret_keys_in(value, path=""):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for k, v in value.items():
            if SECRETISH.search(str(k)):
                yield f"{path}{k}"
            yield from secret_keys_in(v, f"{path}{k}.")
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(value):
            yield from secret_keys_in(v, f"{path}{i}.")


def env_refs(container):
    return sorted(
        (e["name"], ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("name"),
         ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("key"), "value" in e)
        for e in container.get("env") or [])


def want_env(h):
    return sorted([
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD", h["secret"], "clickhouse-password", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID", h["restore"], "access-id", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET", h["restore"], "secret", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN", h["token"], "status-token", False),
    ])


def cmd_render(x, render_file, si_backup, c, image):
    h = host(x, c)
    budget = disk_of(si_backup, x)
    r = h["release"]
    objs = objects(render_file)
    member_objs = sorted(k for k in objs if k[1].startswith(f"{r}-si-member"))
    want_objs = sorted([("ConfigMap", f"{r}-si-member-config"), ("Service", f"{r}-si-member"), ("StatefulSet", f"{r}-si-member")])
    if member_objs != want_objs:
        fail(f"the rendering of {r} holds the member objects {member_objs}, expected {want_objs}")
    overlay = yaml_one(Path(h["overlay"]).read_text())
    si = overlay["storageIntegrity"]
    cm = objs[("ConfigMap", f"{r}-si-member-config")]
    if sorted(cm.get("data") or {}) != ["si-member.yaml"]:
        fail(f"ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config holds {sorted(cm.get('data') or {})}, expected only si-member.yaml")
    text = cm["data"]["si-member.yaml"]
    conf = yaml_one(text)
    if sorted(conf) != ["storage_integrity"] or sorted(conf["storage_integrity"]) != ["arbiter_peers", "member", "payload_store_data_addr"]:
        fail("si-member.yaml has unexpected top-level keys; values withheld")
    member = conf["storage_integrity"]["member"]
    want = {
        "node_id": h["member"], "host_indexer_id": h["indexer"], "state_dir": "/data/si-member",
        "network_id": si["snode"]["networkID"], "genesis_snapshot_id": si["snode"]["genesisSnapshotID"],
        "genesis_tables": genesis_tables(), "clickhouse_dsn": h["dsn"],
        "clickhouse_username": "si_member", "storage_policy": "member", "peers": h["peers"], "pool_collections": POOL,
        "restore": RESTORE, "shadow_verification": True, "stop_installs_ratio": 0.5, "disk_budget_bytes": budget,
        "metrics_listen": ":9095",
    }
    if set(member) != MEMBER_KEYS:
        fail(f"si-member.yaml's member keys are {sorted(member)}, expected {sorted(MEMBER_KEYS)}")
    wrong = [f"{k} differs from the reviewed expected value (values withheld)" for k, v in want.items() if member[k] != v or type(member[k]) is not type(v)]
    if conf["storage_integrity"]["arbiter_peers"] != si["arbiterPeers"]:
        wrong.append("arbiter_peers differ from the host's storageIntegrity.arbiterPeers")
    if conf["storage_integrity"]["payload_store_data_addr"] != si["payloadStoreDataAddr"]:
        wrong.append("payload_store_data_addr differs from the host's storageIntegrity.payloadStoreDataAddr")
    leaked = list(secret_keys_in(conf))
    if leaked:
        wrong.append(f"si-member.yaml carries secret-looking keys {leaked}")
    if wrong:
        fail(f"ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    sts = objs[("StatefulSet", f"{r}-si-member")]
    tpl = sts["spec"]["template"]
    spec = tpl["spec"]
    containers = spec.get("containers") or []
    checks = {
        "replicas": (sts["spec"].get("replicas"), 1),
        "containers": ([c_["name"] for c_ in containers], ["si-member"]),
        "initContainers": (spec.get("initContainers"), None),
        "image": (containers[0].get("image") if containers else None, image),
        "command": (containers[0].get("command") if containers else None, ["/sentio-node"]),
        "args": (containers[0].get("args") if containers else None, ["si-member", "--config-path", "/config/si-member.yaml"]),
        "env": (env_refs(containers[0]) if containers else None, want_env(h)),
        "envFrom": (containers[0].get("envFrom") if containers else None, None),
        "ports": (sorted((p["name"], p["containerPort"]) for p in containers[0].get("ports") or []) if containers else None, [("metrics", 9095), ("status", 9096)]),
        "nodeSelector": (spec.get("nodeSelector"), {"sentio.xyz/general": "true"}),
        "automountServiceAccountToken": (spec.get("automountServiceAccountToken"), False),
        "volumes": (sorted((v["name"], (v.get("configMap") or {}).get("name")) for v in spec.get("volumes") or []), [("config", f"{r}-si-member-config")]),
        "volumeClaimTemplates": ([(v["metadata"]["name"], v["spec"].get("storageClassName"), v["spec"]["resources"]["requests"]["storage"]) for v in sts["spec"].get("volumeClaimTemplates") or []], [("si-member-state", "local-path", "1Gi")]),
        "member-id label": (tpl["metadata"]["labels"].get("storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id"), h["member"]),
        "component label": (tpl["metadata"]["labels"].get("app.kubernetes.io/component"), "si-member"),
        "checksum/si-member-config": ((tpl["metadata"].get("annotations") or {}).get("checksum/si-member-config"), hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()),
    }
    wrong = [f"{k} is {got!r}, expected {exp!r}" for k, (got, exp) in checks.items() if got != exp]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"StatefulSet {r}-si-member: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    svc = objs[("Service", f"{r}-si-member")]
    ports = sorted((p["name"], p["port"]) for p in svc["spec"].get("ports") or [])
    if ports != [("metrics", 9095), ("status", 9096)] or svc["spec"].get("selector", {}).get("storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id") != h["member"]:
        fail(f"Service {r}-si-member: ports {ports}, selector {svc['spec'].get('selector')}")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+:[^@\s]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image):
        fail(f"the member image {image!r} is not digest-pinned")
    host_sts = objs.get(("StatefulSet", r))
    if host_sts is None:
        fail(f"the rendering of {r} has no host StatefulSet {r}")
    refs = secret_refs(host_sts["spec"]["template"]["spec"])
    if refs & {h["secret"], h["token"], h["restore"]}:
        fail(f"the host StatefulSet {r} references {sorted(refs & {h['secret'], h['token'], h['restore']})}: the member Secrets reach only the si-member container (D29)")
    for (kind, name), doc in objs.items():
        if kind in ("Deployment", "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet", "Job", "CronJob") and name != f"{r}-si-member":
            pod = doc["spec"]["template"]["spec"] if kind != "CronJob" else doc["spec"]["jobTemplate"]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
            if secret_refs(pod) & {h["secret"], h["token"]}:
                fail(f"{kind} {name} references a member Secret (D29)")
    print(f"rendering of {r}: ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config (si-member.yaml: node_id {h['member']}, host_indexer_id {h['indexer']}, "
          f"clickhouse_dsn {h['dsn']} as si_member, peers {[p['indexer_id'] for p in h['peers']]}, disk_budget_bytes {budget}, "
          f"stop_installs_ratio 0.5, no secret), StatefulSet {r}-si-member (one container si-member on {image}, env only from "
          f"{h['secret']}, {h['token']} and {h['restore']}, checksum of its own config), Service {r}-si-member (metrics 9095, status 9096); "
          f"the host StatefulSet references no member Secret")
    print(f"render member-{x} ok")


def cmd_member_pod(x, line, c, image):
    h = host(x, c)
    try:
        pod = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        fail(f"the pod line of member-{x} is not JSON")
    want = {
        "pod": f"{h['release']}-si-member-0",
        "member_id": h["member"],
        "containers": ["si-member"],
        "init": [],
        "image": image,
        "sa_token": False,
        "restarts": 0,
        "env": [dict(zip(("name", "secret", "key", "inline"), e)) for e in want_env(h)],
        "volumes": sorted([
            {"name": "config", "configMap": f"{h['release']}-si-member-config", "secret": None, "pvc": None},
            {"name": "si-member-state", "configMap": None, "secret": None, "pvc": f"si-member-state-{h['release']}-si-member-0"},
        ], key=lambda v: v["name"]),
    }
    if not isinstance(pod, dict) or not isinstance(pod.get("uid"), str) or not pod["uid"]:
        fail("member pod UID is missing")
    if not isinstance(pod.get("container_id"), str) or not pod["container_id"]:
        fail("member container identity is missing")
    if pod.get("phase") != "Running" or pod.get("ready") is not True:
        fail("member process is not Running/Ready on its metrics readiness probe")
    got = dict(pod)
    got["env"] = sorted(pod.get("env") or [], key=lambda e: e["name"])
    got["volumes"] = sorted(pod.get("volumes") or [], key=lambda v: v["name"])
    wrong = [f"{k} is {got.get(k)!r}, expected {v!r}" for k, v in want.items() if got.get(k) != v or type(got.get(k)) is not type(v)]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"pod {want['pod']}: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    print(f"pod {want['pod']} on node {pod.get('node')} (ready {str(pod.get('ready')).lower()}): one container si-member on the member image, no restart, member id {h['member']}, "
          f"no service-account token, env only from {h['secret']}/clickhouse-password, {h['token']}/status-token and "
          f"{h['restore']}/access-id,secret, volumes config and si-member-state only")
    print(f"member-pod member-{x} ok")


def cmd_room(path, live_now, planned):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if BUDGET.search(line.strip())]
    if len(lines) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: expected one budget line of the §13.4 estimator, found {len(lines)}")
    live, _, budget, half = map(int, BUDGET.search(lines[0]).groups())
    if half != budget // 2:
        fail(f"{path}: 'a drill spends at most {half}' is not half of {budget}")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", live_now) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", planned):
        fail(f"LIVE_PROMOTION_SEQ {live_now!r} and PLANNED_WRITES {planned!r} must be decimal")
    spent = int(live_now) - live
    if spent < 0:
        fail(f"the live promotion sequence {live_now} is below the start's {live}")
    if spent + int(planned) > budget // 2:
        fail(f"{spent} promotions since budget-start.txt plus {planned} planned exceed half the budget ({budget // 2}): "
             "P2 stops before writing (contract §27.7)")
    print(f"budget room ok: {spent} promotions since budget-start.txt (live {live} -> {live_now}), {planned} planned, "
          f"{budget // 2 - spent - int(planned)} to spare of half the budget ({budget // 2})")


def cmd_disk(x, line, recorded, keep):
    cells = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if len(cells) != 6 or x not in ("a","b","c"):
        fail("disk projection must be one exact six-column row")
    name,path,total,free,reserve,metric = cells
    if any(not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+",v) for v in (total,free,reserve,metric,recorded,keep)):
        fail("disk projection contains non-integer sizes")
    if name != "member" or path != ("/var/lib/clickhouse-member/" if x=="c" else "/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member/"):
        fail("unexpected member disk name/path")
    if int(total)<=0 or int(total)!=int(recorded) or int(metric)!=int(total) or int(reserve)!=int(keep) or not 0<=int(free)<=int(total) or 2*(int(total)-int(free))>=int(total):
        fail("disk total/metric/reserve differs or used space reaches half")
    print(f"member disk {x} ok: total {total}, keep_free_space {keep}, used {int(total)-int(free)} bytes below half")


def cmd_images(path, digest):
    expected={f"storage-integrity-si-v2-{kind}-{i}" for kind in ("arbiter","verifier") for i in range(3)}
    rows=[line.split("\t") for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows)!=6 or any(len(r)!=3 for r in rows) or {r[0]for r in rows}!=expected:
        fail("expected exactly three arbiter and three verifier pod image rows")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",digest) or any(not r[1].endswith("@"+digest) or not r[2].endswith(digest) for r in rows):
        fail("an arbiter/verifier image or runtime imageID differs from ARBITER_DIGEST")
    print("six arbiter/verifier images and runtime imageIDs match ARBITER_DIGEST")


def cmd_identities(path, taskdir):
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows)!=3 or {r.get("member") for r in rows}!={"member-a","member-b","member-c"}:
        fail("identity evidence must contain exactly the three members")
    for x in ("a","b","c"):
        row=next(r for r in rows if r["member"]=="member-"+x)
        baseline=json.loads(Path(taskdir,f"member-{x}-identity.json").read_text())
        expected={"member":"member-"+x,"uid":baseline.get("uid"),"containerID":baseline.get("container_id"),"restarts":0,"ready":True}
        if row!=expected or type(row.get("restarts"))is not int or type(row.get("ready"))is not bool or not expected["uid"] or not expected["containerID"]:
            fail("a member pod/container identity, restart counter or readiness changed since its window")
    print("member identities match the three completed windows")


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 6 and argv[0] == "state":
        cmd_state(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 5 and argv[0] == "commit":
        cmd_commit(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 6 and argv[0] == "render":
        cmd_render(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 5 and argv[0] == "member-pod":
        cmd_member_pod(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 4 and argv[0] == "room":
        cmd_room(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 6 and argv[0] == "disk":
        cmd_disk(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "images":
        cmd_images(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "identities":
        cmd_identities(*argv[1:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The records of Plan S3-C3 Task 41 (a throwaway tool, never committed).

  t41-record.py paragraph SI_BACKUP T41
  t41-record.py insert RUNBOOK PARAGRAPH_FILE
  t41-record.py ledger SI_BACKUP T41 RECORD_PR

paragraph prints the record of the run for the end of runbook §12, one line
built only from the evidence the runbook's blocks wrote under SI_BACKUP, the
ledger values Task 41 read (T41/ledger-41.env) and the time member-b's window
passed (T41/member-b-ok); a missing or malformed piece of evidence stops it. insert puts that line into RUNBOOK (a checkout's
docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md) right after the line
"The record of each run of this runbook follows this paragraph, added by its
outcome record PR (docs only).", followed by "## 13. Rollback" as before, and
refuses a runbook that has the anchor other than once in §12 or holds a
record already. ledger prints the run record of P2_END for Appendix C (one
paragraph, then the steady state after P2 for Plan S3-C4 as "- " lines).
"""

import json
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import math
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ANCHOR = "The record of each run of this runbook follows this paragraph, added by its outcome record PR (docs only)."
HOSTS = ("a", "v1", "v2", "v3", "b", "c")


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"t41-record: {message}; nothing written; stop")


def read(si_backup, name):
    path = Path(si_backup, name)
    if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
        fail(f"{path} is missing or empty")
    return path.read_text()


def one(text, pattern, where):
    found = re.findall(pattern, text, re.M)
    if len(found) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one line matching {pattern!r}, found {len(found)}")
    return found[0]


def key_values(text, required, where):
    out = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line or "=" not in line:
            fail(f"{where}: expected nonempty KEY=VALUE lines")
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*", key) or not value or key in out:
            fail(f"{where}: malformed or duplicate key (values withheld)")
        out[key] = value
    if not set(required) <= set(out):
        fail(f"{where}: required keys missing")
    return out


def ledger_values(path):
    out = key_values(Path(path).read_text(), ("SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2", "SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2", "INDEXER_C_ID", "P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK", "ARBITER_PIN_P2", "P2_PR", "MEMBER_IDS"), path)
    c = out["INDEXER_C_ID"]
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", c) or not 2 <= int(c) <= 2**64 - 1:
        fail("invalid observed INDEXER_C_ID")
    if out["MEMBER_IDS"] != f"member-a:0,member-b:1,member-c:{c}":
        fail("MEMBER_IDS differs from the recorded host mapping")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", out["P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK"]) or int(out["P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK"]) < 500:
        fail("Task 36 release-path full soak is below 500")
    return out


def utc(text):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z", text):
        fail("expected exact UTC second timestamp")
    try:
        return int(dt.datetime.strptime(text, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc).timestamp())
    except ValueError:
        fail("invalid UTC calendar timestamp")


def integer(value, where):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", value):
        fail(f"{where}: expected nonnegative decimal integer")
    return int(value)


def pairs(c):
    return {("member-a", "1"), ("member-a", c), ("member-b", "0"), ("member-b", c), ("member-c", "0"), ("member-c", "1")}


def samples(text, c, where):
    rows = []
    seen = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        cells = line.split("\t")
        if len(cells) != 12 or (cells[1], cells[2]) not in pairs(c):
            fail(f"{where}: sample does not have 12 columns or an expected peer pair")
        row = [utc(cells[0]), cells[1], cells[2]]
        for i, cell in enumerate(cells[3:], 3):
            try:
                value = float(cell)
            except ValueError:
                fail(f"{where}: sample numeric value is malformed")
            if not math.isfinite(value) or value < 0:
                fail(f"{where}: sample value is negative/non-finite")
            if i not in (7, 11):
                value = integer(cell, where)
            row.append(value)
        if row[4] != 0 or row[11] >= 0.5:
            fail(f"{where}: mismatch or member disk at/above 50 percent")
        key = tuple(row[:3])
        if key in seen:
            if seen[key] != row:
                fail(f"{where}: conflicting same-second observations")
            continue
        seen[key] = row
        rows.append(row)
    if not rows:
        fail(f"{where}: no samples")
    return rows


def raw_soak(si_backup, c, start, end, k):
    lo = integer(start["SOAK_START_SEALED"], "start sealed") + 1
    hi = integer(end["SOAK_END_SEALED"], "end sealed")
    begin, finish = utc(start["SOAK_START_UTC"]), utc(end["SOAK_END_UTC"])
    if finish - begin < 86400 or hi < lo:
        fail("soak window must span at least 24h and contain sealed blocks")
    rows = samples(read(si_backup, "soak.tsv"), c, "soak.tsv")
    grouped = {key: [s for s in rows if (s[1], s[2]) == key] for key in pairs(c)}
    for key, values in grouped.items():
        times = [s[0] for s in values]
        if not values or times != sorted(set(times)) or times[0] != begin or times[-1] != finish or any(b-a > 3600 for a,b in zip(times,times[1:])):
            fail(f"soak.tsv: {key} does not cover exact start/end with ordered samples at most one hour apart")
        if any(any(b[i] < a[i] for i in (3,4,5,6,8,9,10)) for a,b in zip(values, values[1:])):
            fail(f"soak.tsv: {key} counter or cursor reset")
    blocks = [json.loads(line) for line in read(si_backup, "blocks-soak.jsonl").splitlines()]
    if sorted(b.get("block_seq") for b in blocks) != list(range(lo,hi+1)):
        fail("block provenance is incomplete, duplicated or outside the frozen range")
    counts = {o:0 for o in ("0", "1", c)}
    for b in blocks:
        if type(b.get("block_seq")) is not int or type(b.get("owner")) is not int or type(b.get("transition")) is not bool or b.get("verdict_evaluated") is not True or b.get("quorum") is not True:
            fail("a sealed block lacks exact typed evaluated/quorum provenance")
        owner = str(b["owner"])
        if owner not in counts:
            fail("a sealed block belongs to an unexpected owner")
        if not b["transition"]:
            counts[owner] += 1
    if any(n < 3*k for n in counts.values()):
        fail("an owner has fewer than its three rounds' writes sealed")
    for (member,owner), values in grouped.items():
        if values[-1][3] - values[0][3] < counts[owner]:
            fail(f"{member} did not shadow every sealed non-transition block of owner {owner}")
    for r in (1,2,3):
        before = samples(read(si_backup,f"soak-round-{r}-before.tsv"),c,f"round {r} before")
        after = samples(read(si_backup,f"soak-round-{r}-after.tsv"),c,f"round {r} after")
        if len(before) != 6 or len(after) != 6 or {(s[1],s[2]) for s in before} != pairs(c) or {(s[1],s[2]) for s in after} != pairs(c):
            fail(f"round {r}: not exactly six pairs on both sides")
        for key in pairs(c):
            a = next(s for s in before if (s[1],s[2]) == key)
            z = next(s for s in after if (s[1],s[2]) == key)
            if not begin+(r-1)*43200 <= a[0] <= z[0] <= finish or any(z[i]<a[i] for i in (3,4,5,6,8,9,10)) or z[3]-a[3]<k or z[3]-a[3]-(z[5]-a[5])<1 or z[7]!=0:
                fail(f"round {r}: timing/counter/byte-scan/copy frontier check failed")
        for owner in ('a','b','c'):
            attempted = utc(read(si_backup,f"soak-writes-{r}-{owner}.done").strip())
            if not max(row[0] for row in before) <= attempted <= min(row[0] for row in after):
                fail(f"round {r}: write attempt marker is outside its actual before/after samples")
    return counts, max(s[11] for s in rows)


def budget_line(text, where):
    hits = re.findall(r"^.*; live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(([0-9]+) bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)$", text, re.M)
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one actual estimator line")
    live, limit, bound, half = map(int, hits[0])
    if limit <= 0 or half != bound//2:
        fail(f"{where}: estimator half/limit is invalid")
    return live, bound, half


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def a_plan(si_backup, rnd, source):
    """Bind the consumer to the frozen owner0 loop and original finished-snapshot budget."""
    if rnd not in ('1', '2', '3'):
        raise ValueError('owner0 round must be exactly1,2or3')
    lines = source.splitlines()
    required = (
        '# block p2-10-3', 'r=1',
        'source "$si_backup/soak-start"',
        'si_p2_soak_budget "$SOAK_K" || exit 1',
        'lo=$((5202 + (r - 1) * SOAK_K)); hi=$((5201 + r * SOAK_K))',
        '  for v in $(seq "$lo" "$hi"); do si_p2_soak_budget 1 || exit 1; si_accept_a_track "$v" || exit 1; si_p2_soak_budget 0 || exit 1; done',
    )
    if not lines or lines[0] != required[0] or any(lines.count(line) != 1 for line in required):
        raise ValueError('owner0 source marker/round/value loop/budget guards changed')
    backup = Path(si_backup)
    start = {}
    for line in (backup / 'soak-start').read_text().splitlines():
        key, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if not sep or key in start or not re.fullmatch(r'SOAK_[A-Z0-9_]+', key) or not value:
            raise ValueError('malformed/duplicate frozen soak-start field')
        start[key] = value
    if (backup / 'soak-k').read_text() != start.get('SOAK_K', '') + '\n' or start.get('SOAK_K') not in ('1', '2', '3'):
        raise ValueError('soak-k differs from the frozen start')
    budget = (backup / 'budget-start.txt').read_text()
    hits = re.findall(r'^.*; live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(134217728 bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)$', budget, re.M)
    if len(hits) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected the one original finished-snapshot L/4 estimator line')
    live, bound, half = map(int, hits[0])
    k = int(start['SOAK_K'])
    if start.get('SOAK_B') != str(bound) or start.get('SOAK_L0') != str(live) or half != bound // 2 or k != min(3, (half - 3) // 9) or 9*k + 3 > half:
        raise ValueError('frozen k/B/L0 differs from the original P2 half budget')
    r = int(rnd)
    return dict(round=r, k=k, owner=0, table='devnet101.swap_new2',
                lo=5202+(r-1)*k, hi=5201+r*k,
                soak_start_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'soak-start').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                soak_k_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'soak-k').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                budget_start_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'budget-start.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest())


def a_readback(text, plan):
    """Native counts are bare lines, bound by the exact frozen header and ordered loop."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    prefix = f"round {plan['round']} owner a (track 0): values {plan['lo']} to {plan['hi']} into {plan['table']}, from "
    headers = [(i, line[len(prefix):]) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(prefix)]
    if len(headers) != 1 or len([line for line in lines if line.startswith('round ')]) != 1:
        raise ValueError('missing/duplicate/wrong round/owner/track/value/table header')
    header, stamp = headers[0]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z', stamp):
        raise ValueError('invalid actual owner0 header timestamp')
    dt.datetime.strptime(stamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    tracks = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('track ')]
    if len(tracks) != plan['k'] or any(i <= header for i in tracks):
        raise ValueError('expected exactly k track0/count pairs after the frozen header')
    rows = []
    for value, index in zip(range(plan['lo'], plan['hi']+1), tracks):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'track 0 published ([0-9]+) -> ([0-9]+)', lines[index])
        if match is None or index+1 >= len(lines) or lines[index+1] != '1':
            raise ValueError('each actual advancing track0 must be immediately followed by bare1')
        before, after = map(int, match.groups())
        if after <= before or (rows and before < rows[-1]['published_after']):
            raise ValueError('owner0 published frontier did not advance in ordered calls')
        if index+2 < len(lines) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', lines[index+2]):
            raise ValueError('ambiguous additional native count after a readback')
        rows.append(dict(value=value, track=0, published_before=before, published_after=after, count=1))
    if len(rows) != plan['k']:
        raise ValueError('incomplete owner0 frozen value range')
    return dict(plan=plan, readbacks=rows)


def execution_receipts(t41, si_backup):
    task = Path(t41).resolve()
    session = task.parent
    snapshot_path = session / "runbook-snapshot.json"
    snapshot_hash = digest(snapshot_path)
    snapshot = json.loads(snapshot_path.read_text())
    actions = [("p2-8-1-3","41-13-member-b-apply",None), ("p2-8-2-3","41-23-member-c-apply",None),
               ("p2-8-3-3","41-33-member-a-apply",None), ("p2-8-4-2","41-42-monitor-apply",None),
               ("p2-12-2","41-81-exit-probe-b",None), ("p2-12-3","41-82-exit-probe-c",None),
               ("p2-12-4","41-83-exit-probe-network",None), ("p2-12-6","41-90-drop-b",None),
               ("p2-12-7","41-91-drop-c",None)]
    for r in (1,2,3):
        actions.append(("p2-10-3",f"41-{51+3*(r-1):02d}-soak-r{r}-a",str(r)))
        for x in ('b','c'):
            actions.append(("p2-10-"+('4' if x=='b' else '5'),f"41-{60+2*(r-1)+(x=='c'):02d}-soak-r{r}-{x}",str(r)))
    for marker,label,rnd in actions:
        source = snapshot["blocks"].get(marker)
        if source is None or source.get("confirmed") is not True:
            fail("execution marker is not a confirmed block of the frozen runbook")
        approval_path = task / f"approval-{label}.json"
        approval = json.loads(approval_path.read_text())
        result = json.loads(task.joinpath(f"run-{label}.json").read_text())
        script = session / "blocks" / (label+".sh")
        meta = json.loads(script.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
        identity = marker + ('-r'+rnd if rnd is not None else '')
        claim = json.loads(session.joinpath("claims",identity+'.started').read_text())
        if any(approval.get(k)!=v for k,v in dict(marker=marker,label=label,round=rnd,snapshot_sha256=snapshot_hash,source_body_sha256=source["source_body_sha256"]).items()) or not approval.get("chat_reference","").strip():
            fail("approval is not bound to this exact source marker, round and frozen session")
        gate=Path(approval["gate_file"])
        if gate.parent != task or digest(gate)!=approval["gate_sha256"]:
            fail("approval gate evidence changed")
        output=task / ("run-"+label+".out")
        if any(result.get(k)!=v for k,v in dict(marker=marker,label=label,round=rnd,exit_code=0,prepared_file=str(script),prepared_sha256=digest(script),output_file=str(output),output_sha256=digest(output),approval_sha256=digest(approval_path),snapshot_sha256=snapshot_hash).items()) or type(result.get("exit_code")) is not int:
            fail("an action is missing successful exact-script/output execution evidence; keep unknown outcomes, never replay")
        if meta.get("source_body_sha256")!=source["source_body_sha256"] or meta.get("rendered_sha256")!=digest(script) or meta.get("marker")!=marker or meta.get("round")!=rnd or claim!={"identity":identity,"label":label,"rendered_sha256":digest(script)}:
            fail("prepared metadata/one-shot claim differs from the executed action")
        if marker == 'p2-10-3':
            try:
                expected_readback = a_readback(output.read_text(), a_plan(si_backup, rnd, source['body']))
            except (ValueError, OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
                fail('owner0 safe readback unverified: '+str(error)+'; whole round remains unknown, never replay')
            if result.get('completion_status') != 'complete' or result.get('safe_readback_error') is not None or result.get('safe_readback') != expected_readback:
                fail('owner0 completion receipt does not bind every native bare1/track/value and original budget')
        if not utc(approval["approved_at"])<=utc(result["started_at"])<=utc(result["finished_at"]):
            fail("approval was recorded after execution")
    for x in ('a','b','c'):
        before=task / f"host-{x}-before.txt"
        after=task / f"host-{x}-final.txt"
        if before.read_bytes()!=after.read_bytes() or len(before.read_text().splitlines())!=3:
            fail("host/process/StatefulSet/source identity changed or final evidence is incomplete")
    return len(actions)


def matrix(path, expected, times, key, stamps=False, mode=None):
    doc=json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    if doc.get('status')!='success' or doc.get('warnings') or doc.get('isPartial') or doc.get('data',{}).get('resultType')!='matrix':
        fail('failed/partial/warned historical response')
    found=set()
    for row in doc['data']['result']:
        identity=key(row['metric'])
        if identity not in expected or identity in found:
            fail('unexpected/duplicate historical series identity')
        found.add(identity)
        data=row.get('values',[])
        if [v[0] for v in data]!=times:
            fail('historical minute missing, duplicated or outside fixed window')
        nums=[float(v[1]) for v in data]
        if any(not math.isfinite(v) or v<0 for v in nums):
            fail('invalid historical numeric evidence')
        if stamps:
            if any(not 0<=at-stamp<=60 for at,stamp in zip(times,nums)) or any(b<a for a,b in zip(nums,nums[1:])):
                fail('stale, future or regressed actual scrape timestamp')
        elif mode:
            if any(v!=int(v) for v in nums): fail('vmalert counter must be integral')
            if mode=='advance' and any(b<=a for a,b in zip(nums,nums[1:])): fail('vmalert evaluations did not advance each minute')
            if mode=='steady' and len(set(nums))!=1: fail('vmalert miss/reset/error counter changed')
    if found!=expected: fail('incomplete historical identity set')


def raw_history(si_backup,c,start,end):
    d=Path(si_backup); begin=utc(start['SOAK_START_UTC']); finish=utc(end['SOAK_END_UTC'])
    if finish-begin<86400: fail('raw history shorter than24h')
    times=list(range(begin,finish+1,60))
    for name in ('t41-alert-copy-history.json','t41-alert-shadow-history.json'):
        alert=json.loads(d.joinpath(name).read_text())
        if alert.get('status')!='success' or alert.get('warnings') or alert.get('isPartial') or alert.get('data',{}).get('resultType')!='vector' or alert['data'].get('result')!=[]:
            fail('fixed-end raw alert query failed or reports a firing alert')
    peer=lambda row:(row.get('member'),row.get('owner'))
    for suffix,stamp in (('history',False),('scrape-times',True)):
        matrix(d/('copy-lag-'+suffix+'.json'),pairs(c),times,peer,stamp)
    identity=json.loads(d.joinpath('soak-vmalert-identity.json').read_text())
    key=lambda row:tuple((k,row[k]) for k in ('group','file','alertname','id') if k in row)
    group=identity.get('group',{}); rules=identity.get('rules',[])
    if set(group)!={'group','file'} or group.get('group')!='storage-integrity-si-v2.members' or not group.get('file') or len(rules)!=6:
        fail('invalid frozen vmalert group identity')
    names={'StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped','StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch','StorageIntegrityMemberForeignPart','StorageIntegrityMemberDiverged','StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind','StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh'}
    if {row.get('alertname') for row in rules}!=names or any(set(row)!={'group','file','alertname','id'} or any(row.get(k)!=v for k,v in group.items()) or not str(row.get('id','')) for row in rules):
        fail('invalid frozen six-rule identity')
    if len({key(row) for row in rules})!=6: fail('duplicate frozen rule identity')
    if type(identity.get('interval')) not in (int,float) or not 0<identity['interval']<=60 or not isinstance(identity.get('selector'),str) or not identity['selector']:
        fail('missing observed vmalert cadence/service selector')
    pod=json.loads(d.joinpath('soak-vmalert-pod.json').read_text())
    if not isinstance(pod.get('uid'),str) or not pod['uid'] or len(pod.get('containers',[]))!=1 or any(not all(row.get(k) for k in ('name','image','imageID','containerID')) or type(row.get('restartCount')) is not int or row['restartCount']<0 or row.get('ready') is not True for row in pod['containers']):
        fail('missing frozen runtime vmalert process/image identity')
    if d.joinpath('t41-vmalert-pod-final.json').read_bytes()!=d.joinpath('soak-vmalert-pod.json').read_bytes() or d.joinpath('t41-vmalert-identity-final.json').read_bytes()!=d.joinpath('soak-vmalert-identity.json').read_bytes():
        fail('vmalert runtime process or group/rule identity changed')
    for metric in ('vmalert_iteration_total','vmalert_iteration_missed_total','vmalert_iteration_reset_total','vmalert_alerting_rules_errors_total'):
        expected={key(row)for row in rules} if metric.endswith('errors_total')else{key(group)}
        mode='advance' if metric=='vmalert_iteration_total' else 'steady'
        matrix(d/(metric+'-history.json'),expected,times,key,False,mode)
        matrix(d/(metric+'-scrape-times.json'),expected,times,key,True)


def raw_probe(si_backup,t41):
    snapshot=json.loads(Path(t41).parent.joinpath('runbook-snapshot.json').read_text())
    corpus=Path(snapshot['docs_root']).parent/'charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_member_live_probe.tsv'
    if digest(corpus)!=snapshot['artifacts']['charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_member_live_probe.tsv']:
        fail('live probe corpus changed since frozen snapshot')
    rows=[line.split('\t') for line in corpus.read_text().splitlines()if line and not line.startswith('#')]
    if not rows or rows.pop(0)!=['expect','statement'] or not rows:fail('invalid frozen probe corpus')
    for host in HOSTS:
        got=read(si_backup,'exit-probe-'+host+'.tsv').splitlines()
        if not got or got.pop(0)!='row\texpect\tgot\tcode\tstatement' or len(got)!=len(rows):fail('incomplete exit probe corpus')
        collection='si_owner_1'if host in ('a','v1','v2','v3')else'si_owner_0'
        for n,(line,source)in enumerate(zip(got,rows),1):
            fields=line.split('\t'); expectation,statement=source
            code='497'if expectation=='denied'else'36'if expectation=='override'else''
            if len(fields)!=5 or fields!=[str(n),expectation,expectation,code,statement.replace('@@COLLECTION@@',collection)]:
                fail('exit probe statement/order/identity/refusal differs from frozen corpus')
    return len(rows)


def evidence(si_backup, t41):
    v = ledger_values(Path(t41, "ledger-41.env"))
    e = {"ledger": v}
    e["actions"] = execution_receipts(t41, si_backup)
    start = key_values(read(si_backup,"soak-start"), ("SOAK_START_UTC","SOAK_START_SEALED","SOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION","SOAK_K","SOAK_B","SOAK_L0"), "soak-start")
    end = key_values(read(si_backup,"soak-end"), ("SOAK_END_UTC","SOAK_END_SEALED"), "soak-end")
    e["start"] = [start["SOAK_START_UTC"], "", str(utc(start["SOAK_START_UTC"]))]
    e["end"] = [end["SOAK_END_UTC"], "", str(utc(end["SOAK_END_UTC"]))]
    e["hours"] = (utc(end["SOAK_END_UTC"]) - utc(start["SOAK_START_UTC"])) / 3600
    e["k"] = read(si_backup,"soak-k").strip()
    if e["k"] not in ("1","2","3") or e["k"] != start["SOAK_K"]:
        fail("soak-k is not the frozen 1..3 value")
    raw_counts, raw_ratio = raw_soak(si_backup, v["INDEXER_C_ID"], start, end, int(e["k"]))
    raw_history(si_backup, v["INDEXER_C_ID"], start, end)
    probe_rows = raw_probe(si_backup, t41)
    first = read(t41, "member-b-ok").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]T[0-9:]{8}Z", first):
        fail(f"{t41}/member-b-ok holds {first!r}, not the UTC time member-b's window passed")
    e["first"] = first[:10]
    e["commits"] = {}
    for name in ("p2-member-member-b-commit", "p2-member-member-c-commit", "p2-member-member-a-commit", "p2-monitoring-commit"):
        sha = read(si_backup, name).strip()

    for x in ("a", "b", "c"):
        total = read(si_backup, f"member-disk-{x}").strip()

        values = re.findall(r"^sentio_node_si_member_"+name+r"(?:\{[^}]*\})? ([^\s]+)$", boot, re.M)
        if not values or (name in ("ready", "audit_clean") and len(values)!=3):

    installs = {src: sum(int(float(n)) for n in re.findall(r'^sentio_node_si_member_installs_total\{source="%s"\} ([0-9.e+]+)$' % src, boot, re.M))
                for src in ("restore", "owner_pull", "peer_unsafe_pull")}
    if installs["restore"] <= 0 or installs["owner_pull"] <= 0:

    e["bootstrap"] = (f"every copy reached its owner's latest published entry, 6 of 6, with {installs['restore']} installs "
                      f"from the P1 backups by restore, {installs['owner_pull']} by owner pull and {installs['peer_unsafe_pull']} "
                      "by peer pull across the three members")
    for r in (1, 2, 3):

    m = read(si_backup, "measurements.txt")

    one(m, r"^StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch fired in the soak: (\[\])$", "measurements.txt")
    e["blocks"] = one(m, r"^blocks ([0-9]+ to [0-9]+: [0-9]+ sealed), per owner \(non-transition\): .*$", "measurements.txt")
    e["per_owner"] = {str(d["owner"]): d["blocks"] for d in json.loads(one(m, r"^blocks [0-9]+ to [0-9]+: [0-9]+ sealed, per owner \(non-transition\): (\[.*\])$", "measurements.txt"))}
    e["shadow"] = re.findall(r"^(member-[abc]) owner ([0-9]+): shadowed \+([0-9]+) of ([0-9]+) sealed non-transition blocks, \+([0-9]+) mismatches, \+([0-9]+) missed scans, \+([0-9]+) unverdicted$", m, re.M)
    if len(e["shadow"]) != 6 or any(s[4] != "0" for s in e["shadow"]):

        fail("measurement disk maximum differs from validated raw samples")

        fail("measurement shadow deltas do not cover six exact peer pairs and every sealed block")

    if sorted(e["disk_used"]) != ["a", "b", "c"] or sorted(e["member_bytes"]) != ["a", "b", "c"]:

    e["probe"] = dict(re.findall(r"^member probe ok on (a|v1|v2|v3|b|c) \(([0-9]+) rows\)$", probe, re.M))
    if sorted(e["probe"]) != sorted(HOSTS) or any(int(count)!=probe_rows for count in e["probe"].values()):

def paragraph(e):

    shadow = "; ".join(f"{mem} shadowed {sh[(mem, o)][2]} of owner {o}'s {sh[(mem, o)][3]} sealed blocks ({sh[(mem, o)][5]} missed scans, {sh[(mem, o)][6]} unverdicted)"

        f"The 500-blocks-per-owner criterion is Plan S3-C2's release-path soak (`P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK` {v['P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK']} "
        f"at arbiter `{v['ARBITER_PIN_P2'][:9]}`). `P2_END` {e['p2_end']}."
    )


def cmd_paragraph(si_backup, t41):
    text = paragraph(evidence(si_backup, t41))
    if "\n" in text:
        fail("the record is not one line")
    print(text)


def cmd_insert(runbook, paragraph_file):
    record = Path(paragraph_file).read_text().strip()
    if not record.startswith("Record of the first run: ") or "\n" in record:
        fail(f"{paragraph_file} is not one 'Record of the first run:' line")
    text = Path(runbook).read_text()
    if text.count("\n## 12. End\n") != 1 or text.count("\n## 13. Rollback\n") != 1:
        fail(f"{runbook}: expected one '## 12. End' and one '## 13. Rollback' heading")
    head, rest = text.split("\n## 12. End\n", 1)
    section, tail = rest.split("\n## 13. Rollback\n", 1)
    if section.count(ANCHOR + "\n") != 1 or text.count(ANCHOR) != 1:
        fail(f"{runbook}: the anchor line is not once in §12")
    if "Record of the first run:" in text:
        fail(f"{runbook} holds a record already")
    before, after = section.split(ANCHOR + "\n", 1)
    if after.strip():
        fail(f"{runbook}: §12 has text after the anchor line")
    new = head + "\n## 12. End\n" + before + ANCHOR + "\n\n" + record + "\n" + "\n## 13. Rollback\n" + tail
    Path(runbook).write_text(new)
    print(f"{runbook}: the record of the first run follows the anchor of §12 ({len(record)} characters)")

        f"Plan S3-C2's P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK {v['P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK']} (K38, D38). Record PR sentioxyz/production#{record_pr} "

        f"member-a {cm['p2-member-member-a-commit'][:12]}, monitoring {cm['p2-monitoring-commit'][:12]} (VMServiceScrape "

        "- steady state for Plan S3-C4: every installation at stage member (si_member with its collection grants, si_member_ddl "
        "nowhere, table_engines_require_grant on), UNSAFE_INC_ROOT empty, every member running and monitored with no member alert "
        "firing, its copies following both peer owners; the members serve no reads yet (P3 adds the serving listener and the "
        "status token's use)",
    ]
    print("\n".join(lines))


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "paragraph":
        cmd_paragraph(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "insert":
        cmd_insert(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 4 and argv[0] == "ledger":
        cmd_ledger(*argv[1:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task41 approval and execution receipts around Task40's immutable D24 producer.
Only future operators execute this tool. Tests use an explicitly inert child.
  t41-run.py approve SESSION MARKER LABEL ROUND|- CHAT_REFERENCE GATE_FILE
  t41-run.py run SESSION MARKER LABEL [ROUND]
  t41-run.py user SESSION soak-R1-b|soak-R1-c|soak-R2-b|soak-R2-c|soak-R3-b|soak-R3-c|drop-b|drop-c KEY_FILE
No key contents are inspected here. Prepared Bash uses the runbook's own key handling.
"""
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def fail(message):
    sys.exit('t41-run: '+message+'; stop (never replay an attempted mutation)')


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def now():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value,stream,sort_keys=True)
        stream.write('\n')
    Path(path).chmod(0o600)


def producer(session, *args):
    process=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',str(session/'task40/prepare.py'),*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if process.returncode:
        fail('immutable producer refused: '+process.stderr.strip())
    return process.stdout.strip()


def context(session, marker, label, rnd):
    session=Path(session).resolve()
    producer(session,'check',str(session))
    snapshot=json.loads((session/'runbook-snapshot.json').read_text())
    if not re.fullmatch(r'41-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9-]+',label):
        fail('expected fresh Task41 label')
    entry=snapshot['blocks'].get(marker)
    if entry is None or (entry['allow_r'] and rnd not in ('1','2','3')) or (not entry['allow_r'] and rnd is not None):
        fail('marker/round does not match the frozen producer declaration')
    # A prior owner0 attempt without semantically complete readbacks stops every
    # subsequent action, including a different marker/label. Never auto-repair it.
    for claim_path in sorted((session/'claims').glob('p2-10-3-r*.started')):
        try:
            claim = json.loads(claim_path.read_text())
            previous_round = claim_path.stem.rsplit('-r', 1)[1]
            previous_label = claim['label']
            if previous_round not in ('1','2','3') or not re.fullmatch(r'41-[0-9]{2}-[a-z0-9-]+', previous_label):
                raise ValueError('invalid prior owner0 identity')
            result = json.loads((session/'task41'/('run-'+previous_label+'.json')).read_text())
            output = session/'task41'/('run-'+previous_label+'.out')
            prepared = session/'blocks'/(previous_label+'.sh')
            wanted = a_readback(output.read_text(), a_plan(Path.home()/'si-devnet2-stage3-p2', previous_round, snapshot['blocks']['p2-10-3']['body']))
            if claim != dict(identity='p2-10-3-r'+previous_round,label=previous_label,rendered_sha256=sha(prepared)) or any(result.get(k)!=v for k,v in dict(marker='p2-10-3',label=previous_label,round=previous_round,exit_code=0,completion_status='complete',safe_readback=wanted,safe_readback_error=None,prepared_file=str(prepared),prepared_sha256=sha(prepared),output_file=str(output),output_sha256=sha(output),snapshot_sha256=sha(session/'runbook-snapshot.json')).items()) or type(result.get('exit_code')) is not int:
                raise ValueError('prior owner0 completion/output/script binding is incomplete')
        except (ValueError, OSError, UnicodeError, KeyError, TypeError):
            fail('a prior owner0 round is started/unknown; stop every next action, retain all attempts, never replay')
    return session,snapshot,entry


def approval_path(session,label):
    return session/'task41'/('approval-'+label+'.json')


def approve(session, marker, label, rnd, chat, gate):
    rnd=None if rnd=='-' else rnd
    session,snapshot,entry=context(session,marker,label,rnd)
    if not entry['confirmed']:
        fail('approval requested for a block without Confirm before running')
    if not chat.strip() or '\n' in chat or '\r' in chat:
        fail('retain the actual user chat approval reference, never an invented yes')
    gate=Path(gate).resolve()
    if not gate.is_file() or not gate.read_bytes() or gate.parent != session/'task41':
        fail('gate must be a retained nonempty Task41 evidence file')
    save(approval_path(session,label),dict(marker=marker,label=label,round=rnd,chat_reference=chat,approved_at=now(),gate_file=str(gate),gate_sha256=sha(gate),snapshot_sha256=sha(session/'runbook-snapshot.json'),source_body_sha256=entry['source_body_sha256']))
    print('actual chat approval retained for '+label)


def a_plan(si_backup, rnd, source):
    """Bind the consumer to the frozen owner0 loop and original finished-snapshot budget."""
    if rnd not in ('1', '2', '3'):
        raise ValueError('owner0 round must be exactly1,2or3')
    lines = source.splitlines()
    required = (
        '# block p2-10-3', 'r=1',
        'source "$si_backup/soak-start"',
        'si_p2_soak_budget "$SOAK_K" || exit 1',
        'lo=$((5202 + (r - 1) * SOAK_K)); hi=$((5201 + r * SOAK_K))',
        '  for v in $(seq "$lo" "$hi"); do si_p2_soak_budget 1 || exit 1; si_accept_a_track "$v" || exit 1; si_p2_soak_budget 0 || exit 1; done',
    )
    if not lines or lines[0] != required[0] or any(lines.count(line) != 1 for line in required):
        raise ValueError('owner0 source marker/round/value loop/budget guards changed')
    backup = Path(si_backup)
    start = {}
    for line in (backup / 'soak-start').read_text().splitlines():
        key, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if not sep or key in start or not re.fullmatch(r'SOAK_[A-Z0-9_]+', key) or not value:
            raise ValueError('malformed/duplicate frozen soak-start field')
        start[key] = value
    if (backup / 'soak-k').read_text() != start.get('SOAK_K', '') + '\n' or start.get('SOAK_K') not in ('1', '2', '3'):
        raise ValueError('soak-k differs from the frozen start')
    budget = (backup / 'budget-start.txt').read_text()
    hits = re.findall(r'^.*; live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(134217728 bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)$', budget, re.M)
    if len(hits) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected the one original finished-snapshot L/4 estimator line')
    live, bound, half = map(int, hits[0])
    k = int(start['SOAK_K'])
    if start.get('SOAK_B') != str(bound) or start.get('SOAK_L0') != str(live) or half != bound // 2 or k != min(3, (half - 3) // 9) or 9*k + 3 > half:
        raise ValueError('frozen k/B/L0 differs from the original P2 half budget')
    r = int(rnd)
    return dict(round=r, k=k, owner=0, table='devnet101.swap_new2',
                lo=5202+(r-1)*k, hi=5201+r*k,
                soak_start_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'soak-start').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                soak_k_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'soak-k').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                budget_start_sha256=hashlib.sha256((backup/'budget-start.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest())


def a_readback(text, plan):
    """Native counts are bare lines, bound by the exact frozen header and ordered loop."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    prefix = f"round {plan['round']} owner a (track 0): values {plan['lo']} to {plan['hi']} into {plan['table']}, from "
    headers = [(i, line[len(prefix):]) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith(prefix)]
    if len(headers) != 1 or len([line for line in lines if line.startswith('round ')]) != 1:
        raise ValueError('missing/duplicate/wrong round/owner/track/value/table header')
    header, stamp = headers[0]
    if not re.fullmatch(r'20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z', stamp):
        raise ValueError('invalid actual owner0 header timestamp')
    dt.datetime.strptime(stamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
    tracks = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('track ')]
    if len(tracks) != plan['k'] or any(i <= header for i in tracks):
        raise ValueError('expected exactly k track0/count pairs after the frozen header')
    rows = []
    for value, index in zip(range(plan['lo'], plan['hi']+1), tracks):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'track 0 published ([0-9]+) -> ([0-9]+)', lines[index])
        if match is None or index+1 >= len(lines) or lines[index+1] != '1':
            raise ValueError('each actual advancing track0 must be immediately followed by bare1')
        before, after = map(int, match.groups())
        if after <= before or (rows and before < rows[-1]['published_after']):
            raise ValueError('owner0 published frontier did not advance in ordered calls')
        if index+2 < len(lines) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', lines[index+2]):
            raise ValueError('ambiguous additional native count after a readback')
        rows.append(dict(value=value, track=0, published_before=before, published_after=after, count=1))
    if len(rows) != plan['k']:
        raise ValueError('incomplete owner0 frozen value range')
    return dict(plan=plan, readbacks=rows)


def execute(session,marker,label,rnd,key=None):
    session,snapshot,entry=context(session,marker,label,rnd)
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed paginated REST primary-author/trailer/head gate before a future squash merge.
  t41-pr.py OWNER/REPOSITORY PR_NUMBER EXPECTED_HEAD
This is a read-only GitHub operation. No GraphQL coauthor list is used.
"""
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys


def fail(message):sys.exit('t41-pr: '+message+'; stop before merge')


def gh(*args):
    result=subprocess.run(['gh',*args],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if result.returncode:fail('GitHub read failed; stderr withheld')
    try:return json.loads(result.stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:fail('GitHub did not return complete JSON')


CANONICAL_READER = r'''"""Fail-closed REST primary-author and trailer check for a pinned PR head."""
import json,re,subprocess,sys
head=sys.argv[1]
if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",head)is None:sys.exit("invalid checked PR head; stop")
pages=json.load(sys.stdin)
if not isinstance(pages,list)or not pages or any(not isinstance(p,list)or not p or len(p)>100 for p in pages):sys.exit("missing or malformed paginated PR commits; stop")
commits=[c for p in pages for c in p]
if len(commits)>=250:sys.exit("REST commit listing reached its limit; stop")
trailer="Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>";seen=set()
for c in commits:
 if not isinstance(c,dict)or not isinstance(c.get("sha"),str)or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",c["sha"])is None or c["sha"]in seen:sys.exit("malformed or duplicate PR commit; stop")
 seen.add(c["sha"]);a=c["commit"]["author"];message=c["commit"]["message"]
 if not isinstance(message,str)or(a["name"],a["email"])!=("poetry","chen@sentio.xyz"):sys.exit("unexpected primary author; stop")
 coauthors=re.findall(r"(?im)^[ \t]*co-authored-by[ \t]*:.*$",message)
 parsed=subprocess.run(["git","interpret-trailers","--parse"],input=message,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout.splitlines()
 if coauthors not in ([],[trailer])or parsed.count(trailer)!=len(coauthors):sys.exit("unexpected or duplicated coauthor trailer; stop")
if commits[-1]["sha"]!=head:sys.exit("REST listing head differs from the checked head; stop")
print("PR commit identities and pinned head verified")
'''


def validate(pull,pages,head):
    if not isinstance(pull,dict) or pull.get('head',{}).get('sha')!=head:
        fail('PR head differs from checked local HEAD')
    if type(pull.get('commits'))is not int or not 1<=pull['commits']<250:
        fail('missing or REST-limit commit count')
    if not isinstance(pages,list)or not pages or any(not isinstance(page,list)or not page for page in pages):
        fail('missing/malformed commit pages')
    commits=[commit for page in pages for commit in page]
    if len(commits)!=pull['commits'] or len(commits)>=250:
        fail('truncated or inconsistent REST listing')
    checked=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-c',CANONICAL_READER,head],input=json.dumps(pages),text=True,capture_output=True)
    if checked.returncode:fail('canonical REST reader refused the listing')
    sys.stdout.write(checked.stdout)
    return len(commits)


def main(args):
    if len(args)!=3:fail(__doc__)
    repo,number,head=args
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+',repo)or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*',number)or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',head):fail('invalid public repo/PR/head arguments')
    pull=gh('api',f'repos/{repo}/pulls/{number}')
    pages=gh('api','--paginate','--slurp',f'repos/{repo}/pulls/{number}/commits?per_page=100')
    n=validate(pull,pages,head)


if __name__=='__main__':main(sys.argv[1:])
```

```python
def compare(base_tree,head_tree,entries,new_releases,output_dir):
    """Compare exact bytes and resource identities; permit only genuinely new named releases."""
```

```bash
# Plan S3-C3 Task 41's own helpers (never committed), sourced by this task's block files right after the
# session's helpers.sh (the P2 runbook's §0 chain and P). They read the cluster, git and local files and
# write only under $si_backup and $T41. None reads, prints or passes a password, token or key: pods are read
# as names and Secret references only, Secrets as key names only (si_secret_keys), and a chart rendering,
# which may hold values from git, lives only in a temporary directory that is removed again. None changes
# the cluster, a pod or git.
# shellcheck shell=bash

T41="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41"
t41_ledger() { # one public ledger value; duplicates are refused, never last-row-wins
  local key="$1" value

  [ "$(grep -c "^$key=" "$T41/ledger-41.env")" = 1 ] || { echo "missing or duplicate public ledger key $key" >&2; return 1; }
  value="$(sed -n "s/^$key=//p" "$T41/ledger-41.env")" || return 1
```
