  [ ! -e "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" ] || { echo "member-$x's window started already: read $T41/host-$x-before.txt" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "$(si_kubectl get statefulset,configmap,service -l "app.kubernetes.io/instance=$r,app.kubernetes.io/component=si-member" -o name | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 0 ] || { echo "a si-member object of $r exists already" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -z "$(si_kubectl get pvc "si-member-state-$r-si-member-0" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ] || { echo "the state claim si-member-state-$r-si-member-0 exists (an earlier start of member-$x): stop and ask" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -z "$(t41_secret_users "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i")$(t41_secret_users "$r-si-member-status-token")" ] || { echo "a pod references storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i or $r-si-member-status-token already" >&2; return 1; }
  t41_host_state "$x" > "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" || return 1
  cat "$T41/host-$x-before.txt"
  echo "member-$x: no member object and no pod references its two Secrets; the host's state is recorded"
}
t41_window_commit() { # $1 a|b|c: after runbook §8's local commit block: HEAD is one commit on origin/main, exactly that member's commit, and the release renders the member as contract §26.2 gives it (local only)
  git fetch -q origin main || return 1
  c3_git_read_060="$( git rev-parse HEAD~1 )" || return 1
  case "$c3_git_read_060" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') return 1;; esac
  [ "${#c3_git_read_060}" = 40 ] || return 1
  c3_git_read_061="$( git rev-parse origin/main )" || return 1
  case "$c3_git_read_061" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') return 1;; esac
  [ "${#c3_git_read_061}" = 40 ] || return 1
  [ "${c3_git_read_060}" = "${c3_git_read_061}" ] || { echo "HEAD is not one commit on origin/main" >&2; return 1; }
  t41_check commit member "$1" "$si_backup" "$(t41_ledger INDEXER_C_ID)" || return 1
  t41_render_check "$1"
}
t41_window_after() { # public host/si-member identity and exact D29 isolation; writes success only after every check
  local x="$1" r i f pod service users
  r="$(t41_release "$x")" || return 2
  i="$(t41_installation "$x")" || return 2
  f="$T41/member-$x-checks.txt"
  [ ! -e "$T41/member-$x-ok" ] && [ ! -e "$f" ] || { echo "member window evidence exists; reconcile, never overwrite" >&2; return 1; }
  t41_host_state "$x" > "$T41/host-$x-after.txt" || return 1
  cmp -s "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" "$T41/host-$x-after.txt" || { echo "host changed: stop and ask for explicit forward repair or confirmed revert" >&2; return 1; }
  pod="$(t41_member_pod "$x")" || return 1
  t41_check member-pod "$x" "$pod" "$(t41_ledger INDEXER_C_ID)" "$(t41_image)" > "$f" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$pod" > "$T41/member-$x-identity.json"
  t41_member_objects "$x" >> "$f" || return 1
  grep -qxF "{\"service\":\"$r-si-member\",\"ports\":[{\"name\":\"metrics\",\"port\":9095},{\"name\":\"status\",\"port\":9096}],\"member_id\":\"member-$x\"}" "$f" || return 1
  grep -qx "pvc si-member-state-$r-si-member-0 Bound local-path 1Gi" "$f" || return 1
  for service in "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i" "$r-si-member-status-token"; do
    users="$(t41_secret_users "$service")" || return 1
    [ "$users" = "$r-si-member-0 " ] || { echo "a member Secret is used by another/no pod; stop" >&2; return 1; }
    printf 'pods using %s: %s\n' "$service" "$users" >> "$f"
  done
  date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$T41/member-$x-ok" || return 1
  cat "$f"
  echo "member-$x window ok; host, StatefulSet and source ClickHouse identities unchanged"
}
t41_identity() { # worktree-local user identity, before any task-created commit
  local w="$1"
  git -C "$w" config extensions.worktreeConfig true || return 1
  git -C "$w" config --worktree user.name poetry || return 1
  git -C "$w" config --worktree user.email chen@sentio.xyz || return 1
  git -C "$w" config --worktree commit.gpgsign true || return 1
}
t41_signed() { # canonical trailer, primary author, good GPG, every new local commit
  local w="$1" identity message trailer_count trailer_rc
  identity="$(git -C "$w" log -1 --format='%an <%ae> %G?')" || return 1
  [ "$identity" = 'poetry <chen@sentio.xyz> G' ] || { echo "commit identity/signature differs; stop" >&2; return 1; }
  git -C "$w" verify-commit HEAD || return 1
  message="$(git -C "$w" log -1 --format=%B)" || return 1
  if trailer_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$message" | grep -iEc '^co-authored-by[[:space:]]*:')"; then trailer_rc=0; else trailer_rc=$?; fi
  case "$trailer_rc" in 0|1) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  [ "$trailer_count" = 1 ] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$message" | grep -qx 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'
}
t41_initial_writes() { # Task39 §10 owns soak-k; before its start, derive only the same conservative planned count
  python3 -I -c 'import importlib.util,sys
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("record",sys.argv[1]);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
_,bound,half=m.budget_line(open(sys.argv[2]).read(),"budget-start.txt")
k=min(3,(half-3)//9)
if k<1:sys.exit("no room for the soak within half the promotion budget; stop")
print(9*k)' "$T41/t41-record.py" "$si_backup/budget-start.txt"
}
t41_run() { python3 -I "$T41/t41-run.py" run "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session" "$@"; }
t41_approve() { # marker label round|- gate; invoke only after the separate, actual chat yes
  local chat
  chat="$(cat "$T41/chat-$2.txt")" || return 1
  python3 -I "$T41/t41-run.py" approve "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session" "$1" "$2" "$3" "$chat" "$4"
}
t41_create() { # repo name branch base; keep the actual absolute JSON path, never resolve its spelling
  local repo="$1" name="$2" branch="$3" base="$4" json w
  json="$T41/urwt-$name.json"
  [ ! -e "$json" ] || { echo 'URWT receipt exists; stop and reconcile' >&2; return 1; }
  bash ~/.agents/skills/urwt/scripts/urwt-create.sh "$repo" codex "$name" "$branch" "$base" > "$json" || return 1
  w="$(python3 -I -c 'import json,sys
v=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));p=v.get("path")
if v.get("action")!="created" or not isinstance(p,str) or not p.startswith("/") or p=="/" or any(c in p for c in "\n\r\0"):sys.exit("new absolute URWT JSON path required; stop")
print(p)' "$json")" || return 1
  c3_git_read_062="$( git -C "$w" branch --show-current )" || return 1
  c3_git_read_063="$( git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD )" || return 1
  case "$c3_git_read_063" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') return 1;; esac
  [ "${#c3_git_read_063}" = 40 ] || return 1
  c3_git_read_064="$( git -C "$repo" rev-parse "$base" )" || return 1
  case "$c3_git_read_064" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') return 1;; esac
  [ "${#c3_git_read_064}" = 40 ] || return 1
  c3_git_read_065="$( git -C "$w" status --porcelain )" || return 1
  [ "${c3_git_read_062}" = "$branch" ] && [ "${c3_git_read_063}" = "${c3_git_read_064}" ] && [ -z "${c3_git_read_065}" ] || return 1
  c3_git_read_066="$( git -C "$w" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir )" || return 1
  c3_git_read_067="$( git -C "$repo" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir )" || return 1
  [ "${c3_git_read_066}" = "${c3_git_read_067}" ] || return 1
  t41_identity "$w" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$w"
}
t41_commit() { # directory message-file one owned path; don't inspect an old HEAD after failure
  local w="$1" msg="$2" path="$3" old new
  old="$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  git -C "$w" add -- "$path" || return 1
  git -C "$w" commit -S -F "$msg" -- "$path" || { echo 'signed commit failed; stop and ask the user to unlock the actual repository key; no unsigned fallback' >&2; return 1; }
  new="$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  c3_git_read_068="$( git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD~1 )" || return 1
  case "$c3_git_read_068" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') return 1;; esac
  [ "${#c3_git_read_068}" = 40 ] || return 1
  [ "$new" != "$old" ] && [ "${c3_git_read_068}" = "$old" ] || return 1
  t41_signed "$w"
}
t41_pr_gate() { # repo number exact expected head; full current-head CI + REST author/message check
  local repo="$1" number="$2" head="$3"
  gh pr checks "$number" --repo "$repo" --watch --fail-fast || return 1
  python3 -I "$T41/t41-pr.py" "$repo" "$number" "$head" || return 1
  local c3_gh_read_09
  c3_gh_read_09="$(gh api "repos/$repo/pulls/$number" --jq .head.sha)" || { echo "GitHub read failed; stop" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "${c3_gh_read_09}" = "$head" ] || return 1
}

## Appendix A: binding contract (continues the Appendix A of Plans S3-A §0–§6, S3-B §7–§15, S3-C1 §16–§19 and S3-C2 §20–§24)

The earlier plans' contracts stay binding; this appendix continues the numbering, so `contract §N` means the same thing in every stage-3 plan. Every name below is binding verbatim for every task of Plan S3-C3. A task that needs a name not listed here adds it in its own section and records it in Appendix B; it never renames one listed here. Names this plan takes from Plans S3-C1 and S3-C2 are spelled as their contracts give them (the cross-plan consistency pass reconciled them, §28.7); if one of those contracts changes a name, its spelling wins.

### 25. The P2 server bundle, engine grants, member users and collections (Task 37)

#### 25.1 What Plan S3-C3 changes (read first)

- No consensus format change and no consensus update: no Raft command, tag, Raft-reachable field, snapshot version (it stays 20), header byte or feature string; `arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()` and every arbiter, verifier and SNode image are unchanged (voters on `ARBITER_DIGEST`, hosts on `SN_DIGEST`). The only new process, the si-member (`SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2`), is never registered and calls only `SafeState.GetSafeWatermark`, `GetManifest`, `GetBlockVerification` and DA `GetPayload`; it never reaches Raft (Plan S3-C2 contract §20–§24).
- What changes on devnet2: the users and grants of every SI installation (users reloads), one restart of every SI ClickHouse (the bundle of §25.3), one Keeper znode (`UNSAFE_INC_ROOT`), three si-member StatefulSets, the members' `hg_replica` and `hg_rstage` tables on the member disks, the member monitoring, and two soak tables on owners 1 and `INDEXER_C_ID` (created and dropped again).
- Every step can be undone without consensus (runbook §13), except that the member ids stay allocated, `unsafe_inc` stays, and undoing the bundle costs another restart.

#### 25.2 Installations, owners and collections

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

#### 25.4 charts/storage-integrity values and rendering

All new values are unset or false by default, and with them so every release renders byte-identically:
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants` (map user → list of engine names, default `{}`): appends `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON <Engine>` to that user's `grants/query`, one entry per engine, after the user's contract §11 grants, in list order.
- `clickhouse.access.member` (false): renders the `si_member` user and the `si_member` profile (§25.6); needs `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_member`.
- `clickhouse.server.enabled` (false): renders the five files of §25.3 and the reader env.
- `clickhouse.server.keepFreeSpaceBytes` (0; required ≥ 10737418240 when enabled), `clickhouse.server.memberDiskPath` (`/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member/`), `clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize` (16).
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections` (list, default `[]`) of `{name, host, port, user, passwordEnv}`; `clickhouse.server.passwordEnv` (list, default `[]`) of `{name, secret: {name, key}}`.
- Helpers in `templates/_helpers.tpl`: `storage-integrity.engineGrants` (the `GRANT TABLE ENGINE` lines of one user), `storage-integrity.memberGrants` (§25.6's list plus the installation's collection grants), `storage-integrity.namedCollectionsXML`.
- The devnet2 overlay `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` carries, in the PR, `clickhouse.server` with `enabled: false` and its collections and env already filled for `network`, `clickhouse.access.engineGrants: {}` and `clickhouse.access.member: false`; each live stage commit (§28.2) flips one of them.
- `indexer-b`'s and `indexer-c`'s CHI manifests are never edited in the PR; each live stage commit rewrites the manifest with the runbook helper `si_p2_yaml <installation> <stage>` (§27.2), which takes the network chart's rendering at that stage with the installation's own collections, env, hashes and member disk path, so `test_p2_server_bundle_files_are_identical_across_installations_by_role` holds at every stage.

#### 25.5 Engine grants (K41)

- `SI_CLICKHOUSE_ENGINE_GRANTS = {"si_snode": ("MergeTree", "ReplicatedMergeTree"), "si_verifier": ("MergeTree", "ReplicatedMergeTree"), "si_gateway": None, "si_reader": (), "si_backup": ()}`; `si_gateway`'s list is `DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES` (`None` in the PR; Task 40 sets the sorted census set, which always contains `Memory` and `MergeTree`, from `ENGINE_CENSUS`).
- `REPLICATED_MERGE_TREE_ENGINES = ("ReplicatedMergeTree", "ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree", "ReplicatedSummingMergeTree", "ReplicatedAggregatingMergeTree", "ReplicatedCollapsingMergeTree", "ReplicatedVersionedCollapsingMergeTree", "ReplicatedGraphiteMergeTree", "ReplicatedCoalescingMergeTree")`; `REACHING_ENGINES = ("Buffer", "Distributed", "Merge", "Alias")`.
- Rendered on every installation at its `engines` stage and kept at every later stage; `si_verifier`'s only on `network`. Never `ON *`, never a revoke, nothing for `default` or `clickhouse_operator`. Task37 also inserts `SI_P2_READER_METADATA_GRANT = "GRANT SHOW COLUMNS ON system.parts"` into `si_reader` immediately before its existing restricted column-SELECT grant, from `engines` onward on every installation (including the network verifier clusters). The three baseline reader grants remain unchanged at `base`; the metadata right adds no table-data SELECT or engine right. `DESCRIBE TABLE system.parts` succeeds and a read of ungranted `bytes_on_disk` remains refused. Task39's exact stage checker consumes the same added grant (§27.2).

#### 25.6 The `si_member` user and profile (spec §8.2 as amended; K32/K33; D36)

CHI `users` keys on an installation at its `member` stage: `si_member/password_sha256_hex` (the hash from `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-<installation>.yaml`), `si_member/networks/ip: ["::/0"]`, `si_member/profile: si_member`, `si_member/grants/query`, verbatim and in this order: Plan S3-C2 contract §23.2's `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS`, with one `GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON <name>` per collection defined on that installation (§25.2 order) in the place §23.2 gives them:
```
GRANT SELECT ON hg_member_unsafe.*
GRANT SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA ON hg_member_unsafe.*
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER DELETE, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE ON hg_replica.*
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE ON hg_rstage.*
GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_replica.*
GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_rstage.*
GRANT READ ON S3
GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON MergeTree
GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Memory
GRANT SELECT ON system.parts
GRANT SELECT ON system.tables
GRANT SELECT ON system.detached_tables
GRANT SELECT ON system.replicas
GRANT SELECT ON system.zookeeper
GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON <collection>   (one line per collection of §25.2 defined here)
GRANT READ ON REMOTE
GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*
```
The test constant `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS` holds the sixteen fixed entries; this list equals the one Plan S3-C2 Task 34's confinement suite runs under (§23.2), and a measured difference changes both in one step. The `hg_rstage` entry names its seven rights and is never `ALL` (spec §8.2 as amended in this plans PR, decision D36: no dictionary, view, `SYSTEM` or definer right on `hg_rstage`); Plan S3-C2 §23.2 carries the same entry. CHI `profiles` keys (`SI_MEMBER_PROFILE`; a reload, like the users): `si_member/profile: default` (inherits the default profile), `si_member/max_memory_usage: "4294967296"`, `si_member/max_concurrent_queries_for_user: "8"`, `si_member/max_threads: "4"`, `si_member/priority: "10"`. `si_member_ddl` is never rendered in this plan.

#### 25.7 validate.yaml refusals (verbatim)

- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants requires clickhouse.access.users`
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants.%s must list ClickHouse table engines by name ([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*), never *`
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants.%s may not hold a Replicated*MergeTree engine: only si_snode and si_verifier create replicated tables`
- `clickhouse.server.enabled requires clickhouse.access.lockDefault: the P2 restart comes after the lockdown (Plan S3-B)`
- `clickhouse.server.enabled requires clickhouse.access.engineGrants for %s: after the restart a user without its engines refuses its own CREATE (spec §8.2)` (every rendered `si_snode`, `si_gateway` and `si_verifier`)
- `clickhouse.server.keepFreeSpaceBytes must be at least 10737418240 (10 GiB)`
- `clickhouse.server.memberDiskPath must be an absolute directory path ending in /`
- `clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize must be an integer from 8 to 64`
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections[%d] needs name (si_owner_<id> or si_peer_verifier_<n>), host, port, user si_reader and passwordEnv`
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections[%d].passwordEnv %s has no clickhouse.server.passwordEnv entry`
- `clickhouse.server.passwordEnv[%d] needs name ([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*), secret.name and secret.key`
- `clickhouse.access.member requires clickhouse.server.enabled: no member user exists on a ClickHouse before its restart (spec §8.2)`
- `clickhouse.access.member requires clickhouse.server.namedCollections: si_member pulls only through NOT OVERRIDABLE collections`
- `si_member_ddl is not created before stage 3 P6 step 6 (Plan S3-F)` (any `passwordSha256.si_member_ddl`)
- `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.%s must be 64 lowercase hex characters` (contract §11, now also for `si_member`)

#### 25.8 Logins script and Secrets

- `scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh <installation> <hashes-file>`, `<installation>` ∈ `network`, `indexer-b`, `indexer-c`, `staging-p2`, run only in the user's terminal. For a member installation it generates the `si_member` password (`openssl rand -hex 24`) and a status token (`openssl rand -hex 32`) and creates two Secrets in namespace `sentio-network-devnet2`: `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` with the one key `clickhouse-password`, and the token's own Secret `<release>-si-member-status-token` with the one key `status-token`, where `<release>` is the installation's host release of §25.2 (`sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member-status-token` for `network`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-member-status-token`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-member-status-token`; decision D29: the token never shares the Secret that holds the `si_member` password); it writes `passwordSha256:` / `  si_member: <hash>` to `<hashes-file>`. For `staging-p2` it creates Secret `storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins` with keys `default`, `si_snode`, `si_gateway`, `si_verifier`, `si_reader`, `si_backup`, `si_member` and writes all seven hashes (no token). It refuses an existing Secret (for a member installation, either of its two) or hashes file, never prints a password or token, and removes its temporary plaintext.
- Mounts (D29): the password Secret only into the `si-member` container (§26.2); the token Secret only within the host's sentio-node release: into the `si-member` container, whose P3 serving listener checks it (Plan S3-C4 §31.3; the P2 image ignores it), and from P3 into the host pod's `sentio-node` container, which presents it (Plan S3-C4 §32.1, `storageIntegrity.replicaReads.memberStatusTokenSecret`); never into `housegate`, a sidecar, a ClickHouse pod or another release. Runbook §1.2 checks with `si_secret_keys` that each member installation's two Secrets hold exactly those keys (key names only, never values).
- Hashes files: `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-<installation>.yaml` (directory mode 700; runbook variable `si_p2_logins_dir`, independent of `$si_backup`).

At each installation's `restarted` stage the posture comment of `indexer-b`'s and `indexer-c`'s CHI (contract §11) gains these lines, verbatim, right after its last line, and the network chart's `templates/clickhouse.yaml` carries the same text as a template comment:
```
# Stage 3 P2 (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md): this
# installation restarted once with table_engines_require_grant (every user
# creates only the table engines granted to it by name), keep_free_space_bytes
# on every disk, the disk and storage policy member, the replicated_merge_tree
# merge default 0, background_fetches_pool_size 16 and NOT OVERRIDABLE named
# collections whose si_reader passwords come from the container environment.
# si_member (spec 8.2) exists from this installation's member stage;
# si_member_ddl does not exist before stage 3 P6 step 6. Users, collections,
# files and the environment are installation-wide (Plan S3-C3 K43).
```

### 26. The si-member StatefulSet, member ids and member monitoring (Task 38)

#### 26.1 charts/sentio-node values (top-level `siMember`, commented, off by default; never inside `node`, `housegate`, `storageIntegrity` or `housegateSidecar`, so never in the host pod's `checksum/config` of `templates/node.yaml:486`)

`siMember.enabled` (false); `siMember.image` (""; a digest-pinned reference `ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<SN_MEMBER_COMMIT_P2>@<SN_MEMBER_DIGEST_P2>`); `siMember.nodeID` (""); `siMember.clickhouseDSN` (""; the host's own source ClickHouse `host:9000`); `siMember.clickhouseUsername` (`si_member`); `siMember.secret` (`{name: "", passwordKey: clickhouse-password}`; the `si_member` password Secret); `siMember.statusTokenSecret` (`{name: "", key: status-token}`; the token's own Secret `<fullname>-si-member-status-token`, decision D29; `<fullname>` is the release name for every devnet2 host release); `siMember.restoreSecret` (`{name: "", accessKeyIDKey: access-id, secretAccessKeyKey: secret}`: Plan S3-C1 contract §18's restore Secrets `storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-a`, `-b`, `-c`, keys `access-id` and `secret`); `siMember.config` (`{}`; the remaining `storage_integrity.member` keys of Plan S3-C2 contract §24.2, rendered verbatim); `siMember.stateSize` (`1Gi`); `siMember.storageClassName` (`local-path`); `siMember.resources` (requests cpu `250m` / memory `512Mi`, limits cpu `"2"` / memory `2Gi`); `siMember.nodeSelector` (`{sentio.xyz/general: "true"}`); `siMember.metricsPort` (9095); `siMember.statusPort` (9096); `siMember.reconciler.enabled` (false).

#### 26.2 Objects (new template `charts/sentio-node/templates/si-member.yaml`, rendered only when `siMember.enabled`)

- ConfigMap `<fullname>-si-member-config`, key `si-member.yaml`:
  ```yaml
  storage_integrity:
    arbiter_peers: <storageIntegrity.arbiterPeers>
    payload_store_data_addr: <storageIntegrity.payloadStoreDataAddr>
    member:
      node_id: <siMember.nodeID>
      state_dir: /data/si-member
      network_id: <storageIntegrity.snode.networkID>
      clickhouse_dsn: <siMember.clickhouseDSN>
      clickhouse_username: si_member
      metrics_listen: ":<siMember.metricsPort>"
      <siMember.config, merged after these keys>
  ```
  (Plan S3-C2 contract §24.2's keys; `config.LoadSIMemberConfig` decodes with `KnownFields(true)`, so the file carries no key outside `SIMemberConfig`: no `enabled` and, in P2, no serving listener. Plan S3-C4 §32.1 adds the `serve` block on `siMember.statusPort` for the P3 image.)
- StatefulSet `<fullname>-si-member` (`replicas: 1`, `serviceName: <fullname>-si-member`, selector and pod labels `app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance: <release>`, `app.kubernetes.io/component: si-member`, `storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id: <nodeID>`), pod annotation `checksum/si-member-config` (sha256 of the rendered ConfigMap data only), `nodeSelector` from `siMember.nodeSelector` (never `.Values.nodeSelector`), one container `si-member`: `image: <siMember.image>`, `command: ["/sentio-node"]`, `args: ["si-member", "--config-path", "/config/si-member.yaml"]`, env `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD` (`siMember.secret` / `passwordKey`), `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN` (`siMember.statusTokenSecret` / `key`, never `siMember.secret`; read by the P3 image's serving listener, Plan S3-C4 §31.3, and ignored by the P2 image), `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET` (`siMember.restoreSecret`; Plan S3-C2 §24.2), ports `metrics` (9095) and `status` (9096), mounts `config` (`/config`, read-only) and `si-member-state` (`/data/si-member`); `volumeClaimTemplates` `si-member-state` (`siMember.storageClassName`, `siMember.stateSize`). No `si-member-reconciler` container (the slot is the value `siMember.reconciler.enabled`, refused while true, §26.3).
- Service `<fullname>-si-member` (ClusterIP, same labels as the pod), ports `metrics` and `status`.
- No Secret: `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` and `<fullname>-si-member-status-token` come only from `make-p2-logins.sh` (§25.8). The host StatefulSet references neither in P2.

#### 26.3 Guards (verbatim, `templates/si-member.yaml`)

- `siMember is supported only in indexer mode`
- `siMember.enabled requires storageIntegrity.enabled: the si-member reads the host's arbiter peers, DA address and network id`
- `siMember.image must be a digest-pinned image (<repository>:<tag>@sha256:<64 hex>)`
- `siMember.nodeID must be one member id (member-[a-z])`
- `siMember.nodeID must differ from storageIntegrity.snode.nodeID`
- `siMember.clickhouseDSN is required (the host's own source ClickHouse, host:port)`
- `siMember.clickhouseUsername must be si_member`
- `siMember.secret.name is required: the si_member password comes only from that Secret`
- `siMember.statusTokenSecret.name must be %s-si-member-status-token: the status token has its own Secret` (`%s` the chart fullname)
- `siMember.statusTokenSecret.name must differ from siMember.secret.name: the status token never shares the Secret that holds the si_member password`
- `siMember.config may not set node_id, state_dir, network_id, clickhouse_dsn, clickhouse_username or metrics_listen: they come from siMember values`
- `siMember.config may not carry a password, a token or a key: secrets come only from siMember.secret, siMember.statusTokenSecret and siMember.restoreSecret` (any key matching `(?i)password|token|secret|key$`)
- `siMember.reconciler.enabled needs the si_member_ddl user of spec §10.4 step 6 (Plan S3-F); it stays false in P2`

#### 26.4 Member ids (Plan S3-C2 K29)

`member-a` on SI indexer 0 (indexer-a), `member-b` on 1 (indexer-b), `member-c` on `INDEXER_C_ID` (indexer-c); never reused, never an SNode, verifier or voter id. `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-multi-source.md` §1.2 gains, after the SNode table and its "Next free id" line, this paragraph and table (the indexer id literal filled from the ledger):
```markdown
Member node ids (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.1, §6.1; Plan S3-C2 K29) are allocated once, from this ledger, and never reused: each is its si-member's scratch prefix from stage 3 P2 and becomes its VERIFIER node id and Keeper replica name from P6, so a member id is never an SNode, verifier or voter id.

| Member | Host (SI indexer) | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `member-a` | 0 (indexer-a) | stage 3 P2 ([storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md) §8.3) |
| `member-b` | 1 (indexer-b) | stage 3 P2 (§8.1 of that runbook) |
| `member-c` | <INDEXER_C_ID> (indexer-c) | stage 3 P2 (§8.2 of that runbook) |

Next free member id: `member-d`.
```

`si_member_ch a|b|c|v1|v2|v3 <sql>` (runs as `si_member` on that ClickHouse, the password of `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` key `clickhouse-password` piped into `kubectl exec -i` stdin as `CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD`, never on argv); `si_engine_census <host> [<since UTC>]` (JSON lines `{user, kind, engine, database, table, count}`); `si_engine_census_check <census-file>` (prints `census ok: si_gateway <engines>` or stops); `si_replicated_tables <host>` (TSV of every `Replicated*` table with `pins_merges` true/false); `si_p2_yaml <installation> <stage>` and `si_p2_py` (the owning `stage`, `constant`, `member`, `monitoring`, `check`, `grants`, `engines`, `census`, `sample`, `round`, `copies`, `probe-file`, `vmalert-history`, `history` and `soak` subcommands; renders and rewrites a CHI manifest or the network overlay for a stage, §25.4); `si_p2_stage_check <host> <stage>` (reads back the preprocessed config, `system.disks`, `system.storage_policies`, `system.replicated_merge_tree_settings`, `system.named_collections` names and uptime as admin; prints `stage <stage> ok on <host>`); `si_quiet_point a|b|c` (§27.5; prints `quiet point ok for <owner>` or stops); `si_unsafe_inc` (`si_keeper "ls '/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe_inc'"`); `si_member_probe <host>` (runs `si_member_live_probe.tsv` as `si_member` into `member-probe-<host>.tsv` or `exit-probe-<host>.tsv`; first `CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_rstage` and `hg_replica` as `si_member`, and at the end drops only a database it created in that run and only where no si-member runs; a mutating helper, so every call sits in a confirmed block; prints `member probe ok on <host> (<n> rows)`); `si_budget_capture` and `si_budget` (Plan S3-B runbook §13.4's two blocks as merged on housegate `main` in housegate#237, `838de2d`, verbatim, writing `budget-voter`, `budget-snapshots.tgz`, `budget-live-seq` and printing the budget line); `si_blockowners_build` and `si_blockowners <from_seq> <to_seq>` (throwaway tool `$si_backup/tools/blockowners`, the one Go block of §0, built from `CORE_TAG_P2`'s `dataplane.Client.GetBlockVerification`, never committed; JSON lines `{block_seq, owner, verdict_evaluated, quorum}`); `si_shadow_sample` (one TSV line per (member, owner): time, blocks, mismatches, missed scans, copy behind, copy entry, member disk used ratio); `si_copies_check` (each member's copy entry per owner against `si_track_published <owner>`; prints `copies equal: <n> of <n>` or the differences).

- `si_p2s_gateway_reader_probe()` consumes only the existing staging Secret keys `si_gateway` and `si_reader` through stdin, emits fixed public status and never prints raw client diagnostics or puts secrets on argv. `si_p2s_grant_probe()` produces exactly seven TSV fields: `row`, `role`, `expect`, `got`, `code`, `statement`, `executed_statement_template`; ordinary rows repeat the logical statement in the last field, while only the exact gateway row uses the disclosed authenticated template. Task40's staging record consumer rejects any other mapping, stale six-field logs or credential literals. The member live probe remains five fields and refusal-only.
- `si_p2_grants` uses the unchanged eight-field admin query (`user_name`, `access_type`, `access_object`, `database`, `table`, `column`, `is_partial_revoke`, `grant_option`), distinct from C2's five-field own-grant API. The stage checker preserves every unchanged real baseline row, including reader column grants and legitimate backup `WRITE ON S3`, and compares the exact per-installation users, engine objects, reader metadata and expanded member tuples. Its additional no-WRITE assertion applies to `si_member`; the exact expected-set comparison rejects unexpected added/missing rights for every user. Nullable scopes and revoke/option flags are not normalized away.

#### 27.4 Census (§2, K41)

Per host `a`, `v1`, `v2`, `v3`, `b`, `c`: `si_engine_census <host>` over the seven days before the run and `si_replicated_tables <host>`, then `si_engine_census_check`. Stops on: any engine of `si_snode`/`si_verifier` outside `MergeTree`, `ReplicatedMergeTree`; any `CREATE` by `si_reader` or `si_backup`; any `Replicated*` engine by `si_gateway`; any `CREATE DATABASE ... ENGINE`; any replicated table that is not a protocol `hg_unsafe` table and does not pin `max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool`; a user other than `default`, `clickhouse_operator` and the `si_*` users creating anything. `engine-census.txt` ends with the line `ENGINE_CENSUS=<sorted si_gateway engines, comma-separated>`.

#### 27.5 Quiet point and restart window (§5, K39)

- `si_quiet_point <owner>` checks: every partition of that owner has `unacked_promotion_seq` 0 (`si_partstates`); `arbiter:pending_blocks:max` is 0 (for `network`, every track); no Job of `<owner release>-si-backup` (Plan S3-C1's CronJob `<fullname>-si-backup`) is active; no `REPLACE`-retired outdated part of `hg_safe` younger than `old_parts_lifetime` (Plan S3-B runbook §13.3's query); no drill is writing.
- A window: quiet point → confirmed commit (§28.2) → apply (`kubectl apply --dry-run=server` then `kubectl apply` for `indexer-b`/`indexer-c`; `si_render_diff storage-integrity-si-v2` showing only the CHI, then the one-release `helmfile sync` for `network`) → `si_chi_state` `Completed` → each ClickHouse pod of the installation restarted exactly once (uptime regressed once) → `si_p2_stage_check <host> restarted` on each → `sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}` up by one and `..._unclean_tables` 0 on the owner → on the installation's source host, as `si_gateway`, `CREATE TABLE devnet2.p2_restart_probe (x UInt8) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/p2-restart-probe/{uuid}', 'r') ORDER BY x` refused with 497 naming `TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree`, leaving no znode under `/p2-restart-probe` (the order of the two checks is measured first in §3) → one acceptance write on the owner reaches safe (§27.7). For `network` also: every block sealed during the window reaches a verdict with quorum, and no track is quarantined. Never two windows in one session.

#### 27.6 si-members and bootstrap (§8, §9)

- Per member, in the order `member-b`, `member-c`, `member-a`: confirmed single-service commit flipping `siMember.enabled` (and `DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED`), `si_render_diff sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-<x>` showing only the `si-member` ConfigMap, StatefulSet and Service (the host StatefulSet unchanged), one-release `helmfile sync`, pod Ready, its first log lines and `si_member_metrics` present, `bootstrap-<member-id>.txt`. The host pod's UID and restart count are unchanged (evidence before and after).
- §8.4: one confirmed commit setting `monitoring.members.releases` to the three releases and `monitoring.members.installations` to the three CHIs (with `DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS`, `DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS`), synced; every member alert's series present, none firing.
- §9: each member reaches, for both peer owners, a copy entry equal to `si_track_published <owner>` (`si_copies_check`), with `sentio_node_si_member_installs_total{source="restore"}` above 0 on at least one member (P1's backups are the bootstrap source, spec §8.6: Plan S3-C2's bootstrap restore probe takes the first part of each copy from them, contract §22.3, review fix 245-4) and `{source="owner_pull"}` above 0 across the three (every other part), `..._foreign_tables` 0 and `..._diverged_partitions_total` 0.

#### 27.7 Acceptance names, values and soak writes (§1.3, §5, §10; D19)

- indexer-a (owner 0): `si_accept_a_track <value>` into `devnet101.swap_new2`, values `5201` to `5299` (disjoint from `3001`–`3004`, `3101`–`3102`, `4101`–`4104` and Plan S3-C1's P1 range).
- indexer-b (owner 1): table `devuser1.s3_p2`; indexer-c (owner `INDEXER_C_ID`): table `s3_p2` in the database named by `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/acceptance-db` (Plan S3-B runbook §8); both `(id UInt64, v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id`, created in §1.3 and dropped in §12 by the `devuser1` owner through its own agent (`si_agent_ch`, one confirmed block per statement), rows `id` from 1 upward with `v` = `p2-<section>-<id>`.
- Budget (§1.3): `si_budget_capture`, then `si_budget` → `budget-start.txt`; per owner and round `k = min(3, (budget // 2 - 3) // 9)`; stop when `k < 1`. Writes: one acceptance write per restart window (owner of that window: §5.1 row 1 of `devuser1.s3_p2`, §5.2 row 1 of `<db>.s3_p2`, §5.3 value `5201`), then three soak rounds R1 (soak start), R2 (≥ 12 h later), R3 (≥ 24 h after the start), each `k` writes per owner (one confirmed block per owner per round). Total ≤ `budget // 2`. The two `CREATE TABLE`s and `DROP TABLE`s cost table-set transition publications, not promotions; §12 re-runs the budget into `budget-end.txt`, which measures the state everything left.

#### 27.8 Exit criteria (§11, §12; spec §16 P2 as amended, K38)

`p2-end.txt` records, and the exit holds only if: (1) Plan S3-C2's ledger shows `P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK` at least 500 and its Task 36 run record `arbiter pin and integration run` shows `TestPipeline_MemberCopiesNeverHoldRowsOfARejectedStatement` and `TestPipeline_MemberShadowSoak` passed with zero mismatches, at `ARBITER_PIN_P2`, in the release-path full soak (Cut Release or a manual `workflow_dispatch`, decision D38; a pull request's 50-blocks-per-owner soak never counts); (2) for every member and each of its two peer owners, `shadow_blocks_total` grew by at least the number of that owner's blocks in `blocks-soak.jsonl` (sealed between `soak-start` and the end), `shadow_mismatches_total` grew by 0, and missed scans are reported apart, with at least one shadowed block per owner per round without a missed scan; (3) `StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind` never fired during a 24 h window inside the soak (`ALERTS` history via `si_vm_query`) and the final `si_copies_check` prints all equal; (4) on every member host the member disk's filesystem is below 50 % used, with the member bytes (`system.parts` and `system.detached_parts` on disk `member`) recorded; (5) `si_member_probe <host>` on all six ClickHouses (`a`, `v1`, `v2`, `v3`, `b`, `c`) prints every row refused, including `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree` with 497 naming `TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree`; (6) `budget-end.txt` shows the P2 writes within half of `budget-start.txt`'s budget; (7) the soak tables are dropped and every member dropped their copies (Retiring on). §12 writes `p2-end.txt` and the line `P2_END=<YYYY-MM-DD>`.

#### 27.9 Rollback and operating rules (§13, §14)

- §13, in reverse order of what ran: a member — `siMember.enabled: false` (its pod and state volume go; the host is untouched; its `hg_replica`/`hg_rstage` tables are dropped as admin only on the user's decision); the monitoring commit — revert; a `member` stage — revert the commit (users reload, `si_member` gone); `unsafe_inc` — never removed; a `restarted` stage — revert the commit, which restarts that installation once more (only on the user's decision, at a quiet point); an `engines` stage — revert (reload). Every revert is one confirmed commit with `si_head_is`.
- §14: a 497 for a missing engine after a restart is answered by granting that engine by name (an `engines`-stage commit, reload), never by removing the setting (§14.2); a new tenant engine is granted before first use; P2 never combines a restart with another change, and from P2 on every SI ClickHouse restart follows §27.5 (§14.3); every drill computes its budget with `si_budget` and spends at most half (§14.4); members (§14.1): Foreign → keep the scratch, stop that table, page; Diverged → automatic rebuild, page if it repeats; a down member does not affect consensus in P2; the K43 residuals.

### Plan-level facts

#### Review fixes (AgentConnect round 1)

- **245-4, the bootstrap check required a restore install the member never made (Task 39 runbook §9, §14.1; contract §27.6; Task 41 Step 7 and its end record).** Plan S3-C2's install order tries the owner pull first, so with healthy owners all six copies bootstrapped by owner pull and §9's mandatory `installs_total{source="restore"} > 0` (also read by Task 41's `p2-end` record) stopped an otherwise successful rollout. Fixed in Plan S3-C2 (its review fix 245-4, contract §22.3): while an owner has no journaled entry, the first fetch of each of its copies tries the restore before the owner pull, once per copy and member process, so the bootstrap installs one part per copy from the P1 backups and the rest by owner pull. §9 now says so (and that `<n>` is at most the number of copies), its validator names the probe in its refusal, §14.1 says how to read a probe that missed or failed (`install_outcomes_total`, the restore Secret, `READ ON S3`, the bucket, a table newer than the newest backup), and contract §27.6 cites the probe; the requirement itself is unchanged, because it is now produced deterministically wherever the P1 backups list a peer owner's oldest parts. Verified: §9's embedded validator parses and, run on a sample bootstrap with probe installs, prints `bootstrap ok: installs from restore 12, by owner pull 36; …`, and on an owner-pull-only sample still fails with the new refusal; the runbook's headings, which Task 39's conventions check pins, are unchanged.
- **245-1, the member's startup order (runbook §8.1–§8.3 Expected; Task 41 Step 3).** Plan S3-C2's review fix 245-1 runs the first copyset pass before the startup audit (contract §23.1 step (8)), so a starting member logs the copies its first pass creates before `install: audit completed`, and the feed after both; the four Expected texts that list a member's first log lines now say so. Nothing else of this plan reads the order.
